input: to Telugu: Q: What is the purpose of the epsilon closure in an NFA-ε? A) It represents the input alphabet for the automaton. B) It determines the final accepting states of the automaton. C) ఏ input symbol నూ consume చేయకుండా చేరుకోగల states యొక్క set ని అది నిర్వచిస్తుంది. D) Infinite loops ని నివారించడానికి automaton లో states సంఖ్యను అది పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the purpose of the epsilon closure in an NFA-ε? A) It represents the input alphabet for the automaton. B) It determines the final accepting states of the automaton. C) It defines the set of states reachable without consuming any input symbol. D) It limits the number of states in the automaton to prevent infinite loops. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a master is transmitting data in Mode 0 and receiving data in Mode 1 simultaneously, what does this imply about the configuration? target_en: Q: If a master is transmitting data in Mode 0 and receiving data in Mode 1 simultaneously, what does this imply about the configuration? target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using self-excitation in a generator design? A) It converts AC output into DC output B) It eliminates the need for a commutator C) It makes the generator operate without a prime mover D) It allows the generator to produce more power by using its own output ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: When defining a primary key constraint in SQL, what happens to the columns participating in that key? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it necessary to maintain multiple concurrent versions of a software product rather than just keeping the latest version? B) సంబంధం లేని projects ని developers ఒకే చోట store చేయడానికి. C) Binary files automatic గా text formats కి మారేలా చూడటానికి. D) Code ని compile చేయాల్సిన అవసరాన్ని తప్పించి system memory ని ఆదా చేయడానికి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is it necessary to maintain multiple concurrent versions of a software product rather than just keeping the latest version? A) To enable locating and fixing bugs that may exist only in specific historical versions. B) To allow developers to store unrelated projects in a single location. C) To ensure that binary files are automatically converted to text formats. D) To bypass the need for compiling code, saving system memory. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of optimization, what does the branching step achieve? A) It recursively divides the current search space into smaller, more constrained regions. target: ప్రశ్న: Optimization సందర్భంలో branching step ఏమి సాధిస్తుంది? A) అది ప్రస్తుత search space ను recursively చిన్న, ఎక్కువ constrained regions గా విభజిస్తుంది. B) ఇప్పటి వరకు కనుగొన్న best feasible solution ను కొత్త upper bound గా ఎంచుకుంటుంది. C) Problem కి initial solution కనుగొనడానికి ఒక heuristic ను apply చేస్తుంది. D) ఒక region లోని అన్ని candidate solutions కి objective function ను evaluate చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the context of optimization, what does the branching step achieve? A) It recursively divides the current search space into smaller, more constrained regions. B) It selects the best feasible solution found so far as the new upper bound. C) It applies a heuristic to find an initial solution to the problem. D) It evaluates the objective function for all candidate solutions in a region. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the Fourier series representation at a point of finite jump discontinuity for a piecewise-smooth function? A) అది ఏ ఒక్క finite value కీ చేరకుండా నిరంతరం oscillate అవుతుంది B) అది left-hand మరియు right-hand limits యొక్క arithmetic mean కి converge అవుతుంది C) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ కచ్చితంగా right-hand limit కి converge అవుతుంది D) Gibbs phenomenon వల్ల అది పూర్తిగా infinity కి diverge అవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the Fourier series representation at a point of finite jump discontinuity for a piecewise-smooth function? A) It oscillates indefinitely without approaching any single finite value B) It converges to the arithmetic mean of the left-hand and right-hand limits C) It always converges strictly to the right-hand limit D) It diverges completely to infinity due to Gibbs phenomenon ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FLP impossibility result considered fundamental in distributed systems? A) It proves that shared memory systems are always faster than message-passing systems. B) It demonstrates that deterministic consensus is impossible in asynchronous systems with even one crash failure. C) It proves that no consensus algorithm can handle Byzantine failures in any system. D) It mandates that synchronous systems must use randomized algorithms to function. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Distributed systems లో FLP impossibility result ని ప్రాథమికమైనదిగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) Shared memory systems ఎల్లప్పుడూ message-passing systems కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయని అది నిరూపిస్తుంది. B) ఒక్క crash failure ఉన్నా asynchronous systems లో deterministic consensus అసాధ్యమని అది చూపిస్తుంది. C) ఏ system లోనూ ఏ consensus algorithm కూడా Byzantine failures ని handle చేయలేదని అది నిరూపిస్తుంది. D) Synchronous systems పనిచేయడానికి randomized algorithms ఉపయోగించాలని అది నిర్దేశిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the FLP impossibility result considered fundamental in distributed systems? A) It proves that shared memory systems are always faster than message-passing systems. B) It demonstrates that deterministic consensus is impossible in asynchronous systems with even one crash failure. C) It proves that no consensus algorithm can handle Byzantine failures in any system. D) It mandates that synchronous systems must use randomized algorithms to function. ANSWER: B

C) వాటి N-point circular convolution లెక్కించబడుతుంది. D) Aliasing లేకుండా వాటి direct sum generate అవుతుంది. జవాబు: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² of a system in a pure stationary state over time? A) It grows exponentially because of the imaginary unit in the time exponent. B) It remains strictly independent of time despite the complex phase factor oscillating. C) It rapidly disperses across all space due to destructive wave packet interference. D) It oscillates periodically with an angular frequency proportional to the system's kinetic energy. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Pure stationary state లో ఉన్న system యొక్క probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² కాలక్రమేణా ఏమవుతుంది? A) Time exponent లోని imaginary unit వల్ల అది exponential గా పెరుగుతుంది. B) Complex phase factor oscillate అవుతున్నప్పటికీ అది time పై కచ్చితంగా ఆధారపడకుండా ఉంటుంది. C) Destructive wave packet interference వల్ల అది వేగంగా అంతటా వ్యాపిస్తుంది. D) System యొక్క kinetic energy కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉన్న angular frequency తో అది periodic గా oscillate అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² of a system in a pure stationary state over time? A) It grows exponentially because of the imaginary unit in the time exponent. B) It remains strictly independent of time despite the complex phase factor oscillating. C) It rapidly disperses across all space due to destructive wave packet interference. D) It oscillates periodically with an angular frequency proportional to the system's kinetic energy. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why would a designer use a Non-Maskable Interrupt instead of a maskable interrupt? A) To allow the processor to ignore the signal during high-load periods B) To reduce the overhead of context switching during instruction execution C) To ensure that critical, time-sensitive events are handled immediately regardless of current masking settings D) To enable the use of polling loops instead of interrupt-driven logic ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Designer maskable interrupt కి బదులు Non-Maskable Interrupt ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) ఎక్కువ load ఉన్న సమయాల్లో processor ఆ signal ని పట్టించుకోకుండా ఉండటానికి B) Instruction execution సమయంలో context switching overhead ని తగ్గించడానికి C) ప్రస్తుత masking settings తో సంబంధం లేకుండా కీలకమైన, time-sensitive events వెంటనే handle చేయబడేలా చూడటానికి D) Interrupt-driven logic కి బదులు polling loops ఉపయోగించడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why would a designer use a Non-Maskable Interrupt instead of a maskable interrupt? A) To allow the processor to ignore the signal during high-load periods B) To reduce the overhead of context switching during instruction execution C) To ensure that critical, time-sensitive events are handled immediately regardless of current masking settings D) To enable the use of polling loops instead of interrupt-driven logic ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key advantage of using a local branch predictor over a global one? A) It always achieves a 100% prediction accuracy on any code. B) ఇది pattern history table అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. C) ఒకే history buffer ను share చేయడం వల్ల దీనికి తక్కువ hardware సరిపోతుంది. D) ఇది ఒకే branch instruction కి ప్రత్యేకమైన patterns ను బాగా predict చేయగలదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key advantage of using a local branch predictor over a global one? A) It always achieves a 100% prediction accuracy on any code. input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the receptive field of a neuron in a deep convolutional network as data passes through multiple layers? A) It increases, allowing the neuron to see a larger context of the input. B) It becomes the same size as the fully connected layer. C) It shrinks, focusing only on the most important pixels. D) It remains constant at the size of the convolution kernel. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Data అనేక layers గుండా వెళ్లే కొద్దీ deep convolutional network లోని neuron యొక్క receptive field కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) అది పెరుగుతుంది, దాంతో neuron input యొక్క పెద్ద context ను చూడగలుగుతుంది. B) అది fully connected layer పరిమాణానికి సమానం అవుతుంది. C) అది కుంచించుకుపోయి అత్యంత ముఖ్యమైన pixels పై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెడుతుంది. D) అది convolution kernel పరిమాణం వద్ద స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to the receptive field of a neuron in a deep convolutional network as data passes through multiple layers? A) It increases, allowing the neuron to see a larger context of the input. B) It becomes the same size as the fully connected layer. C) It shrinks, focusing only on the most important pixels. target_en: Q: Why must transmission lines be modeled using distributed-element parameters rather than standard lumped circuits? A) Because transmission lines are only used for digital signals. input: to Telugu: Q: How does a processor recover from a control hazard when a branch instruction jumps to a new memory location? A) By flushing the pipeline to clear invalid instructions. B) By inserting NOPs until the branch completes. C) By executing the branch in-order with a delay. D) By using operand forwarding to bypass the branch. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Branch instruction ఒక కొత్త memory location కి jump చేసినప్పుడు processor control hazard నుండి ఎలా కోలుకుంటుంది? A) Invalid instructions ను తొలగించడానికి pipeline ను flush చేయడం ద్వారా. B) Branch పూర్తయ్యే వరకు NOPs ను insert చేయడం ద్వారా. C) Branch ను delay తో in-order గా execute చేయడం ద్వారా. D) Branch ను bypass చేయడానికి operand forwarding ను వాడడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does a processor recover from a control hazard when a branch instruction jumps to a new memory location? A) By flushing the pipeline to clear invalid instructions. B) By inserting NOPs until the branch completes. C) By executing the branch in-order with a delay. D) By using operand forwarding to bypass the branch. ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: What is a primary limitation of using only the holdout method for model evaluation? A) It cannot be used for classification tasks, only regression. input: to Telugu: Q: Why should an engineer be cautious when applying an 'ideal' filter to economic time series data? A) It can create artifacts like false cycles that do not exist in the real data. B) Economic data always has a higher sampling rate than electrical signals. C) Ideal filters only work on mechanical beam-mass systems. D) Ideal filters are too expensive to implement in software. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Economic time series data కి 'ideal' filter ని apply చేసేటప్పుడు engineer ఎందుకు జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండాలి? A) అసలు data లో లేని false cycles వంటి artifacts ని అది సృష్టించవచ్చు. B) Economic data కి ఎల్లప్పుడూ electrical signals కంటే ఎక్కువ sampling rate ఉంటుంది. C) Ideal filters mechanical beam-mass systems పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి. D) Software లో ideal filters ని implement చేయడం చాలా ఖరీదైనది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why should an engineer be cautious when applying an 'ideal' filter to economic time series data? A) It can create artifacts like false cycles that do not exist in the real data. B) Economic data always has a higher sampling rate than electrical signals. C) Ideal filters only work on mechanical beam-mass systems. D) Ideal filters are too expensive to implement in software. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes a shear force acting on a structural member? A) A purely rotational force applied to the center of gravity of an object. B) A load applied perpendicular to a beam's cross-section causing it to stretch. C) Two parallel forces acting in opposite directions on different parts of a body. D) Forces acting towards each other causing the material to shorten. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక structural member పై పనిచేసే shear force ను ఏ సందర్భం ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) ఒక వస్తువు center of gravity వద్ద apply చేసిన పూర్తిగా rotational force. B) Beam cross-section కి లంబంగా apply చేసి దానిని సాగదీసే load. C) ఒక body లోని వేర్వేరు భాగాలపై వ్యతిరేక దిశల్లో పనిచేసే రెండు parallel forces. D) ఒకదానివైపు ఒకటి పనిచేసి material ను కుదించే forces. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes a shear force acting on a structural member? A) A purely rotational force applied to the center of gravity of an object. B) A load applied perpendicular to a beam's cross-section causing it to stretch. C) Two parallel forces acting in opposite directions on different parts of a body. D) Forces acting towards each other causing the material to shorten. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the Optimal Brain Damage algorithm, how is the 'saliency' of a parameter defined? A) By approximating the increase in loss that would occur if that parameter were set to zero B) By the magnitude of the weight value itself C) By the distance between the parameter and the bias term D) By the frequency with which the parameter is updated during backpropagation ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Optimal Brain Damage algorithm లో ఒక parameter యొక్క 'saliency' ని ఎలా నిర్వచిస్తారు? A) ఆ parameter ను zero గా set చేస్తే loss లో వచ్చే పెరుగుదలను approximate చేయడం ద్వారా B) Weight value యొక్క magnitude ద్వారానే C) Parameter మరియు bias term మధ్య దూరం ద్వారా D) Backpropagation సమయంలో parameter ఎంత తరచుగా update అవుతుందో దాని ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the Optimal Brain Damage algorithm, how is the 'saliency' of a parameter defined? A) By approximating the increase in loss that would occur if that parameter were set to zero B) By the magnitude of the weight value itself C) By the distance between the parameter and the bias term D) By the frequency with which the parameter is updated during backpropagation ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must both the transmitting and receiving UARTs be set to the same bit rate? target_en: Q: Why must both the transmitting and receiving UARTs be set to the same bit rate? A) To eliminate the need for a start bit B) To allow the use of parallel transmission C) To prevent the need for a shift register D) To ensure the receiver samples the incoming signal at the correct intervals ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How do object-oriented design patterns typically differ from functional programming paradigms? A) They cannot be used with immutable data structures. target_en: Q: How do object-oriented design patterns typically differ from functional programming paradigms? A) They cannot be used with immutable data structures. B) They focus on class relationships rather than functions. C) They are unsuited for functional languages because they imply mutable state. D) They are simpler to implement in functional languages. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does machine learning fundamentally differ from traditional statistical analysis in terms of model creation? A) Statistics is restricted to small datasets, while machine learning is only for large data. B) Machine learning requires predefined, significant variables. C) Machine learning allows data to shape the model structure, whereas statistics often requires a priori model selection. D) Machine learning is purely algorithmic and never uses statistical principles. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Model సృష్టి విషయంలో machine learning సాంప్రదాయ statistical analysis నుండి ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Statistics చిన్న datasets కు మాత్రమే పరిమితం, machine learning కేవలం పెద్ద data కోసం మాత్రమే. B) Machine learning కు ముందే నిర్వచించిన, ముఖ్యమైన variables అవసరం. C) Machine learning లో data యే model structure ను రూపొందిస్తుంది, అయితే statistics లో తరచుగా a priori model selection అవసరం. D) Machine learning పూర్తిగా algorithmic, ఇది ఎప్పుడూ statistical principles ను ఉపయోగించదు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does machine learning fundamentally differ from traditional statistical analysis in terms of model creation? A) Statistics is restricted to small datasets, while machine learning is only for large data. B) Machine learning requires predefined, significant variables. C) Machine learning allows data to shape the model structure, whereas statistics often requires a priori model selection. D) Machine learning is purely algorithmic and never uses statistical principles. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a composite quadrature rule yield a smaller error than a single-interval rule over a large domain? A) It converts a definite integral into an exact elementary antiderivative B) It increases the degree of the global interpolating polynomial to infinity C) Dividing the domain into smaller subintervals keeps low-degree polynomial interpolations closer to the true function D) It eliminates the need to evaluate the integrand at interior coordinates ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: పెద్ద domain పై single-interval rule కంటే composite quadrature rule ఎందుకు తక్కువ error ను ఇస్తుంది? A) అది definite integral ను ఖచ్చితమైన elementary antiderivative గా మారుస్తుంది B) అది global interpolating polynomial degree ని infinity కి పెంచుతుంది C) Domain ను చిన్న subintervals గా విభజించడం వల్ల low-degree polynomial interpolations నిజమైన function కి దగ్గరగా ఉంటాయి D) Interior coordinates వద్ద integrand ను evaluate చేయవలసిన అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does a composite quadrature rule yield a smaller error than a single-interval rule over a large domain? A) It converts a definite integral into an exact elementary antiderivative B) It increases the degree of the global interpolating polynomial to infinity C) Dividing the domain into smaller subintervals keeps low-degree polynomial interpolations closer to the true function D) It eliminates the need to evaluate the integrand at interior coordinates ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a developer choose a non-convex boosting algorithm over a convex one like AdaBoost? A) To guarantee that the training error will always be exactly zero. B) To avoid the vulnerability of convex algorithms to random noise that can prevent learning basic hypotheses. C) To ensure the model is always trained on the entire dataset without any noise. D) To simplify the mathematical formulation of the optimization problem. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: AdaBoost వంటి convex boosting algorithm కంటే non-convex boosting algorithm ని developer ఎందుకు ఎంచుకోవచ్చు? A) Training error ఎల్లప్పుడూ కచ్చితంగా సున్నా అని హామీ ఇవ్వడానికి. B) ప్రాథమిక hypotheses ని నేర్చుకోకుండా అడ్డుకోగల random noise కి convex algorithms లోనయ్యే బలహీనతను తప్పించడానికి. C) Model ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఎలాంటి noise లేకుండా మొత్తం dataset పై train అయ్యేలా చూడటానికి. D) Optimization problem యొక్క mathematical formulation ని సరళీకరించడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why might a developer choose a non-convex boosting algorithm over a convex one like AdaBoost? A) To guarantee that the training error will always be exactly zero. B) To avoid the vulnerability of convex algorithms to random noise that can prevent learning basic hypotheses. C) To ensure the model is always trained on the entire dataset without any noise. D) To simplify the mathematical formulation of the optimization problem. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key difference between L1 and L2 regularization? A) L1 regularization is an explicit form, while L2 is an implicit form B) L1 regularization is only used in neural networks, while L2 is used in linear models C) L1 regularization penalizes the square of coefficients, while L2 penalizes the absolute value D) L1 regularization encourages sparse models, while L2 encourages smaller, distributed coefficients ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: L1 మరియు L2 regularization మధ్య ముఖ్య తేడా ఏమిటి? A) L1 regularization explicit రూపం, L2 implicit రూపం B) L1 regularization ను neural networks లో మాత్రమే, L2 ను linear models లో వాడతారు C) L1 regularization coefficients యొక్క square ను, L2 absolute value ను penalize చేస్తుంది D) L1 regularization sparse models ను ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది, L2 చిన్న, పంపిణీ అయిన coefficients ను ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key difference between L1 and L2 regularization? A) L1 regularization is an explicit form, while L2 is an implicit form B) L1 regularization is only used in neural networks, while L2 is used in linear models C) L1 regularization penalizes the square of coefficients, while L2 penalizes the absolute value D) L1 regularization encourages sparse models, while L2 encourages smaller, distributed coefficients ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary implication of using a consistent heuristic in A*? A) The algorithm will always find the shortest path in a finite graph B) The cost function will be linear with respect to path length C) The algorithm will use less memory than with an admissible heuristic D) A node, once removed from the open set, will have its optimal path guaranteed ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: A* లో consistent heuristic ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Finite graph లో algorithm ఎప్పుడూ shortest path ను కనుగొంటుంది B) Cost function path length కి సంబంధించి linear గా ఉంటుంది C) Admissible heuristic తో పోలిస్తే algorithm తక్కువ memory వాడుతుంది D) ఒక node ను open set నుండి తీసేసిన తర్వాత దాని optimal path హామీ ఇవ్వబడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a primary implication of using a consistent heuristic in A*? A) The algorithm will always find the shortest path in a finite graph B) The cost function will be linear with respect to path length C) The algorithm will use less memory than with an admissible heuristic D) A node, once removed from the open set, will have its optimal path guaranteed ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is an artifact considered a fundamental concept in the UML deployment process? A) Because it is the physical entity that is actually deployed to a computational node B) Because it is used to define the look-across cardinality of associations C) Because it is the tool used to draw interaction diagrams D) Because it represents the abstract classes in a model ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: UML deployment process లో artifact ని ప్రాథమిక భావనగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది computational node కి నిజంగా deploy చేయబడే భౌతిక entity B) ఎందుకంటే associations యొక్క look-across cardinality ని నిర్వచించడానికి అది ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది C) ఎందుకంటే interaction diagrams గీయడానికి ఉపయోగించే tool అదే D) ఎందుకంటే అది model లోని abstract classes ని సూచిస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is an artifact considered a fundamental concept in the UML deployment process? A) Because it is the physical entity that is actually deployed to a computational node B) Because it is used to define the look-across cardinality of associations C) Because it is the tool used to draw interaction diagrams D) Because it represents the abstract classes in a model ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is PWA considered a prevalent approach for cuffless blood pressure estimation using wrist-based PPG signals? A) It uses pulse transit time which is difficult to measure on the wrist B) It relies on the DC component of the PPG signal C) It requires two devices to measure parameters at a certain distance apart D) It extracts features from the PPG waveform and uses machine learning ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Wrist-based PPG signals ఉపయోగించి cuffless blood pressure estimation కి PWA ని ఎందుకు ప్రబలమైన విధానంగా పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది wrist పై కొలవడం కష్టమైన pulse transit time ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది B) అది PPG signal యొక్క DC component పై ఆధారపడుతుంది C) కొంత దూరంలో parameters ని కొలవడానికి దానికి రెండు devices అవసరం D) అది PPG waveform నుండి features ని extract చేసి machine learning ఉపయోగిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is PWA considered a prevalent approach for cuffless blood pressure estimation using wrist-based PPG signals? A) It uses pulse transit time which is difficult to measure on the wrist B) It relies on the DC component of the PPG signal C) It requires two devices to measure parameters at a certain distance apart D) It extracts features from the PPG waveform and uses machine learning ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of spectral density in signal processing? A) To determine the time-domain amplitude of a signal B) To calculate the total duration of a signal C) To describe the distribution of a signal's power or energy across frequency components D) To identify the physical location of a signal's source ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Signal processing లో spectral density యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Signal యొక్క time-domain amplitude ని నిర్ణయించడం B) Signal యొక్క మొత్తం duration ని లెక్కించడం C) Frequency components అంతటా signal యొక్క power లేదా energy ఎలా పంపిణీ అయిందో వివరించడం D) Signal source యొక్క భౌతిక స్థానాన్ని గుర్తించడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of spectral density in signal processing? A) To determine the time-domain amplitude of a signal B) To calculate the total duration of a signal C) To describe the distribution of a signal's power or energy across frequency components D) To identify the physical location of a signal's source ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What role does the totient function play in RSA key generation? A) It is used to compute the private exponent d B) It is used to select the public exponent e C) It is used to generate the prime numbers p and q D) It is used to encrypt the message directly ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: What role does the totient function play in RSA key generation? A) It is used to compute the private exponent d B) It is used to select the public exponent e C) It is used to generate the prime numbers p and q D) It is used to encrypt the message directly ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a garden-path sentence significant in the study of parsing? target_en: Q: Why is a garden-path sentence significant in the study of parsing? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary trade-off when selecting the size of a time quantum in round-robin scheduling? A) చిన్న quanta మెరుగైన fairness ని ఇస్తాయి కానీ తరచుగా switching వల్ల system overhead ని పెంచుతాయి B) చిన్న quanta ready queue లోకి వచ్చే కొత్త processes కి starvation కలిగిస్తాయి C) పెద్ద quanta context switching overhead ని పెంచుతాయి D) Quantum size కి system performance పై ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం లేదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary trade-off when selecting the size of a time quantum in round-robin scheduling? A) Smaller quanta ensure better fairness but increase system overhead due to frequent switching B) Smaller quanta cause starvation for new processes entering the ready queue C) Larger quanta increase context switching overhead D) The size of the quantum has no impact on system performance ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What exact relationship connects the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of an N-point sequence to its discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT)? A) The DFT is the continuous envelope connecting the discrete peaks of the DTFT. B) The DFT doubles the periodic repetition rate of the continuous DTFT spectrum. C) The DFT consists of N equally spaced frequency samples of one DTFT period. D) The DFT represents an infinite integration over the continuous DTFT spectrum. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: N-point sequence యొక్క discrete Fourier transform (DFT) ని దాని discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT) తో కలిపే కచ్చితమైన సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) DFT అనేది DTFT యొక్క discrete peaks ని కలిపే continuous envelope. B) DFT continuous DTFT spectrum యొక్క periodic repetition rate ని రెట్టింపు చేస్తుంది. C) DFT ఒక DTFT period యొక్క N సమాన దూరంలో ఉన్న frequency samples ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది. D) DFT continuous DTFT spectrum పై infinite integration ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What exact relationship connects the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of an N-point sequence to its discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT)? A) The DFT is the continuous envelope connecting the discrete peaks of the DTFT. B) The DFT doubles the periodic repetition rate of the continuous DTFT spectrum. C) The DFT consists of N equally spaced frequency samples of one DTFT period. D) The DFT represents an infinite integration over the continuous DTFT spectrum. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of switched Ethernet compared to traditional shared-bus Ethernet regarding collision domains? A) It eliminates the need for MAC addresses B) It uses wireless signals instead of wires C) It allows for unlimited distance between nodes D) It isolates traffic, effectively creating smaller or single-node collision domains ANSWER: D

A) అది MAC addresses అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది B) అది wires కి బదులు wireless signals ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) Nodes మధ్య అపరిమిత దూరాన్ని అనుమతిస్తుంది D) అది traffic ని వేరు చేసి, చిన్న లేదా single-node collision domains ని సమర్థవంతంగా సృష్టిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of switched Ethernet compared to traditional shared-bus Ethernet regarding collision domains? A) It eliminates the need for MAC addresses B) It uses wireless signals instead of wires C) It allows for unlimited distance between nodes D) It isolates traffic, effectively creating smaller or single-node collision domains ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens in delta modulation when the input signal's derivative is larger than the product of the sampling frequency and step size? A) Slope overload occurs, causing the modulated signal to fail to track the input. B) The system automatically switches to asynchronous mode. C) The signal is accurately tracked due to high sampling rate. D) Granularity noise is introduced into the signal. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Delta modulation లో input signal derivative, sampling frequency మరియు step size ల product కంటే పెద్దగా ఉంటే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Slope overload జరుగుతుంది, దాంతో modulated signal input ను track చేయడంలో విఫలమవుతుంది. B) System స్వయంచాలకంగా asynchronous mode కి మారుతుంది. C) ఎక్కువ sampling rate వల్ల signal ఖచ్చితంగా track అవుతుంది. D) Signal లోకి granularity noise ప్రవేశిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens in delta modulation when the input signal's derivative is larger than the product of the sampling frequency and step size? A) Slope overload occurs, causing the modulated signal to fail to track the input. B) The system automatically switches to asynchronous mode. C) The signal is accurately tracked due to high sampling rate. D) Granularity noise is introduced into the signal. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental difference between model compression and knowledge distillation? target: ప్రశ్న: Model compression మరియు knowledge distillation మధ్య ప్రాథమిక తేడాను ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Model compression అనేది reverse knowledge distillation యొక్క subset B) Knowledge distillation recurrent neural networks కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది C) Knowledge distillation కి ఎల్లప్పుడూ model compression కంటే ఎక్కువ training data అవసరం D) Model compression కొత్త model ని train చేయకుండా size ని తగ్గిస్తుంది, distillation కొత్త, చిన్న model ని train చేస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental difference between model compression and knowledge distillation? A) Model compression is a subset of reverse knowledge distillation B) Knowledge distillation is only applicable to recurrent neural networks C) Knowledge distillation always requires more training data than model compression D) Model compression reduces size without training a new model, whereas distillation trains a new, smaller model ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is forward error correction preferred over ARQ in high-speed fiber-optic communication? A) FEC uses less redundant data than ARQ protocols like Stop-and-wait. B) FEC is implemented in hardware while ARQ requires software processing. C) ARQ cannot handle the burst errors common in fiber-optic channels. D) ARQ requires a back channel which adds latency and is unsuitable for high-speed links. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: High-speed fiber-optic communication లో ARQ కంటే forward error correction ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) Stop-and-wait వంటి ARQ protocols కంటే FEC తక్కువ redundant data ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) FEC hardware లో implement చేయబడుతుంది, ARQ కి software processing అవసరం. C) Fiber-optic channels లో సాధారణంగా వచ్చే burst errors ని ARQ handle చేయలేదు. D) ARQ కి back channel అవసరం, అది latency ని పెంచుతుంది మరియు high-speed links కి సరిపోదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is forward error correction preferred over ARQ in high-speed fiber-optic communication? A) FEC uses less redundant data than ARQ protocols like Stop-and-wait. B) FEC is implemented in hardware while ARQ requires software processing. C) ARQ cannot handle the burst errors common in fiber-optic channels. D) ARQ requires a back channel which adds latency and is unsuitable for high-speed links. ANSWER: D

target: ప్రశ్న: బయటి labels లేకుండా self-supervised learning supervisory signals ను ఎలా generate చేస్తుంది? A) Transformations ద్వారా data నుండే pseudo-labels ను సృష్టించడం ద్వారా B) Manual గా annotate చేసిన ground truth data ను వాడడం ద్వారా C) Supervised learning నుండి pre-trained models ను వాడడం ద్వారా D) Unsupervised clustering algorithms పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does self-supervised learning generate supervisory signals without external labels? A) By creating pseudo-labels from the data itself through transformations B) By using manually annotated ground truth data C) By using pre-trained models from supervised learning D) By relying solely on unsupervised clustering algorithms ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the sign of the Hall coefficient help characterize a semiconductor? A) It measures the total magnetic permeability of the crystal lattice B) It indicates whether the semiconductor is intrinsic or completely undoped C) It identifies whether conduction is dominated by electrons or holes D) It calculates the exact bandgap energy of the material ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Hall coefficient యొక్క sign ఒక semiconductor ని వర్గీకరించడానికి ఎలా సహాయపడుతుంది? A) అది crystal lattice యొక్క మొత్తం magnetic permeability ని కొలుస్తుంది B) Semiconductor intrinsic గా ఉందా లేదా పూర్తిగా undoped గా ఉందా అని సూచిస్తుంది C) Conduction లో electrons ఆధిపత్యం ఉందా లేదా holes ఆధిపత్యం ఉందా అని గుర్తిస్తుంది D) Material యొక్క కచ్చితమైన bandgap energy ని లెక్కిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does the sign of the Hall coefficient help characterize a semiconductor? A) It measures the total magnetic permeability of the crystal lattice B) It indicates whether the semiconductor is intrinsic or completely undoped C) It identifies whether conduction is dominated by electrons or holes D) It calculates the exact bandgap energy of the material ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens when the transition function is undefined for the current state and symbol? A) The machine ignores the symbol and moves to the next cell B) The machine enters a non-deterministic state and tries all possible actions C) The machine halts the computation immediately D) The machine resets to the initial state and continues ANSWER: C

A) Machine ఆ symbol ని పట్టించుకోకుండా తదుపరి cell కి వెళ్తుంది B) Machine ఒక non-deterministic state లోకి ప్రవేశించి అన్ని సాధ్యమైన actions ని ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది C) Machine వెంటనే computation ని halt చేస్తుంది D) Machine initial state కి reset అయి కొనసాగుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens when the transition function is undefined for the current state and symbol? A) The machine ignores the symbol and moves to the next cell B) The machine enters a non-deterministic state and tries all possible actions C) The machine halts the computation immediately D) The machine resets to the initial state and continues ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens in an electron double-slit experiment if detectors are added at the slits to determine which slit each electron passes through? C) The interference pattern shifts phase but retains its fringes. D) The electrons bounce off and fail to reach the detection screen. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Electron double-slit experiment లో, ప్రతి electron ఏ slit గుండా వెళ్తుందో తెలుసుకోవడానికి slits వద్ద detectors పెడితే ఏమవుతుంది? C) Interference pattern phase మారుతుంది కానీ fringes అలాగే ఉంటాయి. D) Electrons వెనక్కి bounce అయి detection screen ను చేరలేవు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens in an electron double-slit experiment if detectors are added at the slits to determine which slit each electron passes through? A) The intensity of the interference fringes doubles due to detection energy. B) The interference pattern is destroyed and replaced by two particle-like bands. target_en: Q: Under what condition does TLB thrashing most likely occur? A) When the physical memory is completely full and no page frames are free. input: to Telugu: Q: A rare disease affects 0.1% of a population. A test has a 99% true positive rate and a 2% false positive rate. If a person tests positive, why is the posterior probability of having the disease still relatively low? A) The true positive rate is insufficiently high to confirm rare diseases. B) The conditional probability of testing positive given the disease equals zero. C) The law of total probability cannot be applied to rare events. D) The small prior probability makes false positives vastly outnumber true positives. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక అరుదైన వ్యాధి జనాభాలో 0.1% మందిని ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది. ఒక test కి 99% true positive rate మరియు 2% false positive rate ఉన్నాయి. ఒక వ్యక్తికి positive వస్తే, వ్యాధి ఉండే posterior probability ఇంకా ఎందుకు సాపేక్షంగా తక్కువగా ఉంటుంది? A) అరుదైన వ్యాధులను నిర్ధారించడానికి true positive rate తగినంత ఎక్కువగా లేదు. B) వ్యాధి ఉన్నప్పుడు positive వచ్చే conditional probability సున్నాకు సమానం. C) అరుదైన events కి law of total probability ని apply చేయలేము. D) చిన్న prior probability వల్ల false positives సంఖ్య true positives కంటే చాలా ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: A rare disease affects 0.1% of a population. A test has a 99% true positive rate and a 2% false positive rate. If a person tests positive, why is the posterior probability of having the disease still relatively low? A) The true positive rate is insufficiently high to confirm rare diseases. B) The conditional probability of testing positive given the disease equals zero. C) The law of total probability cannot be applied to rare events. B) Direct methods continuous limits ఉపయోగించి solutions ని approximate మాత్రమే చేయగలవు. C) Direct methods finite precision లో round-off errors పేరుకుపోకుండా నివారిస్తాయి. D) Converge అవ్వడానికి direct methods ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒక initial guess పై ఆధారపడతాయి. జవాబు: A

D) Routing table మార్పులను వ్యాప్తి చేసి, local link status updates గురించి neighbours కి తెలియజేయడానికి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does a distance-vector protocol require periodic updates between neighbouring routers? A) To establish physical connections between routers that were previously disconnected. input: to Telugu: Q: How does the wavelet transform handle changes in time extension and shape of the basis functions? A) Time extension లో గానీ shape లో గానీ ఎలాంటి మార్పులను అనుమతించదు B) Time extension లో మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది కానీ shape లో కాదు C) Time extension మరియు shape రెండింటిలోనూ మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది D) Shape లో మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది కానీ time extension లో కాదు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the wavelet transform handle changes in time extension and shape of the basis functions? A) It does not allow any changes in either time extension or shape B) It allows changes in time extension but not shape C) It allows both changes in time extension and shape D) It allows changes in shape but not time extension ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does Occam's razor relate to the selection of a machine learning model? A) It suggests preferring simpler models over more complex ones when both fit equally well B) It mandates the use of the most complex model available C) It states that all models are equally probable D) It requires models to be trained on the largest possible dataset ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Machine learning model ఎంపికకు Occam's razor ఎలా సంబంధించినది? A) రెండూ సమానంగా fit అయినప్పుడు సంక్లిష్టమైన models కంటే సరళమైన models ను ఇష్టపడాలని అది సూచిస్తుంది B) అందుబాటులో ఉన్న అత్యంత సంక్లిష్టమైన model ను వాడాలని అది తప్పనిసరి చేస్తుంది C) అన్ని models సమానంగా probable అని అది చెబుతుంది D) Models ను సాధ్యమైనంత పెద్ద dataset పై train చేయాలని అది కోరుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does Occam's razor relate to the selection of a machine learning model? A) It suggests preferring simpler models over more complex ones when both fit equally well B) It mandates the use of the most complex model available C) It states that all models are equally probable D) It requires models to be trained on the largest possible dataset ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: Under what condition does the Minimax theorem fail to guarantee that the move order between the generator and discriminator is irrelevant? input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the von Neumann bottleneck limit a computer's overall performance? A) The CPU lacks the ability to perform complex arithmetic operations. B) Control unit operations ని తగినంత వేగంగా sequence చేయలేదు. C) పెద్ద programs ని store చేయడానికి memory capacity చాలా చిన్నది. D) Instructions మరియు data రెండింటినీ fetch చేయడానికి ఒకే bus ని పంచుకోవాలి, దీనివల్ల throughput పరిమితి ఏర్పడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does the von Neumann bottleneck limit a computer's overall performance? A) The CPU lacks the ability to perform complex arithmetic operations. B) The control unit cannot sequence operations fast enough. C) Memory capacity is too small to store large programs. D) A single bus must be shared to fetch both instructions and data, creating a throughput limit. ANSWER: D

B) Single point of failure ను నివారించడానికి అది authority ని అనేక servers కి అప్పగిస్తుంది. C) ప్రపంచంలోని ప్రతి ISP పంచుకునే ఒకే database file ను అది వాడుతుంది. B) Double-bit errors ను handle చేయడానికి దానికి రెట్టింపు parity bits అవసరం. C) అది ఏ double-bit errors నూ గుర్తించలేదు. D) అది అన్ని double-bit errors ను సరిచేయగలదు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary limitation of a standard Hamming code regarding double-bit errors? A) It may incorrectly decode a double-bit error as a single-bit error. target_en: Q: What is the primary goal of using Random Early Detection (RED) in a network? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary implication of the Shannon-Hartley theorem for designing a communication system? A) It determines the minimum signal power required to overcome noise. B) It sets the theoretical maximum error-free data rate for a given bandwidth and SNR. C) It specifies the exact type of error-correcting code to be used. D) It measures the physical length of the communication channel. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Communication system ని design చేయడంలో Shannon-Hartley theorem యొక్క ప్రధాన implication ఏమిటి? A) Noise ని అధిగమించడానికి అవసరమైన కనీస signal power ని అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. B) ఇచ్చిన bandwidth మరియు SNR కి theoretical maximum error-free data rate ని అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. C) ఉపయోగించాల్సిన error-correcting code యొక్క కచ్చితమైన రకాన్ని అది నిర్దేశిస్తుంది. D) Communication channel యొక్క భౌతిక length ని అది కొలుస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary implication of the Shannon-Hartley theorem for designing a communication system? A) It determines the minimum signal power required to overcome noise. B) It sets the theoretical maximum error-free data rate for a given bandwidth and SNR. C) It specifies the exact type of error-correcting code to be used. D) It measures the physical length of the communication channel. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: If the temperature of the cold reservoir is lowered while keeping the hot reservoir temperature constant, what happens to the maximum efficiency of a Carnot engine? input: to Telugu: Q: In which scenario would Weighted Round-Robin be strictly superior to standard Round-Robin? A) When a network administrator wants to prioritize specific traffic flows over others B) When the CPU needs to minimize the number of context switches C) When all data flows have identical packet sizes and requirements D) When the scheduler is non-preemptive and jobs are short ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ సందర్భంలో Weighted Round-Robin, standard Round-Robin కంటే కచ్చితంగా మెరుగైనది? A) Network administrator కొన్ని నిర్దిష్ట traffic flows కి ఇతర వాటి కంటే priority ఇవ్వాలనుకున్నప్పుడు B) CPU context switches సంఖ్యను తగ్గించాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు C) అన్ని data flows కి ఒకే packet sizes మరియు requirements ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Scheduler non-preemptive గా ఉండి jobs చిన్నవిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In which scenario would Weighted Round-Robin be strictly superior to standard Round-Robin? A) When a network administrator wants to prioritize specific traffic flows over others B) When the CPU needs to minimize the number of context switches C) When all data flows have identical packet sizes and requirements D) When the scheduler is non-preemptive and jobs are short ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: Why is timely certificate revocation critical for security? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary risk associated with a centralized version control system when multiple developers edit the same file simultaneously? target: ప్రశ్న: అనేక developers ఒకే file ని ఒకేసారి edit చేసినప్పుడు centralized version control system తో ముడిపడిన ప్రధాన risk ఏమిటి? A) Corruption ని నివారించడానికి system automatic గా file ని తొలగిస్తుంది. B) మార్పులను process చేయడానికి server కి ఎక్కువ విద్యుత్ అవసరమవుతుంది. C) సరైన locking లేదా merging లేకుండా developers అనుకోకుండా ఒకరి పనిని మరొకరు overwrite చేయవచ్చు. D) File system ఒక DAG structure నుండి tree structure కి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary risk associated with a centralized version control system when multiple developers edit the same file simultaneously? A) The system will automatically delete the file to prevent corruption. B) The server will require more electricity to process the changes. C) Developers may inadvertently overwrite each other's work without proper locking or merging. D) The file system will switch from a DAG structure to a tree structure. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: How is the spectral energy density of a continuous-time signal calculated? B) Program కి undefined behavior ఉంటుంది, అంటే ఏ ఫలితమైనా రావచ్చు. C) Memory corruption ని నివారించడానికి program automatic గా terminate అవుతుంది. input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Daily Scrum meeting? A) To allow stakeholders to provide feedback on the daily progress B) To report progress toward the sprint goal and identify potential blockers C) To assign tasks to team members based on their expertise D) To perform a detailed technical code review for the daily tasks ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Daily Scrum meeting యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) రోజువారీ పురోగతిపై stakeholders feedback ఇవ్వడానికి అనుమతించడం B) Sprint goal వైపు పురోగతిని report చేసి, సంభావ్య blockers ని గుర్తించడం C) Team members కి వారి నైపుణ్యం ఆధారంగా tasks కేటాయించడం D) రోజువారీ tasks కోసం వివరణాత్మక technical code review చేయడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Daily Scrum meeting? A) To allow stakeholders to provide feedback on the daily progress B) To report progress toward the sprint goal and identify potential blockers C) To assign tasks to team members based on their expertise D) To perform a detailed technical code review for the daily tasks ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under standard conditions with a simple root, what does quadratic convergence imply about the error at step n? A) The number of correct significant digits roughly doubles with each step B) The error decreases linearly with the total number of iterations C) The error decreases by exactly 50 percent each step D) The execution time scales quadratically with matrix dimension ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Simple root తో standard conditions లో, quadratic convergence step n వద్ద error గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) ప్రతి step తో సరైన significant digits సంఖ్య దాదాపు రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది B) మొత్తం iterations సంఖ్యతో error linear గా తగ్గుతుంది C) ప్రతి step లో error సరిగ్గా 50 percent తగ్గుతుంది D) Execution time matrix dimension తో quadratic గా పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under standard conditions with a simple root, what does quadratic convergence imply about the error at step n? A) The number of correct significant digits roughly doubles with each step B) The error decreases linearly with the total number of iterations C) The error decreases by exactly 50 percent each step D) The execution time scales quadratically with matrix dimension ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the state-value function estimate about being in a particular state? A) How good it is to be in that given state under a specific policy. D) The immediate reward received after transitioning from that state. ANSWER: A

B) ఆ state లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్న మొత్తం సాధ్యమైన actions సంఖ్య. C) Random action కింద మరొక state కి మారే probability. D) ఆ state నుండి మారిన వెంటనే లభించే reward. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What does the state-value function estimate about being in a particular state? A) How good it is to be in that given state under a specific policy. B) The total number of possible actions available in that state. C) The probability of transitioning to another state under a random action. D) The immediate reward received after transitioning from that state. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How do tension forces differ from shear forces regarding the alignment of the applied loads? A) Tension forces always cause sliding while shear forces always cause elongation. input: to Telugu: Q: Which is true regarding the relationship between control gain and system stability? target_en: Q: Which is true regarding the relationship between control gain and system stability? A) Higher gain always improves stability without exception B) Lower gain always results in faster settling times C) Gain has no effect on the stability of a control loop D) Excessive gain can cause a system to oscillate or diverge ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does an inference engine function within an expert system architecture? A) It compiles the source code of the expert system into executable binaries. C) కొత్త domain information కనుగొనబడినప్పుడు అది system software ను స్వయంచాలకంగా upgrade చేస్తుంది. D) User profiles మరియు historical data ను store చేసే database manager గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does an inference engine function within an expert system architecture? A) It compiles the source code of the expert system into executable binaries. input: to Telugu: Q: In what scenario is a cross assembler most useful? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of a systematic error correction scheme over a non-systematic code? A) It requires fewer check bits to achieve the same level of error correction. D) It is more resistant to burst errors during transmission. ANSWER: B

B) Decode చేయకుండానే receiver అసలు data bits ను సులభంగా access చేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది. C) దానిని సరళమైన Viterbi algorithm తో decode చేయవచ్చు. D) Transmission సమయంలో burst errors కి అది ఎక్కువ నిరోధకత కలిగి ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of a systematic error correction scheme over a non-systematic code? A) It requires fewer check bits to achieve the same level of error correction. B) It allows the receiver to easily access the original data bits without decoding. C) It can be decoded using a simpler Viterbi algorithm. D) It is more resistant to burst errors during transmission. ANSWER: B

D) Data k సమాన folds గా విభజించబడుతుంది, ఒక fold training కి ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In leave-one-out cross-validation, what happens to the training set for each iteration? A) The entire dataset is used for both training and validation. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Diffie-Hellman key exchange considered secure against an eavesdropper? A) Because the modulus p is kept secret by the communicating parties. D) ఎందుకంటే shared secret ను transmit చేసే ముందు encrypt చేస్తారు. జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: When analyzing a digital filtering system using the additive noise model, what is a key assumption about the quantization error? A) It behaves like white noise with a flat power spectral density. B) It increases linearly as the bit rate increases. C) It is only present in mid-riser quantizers. D) It is perfectly correlated with the input signal. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Additive noise model ఉపయోగించి digital filtering system ని analyze చేసేటప్పుడు quantization error గురించి ముఖ్య assumption ఏమిటి? A) అది flat power spectral density ఉన్న white noise లా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది. B) Bit rate పెరిగేకొద్దీ అది linear గా పెరుగుతుంది. C) అది mid-riser quantizers లో మాత్రమే ఉంటుంది. D) అది input signal తో పూర్తిగా correlated గా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: When analyzing a digital filtering system using the additive noise model, what is a key assumption about the quantization error? A) It behaves like white noise with a flat power spectral density. B) It increases linearly as the bit rate increases. C) It is only present in mid-riser quantizers. D) It is perfectly correlated with the input signal. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a foreign key in a relational database? A) To ensure that each tuple in a relation has a unique identifier. B) To establish a link between two tables by referencing a candidate key in another table. C) To define the physical storage structure of a database. D) To store default values for missing data in a table. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Relational database లో foreign key యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) ఒక relation లోని ప్రతి tuple కి unique identifier ఉండేలా చూడడం. B) మరో table లోని candidate key ని reference చేయడం ద్వారా రెండు tables మధ్య link ఏర్పరచడం. C) Database యొక్క physical storage structure ను నిర్వచించడం. D) Table లో లేని data కోసం default values ను store చేయడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a foreign key in a relational database? A) To ensure that each tuple in a relation has a unique identifier. B) To establish a link between two tables by referencing a candidate key in another table. C) To define the physical storage structure of a database. D) To store default values for missing data in a table. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of isolating a unit during the testing process? target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of isolating a unit during the testing process? input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes Byzantine failures from the failures assumed in basic Paxos? A) Byzantine failures are temporary, while crash failures are permanent. D) Byzantine failures are handled by a quorum of acceptors, while crash failures are not. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Basic Paxos లో ఊహించే failures నుండి Byzantine failures ని ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Byzantine failures తాత్కాలికమైనవి, crash failures శాశ్వతమైనవి. B) Byzantine failures లో ఏకపక్ష లేదా హానికరమైన ప్రవర్తన ఉంటుంది, basic Paxos crash failures ని ఊహిస్తుంది. C) Byzantine failures network ని మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి, crash failures processors ని ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. D) Byzantine failures acceptors quorum ద్వారా handle చేయబడతాయి, crash failures అలా కాదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What distinguishes Byzantine failures from the failures assumed in basic Paxos? A) Byzantine failures are temporary, while crash failures are permanent. B) Byzantine failures involve arbitrary or malicious behavior, whereas basic Paxos assumes crash failures. C) Byzantine failures only affect the network, while crash failures affect processors. input: to Telugu: Q: Why does sharing a common OS kernel among multiple containers introduce a specific security risk? A) It requires each container to have its own independent OS instance. B) Configuration files మరియు dependencies ను bundle చేసే సామర్థ్యాన్ని అది పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. C) Non-cloud environments పై containers నడవకుండా అది నిరోధిస్తుంది. D) OS లోని ఒక vulnerability ఆ host పై నడుస్తున్న అన్ని containers ను compromise చేయగలదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does sharing a common OS kernel among multiple containers introduce a specific security risk? A) It requires each container to have its own independent OS instance. B) It limits the ability to bundle configuration files and dependencies. C) It prevents containers from running on non-cloud environments. D) A vulnerability in the OS can compromise all containers running on that host. ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: What was the key insight that led David Patterson to start the Berkeley RISC project? A) That 32-bit formats were necessary B) That microcode was too complex and inefficient C) That IBM 801 was the best design D) That CISC architectures were too slow ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Big O notation used in computer science when analyzing algorithms? A) To determine the specific hardware requirements for running an algorithm. B) To describe how the run time or space requirements grow as input size increases. C) To calculate the exact number of CPU cycles an algorithm requires. D) To convert an algorithm into a power series approximation. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Algorithms ని analyze చేసేటప్పుడు computer science లో Big O notation ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) ఒక algorithm ని run చేయడానికి అవసరమైన నిర్దిష్ట hardware requirements ని నిర్ణయించడానికి. B) Input size పెరిగేకొద్దీ run time లేదా space requirements ఎలా పెరుగుతాయో వివరించడానికి. C) ఒక algorithm కి అవసరమైన కచ్చితమైన CPU cycles సంఖ్యను లెక్కించడానికి. D) ఒక algorithm ని power series approximation గా మార్చడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Big O notation used in computer science when analyzing algorithms? A) To determine the specific hardware requirements for running an algorithm. B) To describe how the run time or space requirements grow as input size increases. C) To calculate the exact number of CPU cycles an algorithm requires. D) To convert an algorithm into a power series approximation. ANSWER: B

A) ఎందుకంటే theorem ఒకే subproblem ఉన్న algorithms కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే theorem యొక్క parameters fixed సంఖ్యలో subproblems ని ఊహిస్తాయి C) ఎందుకంటే combination time negative అవుతుంది D) ఎందుకంటే recurrence relation solve చేయడానికి చాలా సంక్లిష్టంగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the master theorem fail for recurrences where the number of subproblems is not constant? input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does the integral ∮ f(z) dz along a simple closed curve C evaluate strictly to zero according to Cauchy's integral theorem? A) f(z) is holomorphic on and inside the region bounded by C B) The contour C is symmetric about the imaginary axis C) f(z) is a real-valued function along the real axis D) f(z) has only simple poles inside C whose residues sum to zero ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Cauchy's integral theorem ప్రకారం ఏ పరిస్థితిలో simple closed curve C వెంబడి integral ∮ f(z) dz ఖచ్చితంగా zero అవుతుంది? A) C తో bounded అయిన region పై మరియు లోపల f(z) holomorphic గా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) Contour C imaginary axis గురించి symmetric గా ఉన్నప్పుడు C) Real axis వెంబడి f(z) ఒక real-valued function అయినప్పుడు D) C లోపల f(z) కి simple poles మాత్రమే ఉండి వాటి residues sum zero అయినప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under what condition does the integral ∮ f(z) dz along a simple closed curve C evaluate strictly to zero according to Cauchy's integral theorem? A) f(z) is holomorphic on and inside the region bounded by C B) The contour C is symmetric about the imaginary axis C) f(z) is a real-valued function along the real axis D) f(z) has only simple poles inside C whose residues sum to zero ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following statements accurately describes the relationship between regular expressions and finite automata? B) Regular expressions can be converted into equivalent minimal finite state machines for equivalence checking. C) Finite automata can only process literal characters and not metacharacters. D) Regular expressions are strictly more powerful than any finite automaton. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Regular expressions మరియు finite automata మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని కింది statements లో ఏది ఖచ్చితంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Regular expressions context-free languages ను వివరిస్తాయి, automata regular languages ను వివరిస్తాయి. B) Equivalence checking కోసం regular expressions ను సమానమైన minimal finite state machines గా మార్చవచ్చు. C) Finite automata literal characters ను మాత్రమే process చేయగలవు, metacharacters ను కాదు. D) Regular expressions ఏ finite automaton కంటే అయినా ఖచ్చితంగా ఎక్కువ శక్తివంతమైనవి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following statements accurately describes the relationship between regular expressions and finite automata? A) Regular expressions describe context-free languages, whereas automata describe regular languages. B) Regular expressions can be converted into equivalent minimal finite state machines for equivalence checking. C) Finite automata can only process literal characters and not metacharacters. D) Regular expressions are strictly more powerful than any finite automaton. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is cross-validation generally preferred over a single holdout method for assessing model performance? A) It uses all data points for both training and validation across iterations, providing a more stable estimate. B) It requires less computational power than a single holdout split. C) It completely eliminates the possibility of overfitting during model training. D) It only requires a single split of the data into training and test sets. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Model performance ను అంచనా వేయడానికి single holdout method కంటే cross-validation ను సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) Iterations అంతటా అన్ని data points ను training మరియు validation రెండింటికీ వాడి, అది మరింత స్థిరమైన అంచనాను ఇస్తుంది. B) దానికి single holdout split కంటే తక్కువ computational power అవసరం. C) Model training సమయంలో overfitting అవకాశాన్ని అది పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. D) దానికి data ను training మరియు test sets గా ఒక్కసారి split చేస్తే సరిపోతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is cross-validation generally preferred over a single holdout method for assessing model performance? A) It uses all data points for both training and validation across iterations, providing a more stable estimate. B) It requires less computational power than a single holdout split. C) It completely eliminates the possibility of overfitting during model training. D) It only requires a single split of the data into training and test sets. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a periodic function is purely real and even, how do its Fourier coefficients behave in standard trigonometric form? A) The fundamental frequency doubles and the constant term vanishes B) All sine coefficients (b_n) vanish, leaving only cosine terms and the constant term C) All cosine coefficients (a_n) vanish, leaving only odd harmonics of sine D) The complex exponential coefficients become purely imaginary ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక periodic function పూర్తిగా real మరియు even అయితే, standard trigonometric form లో దాని Fourier coefficients ఎలా ప్రవర్తిస్తాయి? A) Fundamental frequency రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది, constant term అదృశ్యమవుతుంది B) అన్ని sine coefficients (b_n) అదృశ్యమవుతాయి, cosine terms మరియు constant term మాత్రమే మిగులుతాయి C) అన్ని cosine coefficients (a_n) అదృశ్యమవుతాయి, sine యొక్క odd harmonics మాత్రమే మిగులుతాయి D) Complex exponential coefficients పూర్తిగా imaginary అవుతాయి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a periodic function is purely real and even, how do its Fourier coefficients behave in standard trigonometric form? A) The fundamental frequency doubles and the constant term vanishes B) All sine coefficients (b_n) vanish, leaving only cosine terms and the constant term C) All cosine coefficients (a_n) vanish, leaving only odd harmonics of sine D) The complex exponential coefficients become purely imaginary ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to a superconductor maintained below its critical temperature when an external magnetic field exceeds its critical magnetic field? A) It undergoes complete mechanical disintegration due to magnetic pressure. B) It abruptly transitions back into the normal resistive conducting state. C) It creates an infinite internal electric current to resist the field. D) Its critical temperature permanently shifts above room temperature. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: తన critical temperature కంటే తక్కువలో ఉంచిన superconductor పై external magnetic field దాని critical magnetic field ని మించినప్పుడు దానికి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Magnetic pressure వల్ల అది పూర్తిగా mechanical గా విచ్ఛిన్నమవుతుంది. B) అది అకస్మాత్తుగా తిరిగి normal resistive conducting state కి మారుతుంది. C) Field ని ప్రతిఘటించడానికి అది infinite internal electric current ని సృష్టిస్తుంది. D) దాని critical temperature శాశ్వతంగా room temperature కంటే పైకి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to a superconductor maintained below its critical temperature when an external magnetic field exceeds its critical magnetic field? A) It undergoes complete mechanical disintegration due to magnetic pressure. B) It abruptly transitions back into the normal resistive conducting state. C) It creates an infinite internal electric current to resist the field. D) Its critical temperature permanently shifts above room temperature. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What is the main purpose of an iteration in agile development? A) To write comprehensive documentation for the entire project. input: to Telugu: Q: How do Byzantine failures fundamentally differ from crash failures? A) Byzantine failures involve arbitrary behavior, such as sending conflicting data, rather than just stopping. target: ప్రశ్న: Byzantine failures crash failures నుండి మౌలికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటాయి? A) Byzantine failures లో కేవలం ఆగిపోవడం కాకుండా, విరుద్ధమైన data పంపడం వంటి ఏకపక్ష ప్రవర్తన ఉంటుంది. B) Crash failures ను tolerate చేయడం అసాధ్యం, Byzantine failures సులభంగా పరిష్కరించబడతాయి. C) Byzantine failures shared memory models లో మాత్రమే జరుగుతాయి. D) Byzantine failures network latency వల్ల మాత్రమే వస్తాయి, crashes hardware వల్ల వస్తాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How do Byzantine failures fundamentally differ from crash failures? A) Byzantine failures involve arbitrary behavior, such as sending conflicting data, rather than just stopping. B) Crash failures are impossible to tolerate, while Byzantine failures are easily solved. C) Byzantine failures only occur in shared memory models. D) Byzantine failures are caused only by network latency, whereas crashes are caused by hardware. ANSWER: A

D) Exploding gradients, ఇందులో updates అతిగా పెద్దవి అవుతాయి. జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is alternating current (AC) generally preferred over direct current (DC) for long-distance electrical power transmission? A) AC is the only form of electricity that can be generated by waterwheels. B) AC voltage can be easily stepped up and down using transformers to reduce line losses. C) AC requires fewer conductors than DC for the same power transfer. D) AC is inherently safer than DC at all voltage levels. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: దూర ప్రాంతాలకు electrical power transmission కోసం direct current (DC) కంటే alternating current (AC) ని సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) Waterwheels ద్వారా generate చేయగల electricity రూపం AC మాత్రమే. B) Line losses తగ్గించడానికి transformers ఉపయోగించి AC voltage ని సులభంగా step up మరియు step down చేయవచ్చు. C) అదే power transfer కోసం DC కంటే AC కి తక్కువ conductors అవసరం. D) అన్ని voltage levels లో AC సహజంగానే DC కంటే సురక్షితం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is alternating current (AC) generally preferred over direct current (DC) for long-distance electrical power transmission? A) AC is the only form of electricity that can be generated by waterwheels. B) AC voltage can be easily stepped up and down using transformers to reduce line losses. C) AC requires fewer conductors than DC for the same power transfer. D) AC is inherently safer than DC at all voltage levels. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of silicon-gate MOS technology over earlier metal-gate MOS? A) It allows for the integration of analog components on the same chip. B) Transistor structure లో insulating oxide layer అవసరాన్ని అది పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. C) Silicon gate electrode ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా అది ఎక్కువ transistor density మరియు మెరుగైన reliability ని సాధ్యం చేస్తుంది. D) Power efficiency మెరుగుపరచడానికి అది processor యొక్క word size ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of silicon-gate MOS technology over earlier metal-gate MOS? A) It allows for the integration of analog components on the same chip. B) It completely eliminates the need for an insulating oxide layer in the transistor structure. C) It enables higher transistor density and better reliability by using a silicon gate electrode. D) It reduces the word size of the processor to improve power efficiency. ANSWER: C

B) Current demand తగ్గి, transmission line losses తగ్గుతాయి. C) Reactive power పెరిగే కొద్దీ current demand zero కి పడిపోతుంది. D) Current demand పెరిగి, ఎక్కువ system line losses కి దారితీస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens to the current demand of an AC load if its power factor decreases while maintaining constant real power delivery? A) The current demand remains unchanged because real power is constant. B) The current demand decreases, reducing transmission line losses. target_en: Q: In the context of page replacement, how does the LRU algorithm decide which page to swap out? A) It selects the page that was first loaded into memory. D) It selects the page that has not been accessed for the longest period of time. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an applied external electric field decrease in magnitude inside a dielectric medium? A) Conduction electrons వచ్చే field energy ని వేగంగా absorb చేసి neutralize చేస్తాయి B) Free electrons సరిహద్దులకు వలస వెళ్ళి potential difference ని short చేస్తాయి C) Field కి గురైనప్పుడు material యొక్క relative permittivity సున్నాకు పడిపోతుంది D) స్థానభ్రంశం చెందిన charges external field ని వ్యతిరేకించే internal electric field ని సృష్టిస్తాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does an applied external electric field decrease in magnitude inside a dielectric medium? A) Conduction electrons rapidly absorb and neutralize the incident field energy B) Free electrons migrate to the boundaries, shorting out the potential difference C) The relative permittivity of the material drops to zero under field exposure D) Displaced charges create an internal electric field that opposes the external field ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for using an 'integer DCT' in modern video standards like HEVC? A) To increase the bit-depth of the original image beyond 16 bits. B) To ensure identical results across different hardware architectures by avoiding rounding errors. C) To automatically double the compression ratio compared to the standard DCT. D) To allow for floating-point arithmetic to be processed at infinite precision. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: HEVC వంటి ఆధునిక video standards లో 'integer DCT' ఉపయోగించడానికి ప్రధాన ప్రేరణ ఏమిటి? A) అసలు image యొక్క bit-depth ని 16 bits కంటే ఎక్కువకు పెంచడానికి. B) Rounding errors ని తప్పించడం ద్వారా వేర్వేరు hardware architectures లో ఒకే ఫలితాలు వచ్చేలా చూడటానికి. C) Standard DCT తో పోలిస్తే compression ratio ని automatic గా రెట్టింపు చేయడానికి. D) Floating-point arithmetic ని infinite precision తో process చేయడానికి అనుమతించడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for using an 'integer DCT' in modern video standards like HEVC? A) To increase the bit-depth of the original image beyond 16 bits. B) To ensure identical results across different hardware architectures by avoiding rounding errors. C) To automatically double the compression ratio compared to the standard DCT. D) To allow for floating-point arithmetic to be processed at infinite precision. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a primary advantage of Least Absolute Deviation (LAD) over Ordinary Least Squares (OLS)? A) LAD is less sensitive to outliers in the dataset. input: to Telugu: Q: Why are capacitor banks commonly added near large industrial electric motor loads? A) To supply local reactive power and compensate for the inductive motor load. B) Motor windings కోసం alternating current ను direct current గా మార్చడానికి. C) AC power supply యొక్క fundamental operating frequency ని పెంచడానికి. D) అదనపు real power ను గ్రహించి circuit overheating ను నివారించడానికి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why are capacitor banks commonly added near large industrial electric motor loads? A) To supply local reactive power and compensate for the inductive motor load. input: to Telugu: Q: According to the classical Drude model, how does an applied electric field generate a steady drift velocity? A) Thermal agitation alone drives electrons preferentially against the applied field vector. B) Continuous electrostatic acceleration is balanced by randomizing collisions with lattice ions. A) Thermal agitation ఒక్కటే electrons ను applied field vector కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ప్రాధాన్యంగా నడిపిస్తుంది. B) నిరంతర electrostatic acceleration ను lattice ions తో జరిగే randomizing collisions balance చేస్తాయి. C) Quantum tunneling వల్ల electrons kinetic energy కోల్పోకుండా ionic potentials ను దాటవేస్తాయి. D) Electrons collisions లేకుండా ఆదర్శ, ఘర్షణ లేని crystal lattice గుండా కదులుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to the classical Drude model, how does an applied electric field generate a steady drift velocity? A) Thermal agitation alone drives electrons preferentially against the applied field vector. B) Continuous electrostatic acceleration is balanced by randomizing collisions with lattice ions. C) Quantum tunneling allows electrons to bypass ionic potentials without kinetic energy loss. D) Electrons move without collisions through an ideal, frictionless crystal lattice. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is logistic regression preferred over linear regression for predicting a binary outcome like pass/fail? A) Because it models the log-odds of the outcome as a linear combination of predictors. B) Because it uses the logistic function which is computationally faster. C) Because it can handle both categorical and continuous independent variables. D) Because it ensures predicted probabilities are always between 0 and 1. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Pass/fail వంటి binary outcome ను predict చేయడానికి linear regression కంటే logistic regression ను ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది outcome యొక్క log-odds ను predictors యొక్క linear combination గా model చేస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే అది computationally వేగవంతమైన logistic function ను వాడుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే అది categorical మరియు continuous independent variables రెండింటినీ handle చేయగలదు. D) ఎందుకంటే predicted probabilities ఎప్పుడూ 0 మరియు 1 మధ్య ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is logistic regression preferred over linear regression for predicting a binary outcome like pass/fail? A) Because it models the log-odds of the outcome as a linear combination of predictors. B) Because it uses the logistic function which is computationally faster. C) Because it can handle both categorical and continuous independent variables. D) Because it ensures predicted probabilities are always between 0 and 1. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a commutator essential for a traditional brushed DC motor? A) It increases the input voltage to produce higher starting torque B) It replaces the need for permanent magnets in the stator C) It converts AC to DC within the rotor to maintain unidirectional torque D) It acts as a sensor for the motor controller to detect rotor position ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: సాంప్రదాయ brushed DC motor కి commutator ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఎక్కువ starting torque ఉత్పత్తి చేయడానికి అది input voltage ని పెంచుతుంది B) అది stator లో permanent magnets అవసరాన్ని భర్తీ చేస్తుంది C) Unidirectional torque ని నిలుపుకోవడానికి అది rotor లోపల AC ని DC గా మారుస్తుంది D) Rotor position ని గుర్తించడానికి motor controller కి sensor గా పనిచేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is a commutator essential for a traditional brushed DC motor? A) It increases the input voltage to produce higher starting torque B) It replaces the need for permanent magnets in the stator C) It converts AC to DC within the rotor to maintain unidirectional torque D) It acts as a sensor for the motor controller to detect rotor position ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary benefit of co-location in an agile team? A) It enables face-to-face conversation, which is the most efficient way to convey information and establish team identity. B) It ensures that all team members use the exact same hardware and software tools. C) It guarantees that the project will be completed ahead of schedule. D) It reduces the need for any communication at all. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Agile team లో co-location యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది ముఖాముఖి సంభాషణను సాధ్యం చేస్తుంది, సమాచారాన్ని అందించడానికి మరియు team identity ని ఏర్పరచడానికి అదే అత్యంత సమర్థవంతమైన మార్గం. B) Team సభ్యులందరూ ఒకే hardware మరియు software tools ను వాడేలా అది చూస్తుంది. C) Project schedule కంటే ముందే పూర్తవుతుందని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) అది ఎలాంటి communication అవసరాన్నైనా తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary benefit of co-location in an agile team? A) It enables face-to-face conversation, which is the most efficient way to convey information and establish team identity. B) It ensures that all team members use the exact same hardware and software tools. C) It guarantees that the project will be completed ahead of schedule. D) It reduces the need for any communication at all. ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: What is the primary reason for implementing concurrency control in a database system?
