input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the hydraulic diameter used instead of the actual diameter for non-circular ducts? A) It is required by all international engineering codes. B) It provides a standardized characteristic length that allows equivalent Reynolds number calculations. C) It accounts for the material thickness of the duct walls. D) It is always smaller than the actual diameter for easier calculations. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Non-circular ducts కోసం అసలు diameter కి బదులు hydraulic diameter ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) అన్ని international engineering codes దాన్ని తప్పనిసరి చేస్తాయి. B) సమానమైన Reynolds number లెక్కింపులకు అనుమతించే ప్రామాణిక characteristic length ని అది అందిస్తుంది. C) Duct walls యొక్క material thickness ని అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకుంటుంది. D) సులభమైన లెక్కింపుల కోసం అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ అసలు diameter కంటే చిన్నదిగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the hydraulic diameter used instead of the actual diameter for non-circular ducts? A) It is required by all international engineering codes. B) It provides a standardized characteristic length that allows equivalent Reynolds number calculations. C) It accounts for the material thickness of the duct walls. D) It is always smaller than the actual diameter for easier calculations. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the transient response of an RLC circuit when its damping factor (ζ) is adjusted to exactly 1? target_en: Q: What happens to the transient response of an RLC circuit when its damping factor (ζ) is adjusted to exactly 1? target_en: Q: Why is PC-relative addressing preferred for conditional jumps in modern architectures? A) It is always faster than absolute addressing because it requires no registers. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the exploration-exploitation dilemma considered a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning? A) Because the agent must balance gathering new information about the environment with using current knowledge to maximize rewards. D) Because random action selection without reference to an estimated probability distribution shows poor performance. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Reinforcement learning లో exploration-exploitation dilemma ను మౌలిక సవాలుగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? B) ఎందుకంటే సాధ్యమైన policies సంఖ్య పెద్దదిగా లేదా infinite గా కూడా ఉండవచ్చు. C) ఎందుకంటే scaling algorithms లేనందున సరళమైన exploration methods అత్యంత ఆచరణాత్మకమైనవి. D) ఎందుకంటే అంచనా వేసిన probability distribution ను పట్టించుకోకుండా random action selection పేలవమైన performance ను చూపుతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the exploration-exploitation dilemma considered a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning? A) Because the agent must balance gathering new information about the environment with using current knowledge to maximize rewards. target_en: Q: Why does a boost converter step up voltage while stepping down current? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary physical outcome when an electron in the conduction band recombines with a hole in the valence band? C) An extra free electron is generated in the conduction band. D) The crystal lattice develops structural dislocations. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Conduction band లోని ఒక electron, valence band లోని hole తో recombine అయినప్పుడు ప్రధాన భౌతిక ఫలితం ఏమిటి? A) Semiconductor material యొక్క band gap energy శాశ్వతంగా పెరుగుతుంది. B) రెండు charge carriers నశించి, energy ని కాంతి లేదా వేడి రూపంలో విడుదల చేస్తాయి. C) Conduction band లో ఒక అదనపు free electron generate అవుతుంది. D) Crystal lattice లో structural dislocations ఏర్పడతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary physical outcome when an electron in the conduction band recombines with a hole in the valence band? A) The band gap energy of the semiconductor material increases permanently. B) Both charge carriers are annihilated, releasing energy as light or heat. C) An extra free electron is generated in the conduction band. D) The crystal lattice develops structural dislocations. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a coinductive data definition? A) To define data using a simple base case. B) To define operations on data of infinite size. C) To define data with a finite, fixed size. D) To define data that cannot be modified after creation. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a coinductive data definition? A) To define data using a simple base case. B) To define operations on data of infinite size. C) To define data with a finite, fixed size. D) To define data that cannot be modified after creation. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following conditions must be met for the standard Bernoulli equation to be valid? A) The flow must be viscous and rotational. B) The fluid must have a varying density along the streamline. C) The fluid must be compressible and experiencing heat transfer. D) The flow must be steady, incompressible, and inviscid. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard Bernoulli equation valid అవ్వడానికి కింది షరతుల్లో ఏది నెరవేరాలి? A) Flow viscous మరియు rotational గా ఉండాలి. B) Streamline వెంబడి fluid density మారుతూ ఉండాలి. C) Fluid compressible గా ఉండి heat transfer కి లోనవ్వాలి. D) Flow steady, incompressible మరియు inviscid గా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following conditions must be met for the standard Bernoulli equation to be valid? A) The flow must be viscous and rotational. B) The fluid must have a varying density along the streamline. C) The fluid must be compressible and experiencing heat transfer. D) The flow must be steady, incompressible, and inviscid. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does the continuum hypothesis typically fail, requiring a transition to statistical mechanics? A) When the velocity of the fluid is too low. B) When the fluid is highly incompressible. C) When the fluid flow is turbulent. D) When the characteristic length scale of the system is comparable to the molecular mean free path. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో continuum hypothesis సాధారణంగా విఫలమై, statistical mechanics కి మారవలసి వస్తుంది? A) Fluid velocity చాలా తక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు. B) Fluid అత్యంత incompressible గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. C) Fluid flow turbulent గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. D) System యొక్క characteristic length scale molecular mean free path తో పోల్చదగినదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition does the continuum hypothesis typically fail, requiring a transition to statistical mechanics? A) When the velocity of the fluid is too low. B) When the fluid is highly incompressible. C) When the fluid flow is turbulent. D) When the characteristic length scale of the system is comparable to the molecular mean free path. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does dynamic pressure change if the flow velocity of a fluid doubles while density remains constant? A) It quadruples. B) It doubles. C) It decreases by half. D) It remains the same. ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: How does dynamic pressure change if the flow velocity of a fluid doubles while density remains constant? A) It quadruples. B) It doubles. C) It decreases by half. D) It remains the same. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes an authoritative name server from a non-authoritative (caching) server? A) It only handles requests from other authoritative name servers. B) It is always located at the root of the DNS tree structure. C) It provides answers derived directly from the master configuration of the zone. D) It stores the entire database of all IP addresses on the Internet. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Authoritative name server ను non-authoritative (caching) server నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) అది ఇతర authoritative name servers నుండి వచ్చే requests ను మాత్రమే handle చేస్తుంది. B) అది ఎప్పుడూ DNS tree structure యొక్క root వద్ద ఉంటుంది. C) Zone యొక్క master configuration నుండి నేరుగా తీసుకున్న answers ను అది అందిస్తుంది. target_en: Q: What distinguishes an authoritative name server from a non-authoritative (caching) server? A) It only handles requests from other authoritative name servers. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is part-of-speech tagging more complex than simply matching words to a fixed list of categories? A) Because many words can function as different parts of speech depending on their grammatical context. B) Because computational systems cannot store large dictionaries of words and their parts of speech. C) Because algorithms are unable to process semantic information like word meanings. D) Because natural languages have fewer parts of speech than artificial languages. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Words ను fixed categories list తో కేవలం match చేయడం కంటే part-of-speech tagging ఎందుకు ఎక్కువ సంక్లిష్టమైనది? A) ఎందుకంటే చాలా words వాటి grammatical context ను బట్టి వేర్వేరు parts of speech గా పనిచేయగలవు. B) ఎందుకంటే computational systems words మరియు వాటి parts of speech ఉన్న పెద్ద dictionaries ను store చేయలేవు. C) ఎందుకంటే word meanings వంటి semantic information ను algorithms process చేయలేవు. D) ఎందుకంటే natural languages లో artificial languages కంటే తక్కువ parts of speech ఉంటాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is part-of-speech tagging more complex than simply matching words to a fixed list of categories? A) Because many words can function as different parts of speech depending on their grammatical context. B) Because computational systems cannot store large dictionaries of words and their parts of speech. C) Because algorithms are unable to process semantic information like word meanings. D) Because natural languages have fewer parts of speech than artificial languages. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason Lloyd's algorithm is considered efficient in practice despite the k-means problem being NP-hard? A) It uses the Forgy initialization method, which is always optimal. B) It avoids the NP-hard nature by only working on two-dimensional data. C) It guarantees finding the global optimum in polynomial time for all datasets. D) It converges to a local optimum very quickly, often in a small number of iterations. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: k-means problem NP-hard అయినప్పటికీ Lloyd's algorithm ఆచరణలో సమర్థవంతమైనదిగా పరిగణించబడటానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) ఇది ఎప్పుడూ optimal అయిన Forgy initialization method ను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) ఇది కేవలం two-dimensional data పై మాత్రమే పనిచేయడం ద్వారా NP-hard స్వభావాన్ని తప్పించుకుంటుంది. C) ఇది అన్ని datasets కు polynomial time లో global optimum ను కనుగొంటుందని హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) ఇది చాలా వేగంగా, తరచుగా కొన్ని iterations లోనే, ఒక local optimum కు converge అవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason Lloyd's algorithm is considered efficient in practice despite the k-means problem being NP-hard? A) It uses the Forgy initialization method, which is always optimal. B) It avoids the NP-hard nature by only working on two-dimensional data. C) It guarantees finding the global optimum in polynomial time for all datasets. D) It converges to a local optimum very quickly, often in a small number of iterations. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the brightness constancy constraint insufficient on its own to determine the complete optical flow vector at a pixel? A) It cannot account for changes in lighting conditions. B) It provides only one equation for two unknown velocity components. C) It calculates only the magnitude of motion, not the direction. D) It assumes the camera is stationary, which is rarely true. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక pixel వద్ద పూర్తి optical flow vector ని నిర్ణయించడానికి brightness constancy constraint ఒక్కటే ఎందుకు సరిపోదు? A) Lighting conditions లో మార్పులను అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోలేదు. B) రెండు తెలియని velocity components కి అది ఒకే ఒక equation ని ఇస్తుంది. C) అది motion యొక్క magnitude ని మాత్రమే లెక్కిస్తుంది, దిశను కాదు. D) Camera stationary గా ఉందని అది ఊహిస్తుంది, ఇది చాలా అరుదుగా నిజం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the brightness constancy constraint insufficient on its own to determine the complete optical flow vector at a pixel? A) It cannot account for changes in lighting conditions. B) It provides only one equation for two unknown velocity components. C) It calculates only the magnitude of motion, not the direction. D) It assumes the camera is stationary, which is rarely true. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: According to Babinet's principle, how does the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern of a thin wire compare to that of a slit of the same width? A) The wire produces no diffraction pattern at all B) The intensity distributions outside the direct beam are identical C) The slit produces twice as many diffraction fringes D) The wire produces completely inverted intensity peaks ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Babinet's principle ప్రకారం, ఒక సన్నని wire యొక్క Fraunhofer diffraction pattern అదే width ఉన్న slit దానితో ఎలా పోలుస్తుంది? A) Wire అసలు ఏ diffraction pattern నూ ఉత్పత్తి చేయదు B) Direct beam బయట intensity distributions ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి C) Slit రెట్టింపు diffraction fringes ని ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది D) Wire పూర్తిగా తలక్రిందులైన intensity peaks ని ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to Babinet's principle, how does the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern of a thin wire compare to that of a slit of the same width? A) The wire produces no diffraction pattern at all B) The intensity distributions outside the direct beam are identical C) The slit produces twice as many diffraction fringes D) The wire produces completely inverted intensity peaks ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does an asynchronous IPC mechanism differ from a synchronous one? A) Asynchronous IPC requires the sender to block until the receiver acknowledges. B) Asynchronous IPC cannot use synchronization primitives. C) Asynchronous IPC allows the sender to continue execution immediately after sending. D) Asynchronous IPC only works on microkernels. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Asynchronous IPC mechanism synchronous దాని నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Asynchronous IPC లో receiver acknowledge చేసే వరకు sender block అవ్వాలి. B) Asynchronous IPC synchronization primitives ను వాడలేదు. C) Asynchronous IPC లో పంపిన వెంటనే sender execution ను కొనసాగించవచ్చు. D) Asynchronous IPC microkernels పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does an asynchronous IPC mechanism differ from a synchronous one? A) Asynchronous IPC requires the sender to block until the receiver acknowledges. B) Asynchronous IPC cannot use synchronization primitives. C) Asynchronous IPC allows the sender to continue execution immediately after sending. D) Asynchronous IPC only works on microkernels. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: What is the primary effect of adding a lag compensator to a control system? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of a bounding function in a branch-and-bound algorithm? A) To provide an estimate that allows the algorithm to prune suboptimal branches. D) To determine the branching rule for partitioning the search space. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Branch-and-bound algorithm లో bounding function యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Suboptimal branches ను algorithm prune చేయడానికి వీలు కల్పించే అంచనాను అందించడం. B) Heuristic solutions తో queue ను initialize చేయడం. C) ఒక candidate solution కి objective function యొక్క ఖచ్చితమైన value ను compute చేయడం. D) Search space ను విభజించడానికి branching rule ను నిర్ణయించడం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of a bounding function in a branch-and-bound algorithm? A) To provide an estimate that allows the algorithm to prune suboptimal branches. B) To initialize the queue with heuristic solutions. C) To compute the exact value of the objective function for a candidate solution. D) To determine the branching rule for partitioning the search space. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the Hough transform, how does maximum likelihood estimation handle partially occluded shapes? A) By increasing the threshold for local maxima. B) By requiring all pixels on the shape to be detected. C) By using a uniform prior on the shape space. D) By ignoring negative evidence and only considering positive evidence. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hough transform లో maximum likelihood estimation పాక్షికంగా కప్పబడిన (occluded) shapes ని ఎలా handle చేస్తుంది? A) Local maxima కోసం threshold ని పెంచడం ద్వారా. B) Shape పై ఉన్న అన్ని pixels గుర్తించబడాలని కోరడం ద్వారా. C) Shape space పై uniform prior ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా. D) Negative evidence ని పట్టించుకోకుండా positive evidence ని మాత్రమే పరిగణించడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the Hough transform, how does maximum likelihood estimation handle partially occluded shapes? A) By increasing the threshold for local maxima. B) By requiring all pixels on the shape to be detected. C) By using a uniform prior on the shape space. D) By ignoring negative evidence and only considering positive evidence. ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: Why is a disjoint-set data structure used during the execution of Kruskal's algorithm? D) Neural networks ని train చేసే computational cost ని తగ్గించడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for developing multi-sense embeddings? A) To ensure that all words in a dictionary are represented by a single vector. target_en: Q: Under which condition does Cramer's rule fail to provide a unique solution for a linear system Ax = b? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a monitor in the context of the producer-consumer problem? A) To define the structure of the buffer without handling any synchronization logic. B) To implement busy waiting as an alternative to semaphores for synchronization. C) To encapsulate shared data and synchronize access to it through condition variables. D) To allow multiple threads to modify the buffer simultaneously without any synchronization. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Producer-consumer problem సందర్భంలో monitor యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) ఎలాంటి synchronization logic ని handle చేయకుండా buffer యొక్క structure ని నిర్వచించడం. B) Synchronization కోసం semaphores కి ప్రత్యామ్నాయంగా busy waiting ని implement చేయడం. C) Shared data ని encapsulate చేసి, condition variables ద్వారా దానికి access ని synchronize చేయడం. D) ఎలాంటి synchronization లేకుండా అనేక threads ఒకేసారి buffer ని modify చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a monitor in the context of the producer-consumer problem? A) To define the structure of the buffer without handling any synchronization logic. B) To implement busy waiting as an alternative to semaphores for synchronization. C) To encapsulate shared data and synchronize access to it through condition variables. D) To allow multiple threads to modify the buffer simultaneously without any synchronization. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary operational difference between symmetric-key and asymmetric-key encryption regarding key management? A) Symmetric-key is always faster but less secure than asymmetric-key methods. B) Asymmetric-key encryption does not require a secret key at all. C) Symmetric-key encryption is solely used for authentication, not for data privacy. D) Symmetric-key uses one key for both, while asymmetric-key uses a distinct key pair. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Key management విషయంలో symmetric-key మరియు asymmetric-key encryption మధ్య ప్రధాన operational తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Symmetric-key ఎప్పుడూ asymmetric-key methods కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటుంది కానీ తక్కువ secure. B) Asymmetric-key encryption కి secret key అసలు అవసరం లేదు. C) Symmetric-key encryption ను authentication కోసం మాత్రమే వాడతారు, data privacy కోసం కాదు. D) Symmetric-key రెండింటికీ ఒకే key ను వాడుతుంది, asymmetric-key వేరే key pair ను వాడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary operational difference between symmetric-key and asymmetric-key encryption regarding key management? A) Symmetric-key is always faster but less secure than asymmetric-key methods. B) Asymmetric-key encryption does not require a secret key at all. C) Symmetric-key encryption is solely used for authentication, not for data privacy. D) Symmetric-key uses one key for both, while asymmetric-key uses a distinct key pair. ANSWER: D

D) Hash function variable-length outputs ని ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary risk if a hash function lacks collision resistance? A) An attacker could easily derive the secret key. D) The hash function would produce variable-length outputs. ANSWER: B

B) To minimize the energy of the system to achieve a stable activation pattern. C) To maximize the energy to increase the network's processing speed. D) To ignore the energy state as it is irrelevant to neural network performance. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes the appropriate use of a parameterized test? A) When you are refactoring legacy production code B) When you need to run the same validation logic against multiple input datasets C) When the test code needs to access private methods using reflection D) When you want to perform system-level integration of modules ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Parameterized test యొక్క సరైన ఉపయోగాన్ని ఏ సందర్భం ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Legacy production code ని refactor చేస్తున్నప్పుడు B) ఒకే validation logic ని అనేక input datasets పై run చేయాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు C) Test code reflection ఉపయోగించి private methods ని access చేయాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు D) Modules యొక్క system-level integration చేయాలనుకున్నప్పుడు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes the appropriate use of a parameterized test? A) When you are refactoring legacy production code B) When you need to run the same validation logic against multiple input datasets C) When the test code needs to access private methods using reflection D) When you want to perform system-level integration of modules ANSWER: B

B) Conductor గుండా వెళ్లే current applied voltage పై పూర్తిగా ఆధారపడదు. C) Applied voltage మారుతున్నప్పుడు voltage కి current కి ఉన్న ratio స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. D) High fields వద్ద electric field strength తో current nonlinear గా పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Under what condition is a conductor strictly considered to obey Ohm's law? A) The material exhibits zero internal resistance across all operating temperatures. B) The current through the conductor remains entirely independent of the applied voltage. C) The ratio of voltage to current remains constant as the applied voltage varies. D) The current increases nonlinearly with electric field strength under high fields. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If the total variance of a dataset is constant, what does minimizing the Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) imply about the Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS)? A) BCSS remains unchanged as it is independent of WCSS. B) BCSS must increase because the two components are inversely related. C) BCSS must also decrease to maintain the constant total variance. D) BCSS becomes zero, indicating all clusters are identical. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Dataset యొక్క total variance స్థిరంగా ఉంటే, Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) ని minimize చేయడం Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS) గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) BCSS, WCSS పై ఆధారపడనందున మారకుండా ఉంటుంది. B) రెండు components విలోమ సంబంధం కలిగి ఉన్నందున BCSS తప్పనిసరిగా పెరుగుతుంది. C) Total variance స్థిరంగా ఉండటానికి BCSS కూడా తగ్గాలి. D) BCSS సున్నా అవుతుంది, అంటే అన్ని clusters ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If the total variance of a dataset is constant, what does minimizing the Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) imply about the Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS)? A) BCSS remains unchanged as it is independent of WCSS. B) BCSS must increase because the two components are inversely related. C) BCSS must also decrease to maintain the constant total variance. D) BCSS becomes zero, indicating all clusters are identical. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What is the relationship between a DFA and an NFA? A) A DFA is a special case of an NFA where each transition is unique. B) DFAs and NFAs are completely unrelated models. B) Autocorrelation ఎల్లప్పుడూ variance కి సమానం. C) అన్ని time lags కి autocorrelation constant గా ఉండాలి. D) Autocorrelation samples మధ్య time lag పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D

D) Multi-level transactions system architecture యొక్క వేర్వేరు layers అంతటా స్పష్టంగా పనిచేస్తాయి. జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the choice of search algorithm often dependent on the data structure being searched? target: ప్రశ్న: Search algorithm ఎంపిక తరచుగా search చేస్తున్న data structure పై ఎందుకు ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే data structures కేవలం memory usage ను మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి, speed ను కాదు B) ఎందుకంటే structure ఏదైనా search problem ఎప్పుడూ ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే data structure యొక్క అమరిక ఒక algorithm elements ను ఎంత సమర్థవంతంగా access చేయగలదో నిర్ణయిస్తుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అన్ని algorithms ఏ data structure పైనైనా ఒకేలా పనిచేస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the choice of search algorithm often dependent on the data structure being searched? A) Because data structures only affect memory usage, not speed B) Because the search problem is always the same regardless of structure C) Because the data structure's organization determines how efficiently an algorithm can access elements D) Because all algorithms perform identically on any data structure ANSWER: C

B) అనేక వేర్వేరు input values ఒకే discrete output value కి map అవుతాయి. C) అది analog-to-digital converters లో మాత్రమే జరుగుతుంది. D) అది infinite precision arithmetic ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is symmetric-key cryptography considered less practical for secure communication over public networks compared to asymmetric systems? A) Symmetric algorithms are always slower than public-key algorithms. B) Symmetric keys are too short to provide adequate security. C) The same key must be securely shared between all communicating parties beforehand. D) Symmetric ciphers cannot encrypt large blocks of data efficiently. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Asymmetric systems తో పోలిస్తే public networks పై secure communication కి symmetric-key cryptography ఎందుకు తక్కువ practical గా పరిగణించబడుతుంది? A) Symmetric algorithms ఎల్లప్పుడూ public-key algorithms కంటే నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటాయి. B) తగిన security ఇవ్వడానికి symmetric keys చాలా చిన్నవి. C) Communicate చేసే అన్ని parties మధ్య ఒకే key ని ముందుగానే సురక్షితంగా share చేయాలి. D) Symmetric ciphers పెద్ద data blocks ని సమర్థవంతంగా encrypt చేయలేవు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is symmetric-key cryptography considered less practical for secure communication over public networks compared to asymmetric systems? A) Symmetric algorithms are always slower than public-key algorithms. B) Symmetric keys are too short to provide adequate security. C) The same key must be securely shared between all communicating parties beforehand. D) Symmetric ciphers cannot encrypt large blocks of data efficiently. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of the priority queue in the A* algorithm implementation? A) ప్రతి node కి heuristic value ను లెక్కించడం B) ఇప్పటికే సందర్శించిన nodes ను ఉంచడం C) Start నుండి goal వరకు final path ను store చేయడం D) Expansion కోసం minimum f-cost ఉన్న తదుపరి node ను సమర్థవంతంగా ఎంచుకోవడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of the priority queue in the A* algorithm implementation? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for studying the formal definition of regular expressions using constants and operators? A) To enable the use of non-standard operators like the complement operator by default. B) To prove that all regular expressions are actually context-free languages. A) Complement operator వంటి non-standard operators ని default గా ఉపయోగించడానికి. B) అన్ని regular expressions నిజానికి context-free languages అని నిరూపించడానికి. C) Regular languages class ని కచ్చితంగా నిర్వచించే ప్రామాణిక, కనీస framework ని అందించడానికి. D) Regex engines literal characters ని పూర్తిగా పట్టించుకోకుండా చూడటానికి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for studying the formal definition of regular expressions using constants and operators? A) To enable the use of non-standard operators like the complement operator by default. B) To prove that all regular expressions are actually context-free languages. input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does total internal reflection occur at the core-cladding boundary of an optical fiber? A) Cladding యొక్క refractive index, core కంటే కచ్చితంగా ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) కాంతి ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే తక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు C) కాంతి తక్కువ నుండి ఎక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే ఎక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు D) కాంతి ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే ఎక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition does total internal reflection occur at the core-cladding boundary of an optical fiber? A) The refractive index of the cladding is strictly greater than that of the core B) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle less than the critical angle C) Light travels from lower to higher refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle D) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a RISC architecture, how is the sequencing of hardware operations typically managed compared to microcoded systems? A) Flexibility కోసం అన్ని instructions ని SRAM లో store చేయడం ద్వారా B) ప్రతి instruction కి సంక్లిష్టమైన microcode engine ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా C) Instruction sequencing కోసం player piano mechanism ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా D) Direct hardware control లేదా compiler scheduling ద్వారా, microcode పై ఆధారపడటాన్ని తగ్గిస్తూ జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In a RISC architecture, how is the sequencing of hardware operations typically managed compared to microcoded systems? A) By storing all instructions in SRAM for flexibility B) By using a complex microcode engine for every instruction C) By using a player piano mechanism for instruction sequencing D) Through direct hardware control or compiler scheduling, minimizing microcode reliance ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FFT considered more 'practical' than the naïve DFT calculation for large datasets? A) It eliminates the need for complex numbers entirely. B) Real numbers ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించి DFT ని compute చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. C) అది arithmetic complexity ని O(n²) నుండి O(n log n) కి తగ్గిస్తుంది. D) అది transformation యొక్క output values ని మారుస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the FFT considered more 'practical' than the naïve DFT calculation for large datasets? A) It eliminates the need for complex numbers entirely. A) వాటికి ఎక్కువ fanout ఉంటుంది, దాంతో తక్కువ I/O operations అవసరమవుతాయి B) Databases లో binary trees ను వాడరు C) వేగవంతమైన access కోసం అవి data ను internal nodes లో store చేస్తాయి D) వాటికి pointers కోసం తక్కువ memory అవసరం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why do B+ trees generally outperform Binary Search Trees in disk-based storage systems? A) They have a higher fanout, leading to fewer I/O operations B) Binary trees are not used in databases C) They store data in internal nodes for faster access D) They require less memory for pointers ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a reverse-biased p–n junction conduct only an extremely small current before breakdown? A) Electrons and holes are converted into photons before crossing the junction. B) The broadened potential barrier blocks majority carriers, allowing only thermally generated minority carriers to cross. C) Majority carriers cancel each other out completely in the external connecting leads. D) The applied electric field neutralizes all donor and acceptor dopants inside the crystal. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Reverse-biased p–n junction breakdown కి ముందు చాలా తక్కువ current ని మాత్రమే ఎందుకు conduct చేస్తుంది? A) Junction ని దాటే ముందు electrons మరియు holes photons గా మారతాయి. B) విస్తరించిన potential barrier majority carriers ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది, thermal గా generate అయిన minority carriers మాత్రమే దాటగలవు. C) External connecting leads లో majority carriers ఒకదానినొకటి పూర్తిగా రద్దు చేసుకుంటాయి. D) Applied electric field crystal లోని అన్ని donor మరియు acceptor dopants ని neutralize చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a reverse-biased p–n junction conduct only an extremely small current before breakdown? A) Electrons and holes are converted into photons before crossing the junction. B) The broadened potential barrier blocks majority carriers, allowing only thermally generated minority carriers to cross. C) Majority carriers cancel each other out completely in the external connecting leads. D) The applied electric field neutralizes all donor and acceptor dopants inside the crystal. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does using an FIR filter in an interpolation application improve computational efficiency? A) Expansion సమయంలో చేర్చిన zero-valued samples ని dot product లెక్కింపులలో skip చేయవచ్చు B) FIR filters expansion అవసరం లేకుండా sampling rate ని automatic గా పెంచుతాయి C) Feedback loops వల్ల FIR filters సహజంగానే IIR filters కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయి D) FIR filters చేర్చిన zero values పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does using an FIR filter in an interpolation application improve computational efficiency? A) Zero-valued samples introduced during expansion can be skipped in dot product calculations B) FIR filters automatically increase the sampling rate without needing expansion C) FIR filters are inherently faster than IIR filters due to their feedback loops D) FIR filters operate only on the inserted zero values ANSWER: A

A) Computation time తగ్గించడానికి అన్ని weak learners ను parallel గా train చేయడం ద్వారా. B) మునుపటి వాటి errors ను సరిదిద్దడంపై దృష్టి పెట్టేలా కొత్త weak learners ను వరుసగా train చేయడం ద్వారా. C) ప్రతి weak learner కి training data ను స్వతంత్రంగా random గా sample చేయడం ద్వారా. D) అనేక సరళమైన వాటి బదులు ఒకే అత్యంత సంక్లిష్టమైన weak learner ను వాడడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a boosting algorithm primarily improve the overall accuracy of its final strong learner? A) By training all weak learners in parallel to reduce computation time. B) By sequentially training new weak learners to focus on correcting the errors of previous ones. C) By randomly sampling training data for each weak learner independently. D) By using a single highly complex weak learner instead of multiple simple ones. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What allows Gaussian quadrature to integrate higher-degree polynomials exactly compared to Newton-Cotes formulas using the same number of points? A) It restricts evaluation exclusively to uniformly spaced points B) It avoids evaluating the integrand anywhere within the interior of the domain C) Both the evaluation nodes and their weights are treated as free variables to be optimized D) It uses symbolic differentiation instead of function evaluations ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: అదే సంఖ్యలో points ను వాడే Newton-Cotes formulas తో పోలిస్తే Gaussian quadrature ఎక్కువ degree ఉన్న polynomials ను ఖచ్చితంగా integrate చేయడానికి ఏది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది? A) అది evaluation ను సమాన దూరంలో ఉన్న points కి మాత్రమే పరిమితం చేస్తుంది B) Domain లోపల ఎక్కడా integrand ను evaluate చేయకుండా అది నివారిస్తుంది C) Evaluation nodes మరియు వాటి weights రెండింటినీ optimize చేయవలసిన free variables గా పరిగణిస్తారు D) అది function evaluations బదులు symbolic differentiation ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What allows Gaussian quadrature to integrate higher-degree polynomials exactly compared to Newton-Cotes formulas using the same number of points? A) It restricts evaluation exclusively to uniformly spaced points B) It avoids evaluating the integrand anywhere within the interior of the domain C) Both the evaluation nodes and their weights are treated as free variables to be optimized D) It uses symbolic differentiation instead of function evaluations ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a cache miss significantly impact processor performance? A) It forces the CPU to switch to a different operating system. B) It leads to the permanent deletion of data from the cache. C) It increases the clock speed of the CPU uncontrollably. D) It causes the CPU to stall while waiting for data from slower main memory. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Cache miss processor performance ను ఎందుకు గణనీయంగా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది CPU ను వేరే operating system కి మారేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. B) అది cache నుండి data శాశ్వతంగా delete అవ్వడానికి దారితీస్తుంది. C) అది CPU clock speed ను అదుపు లేకుండా పెంచుతుంది. D) నెమ్మదైన main memory నుండి data కోసం ఎదురుచూస్తూ CPU stall అయ్యేలా అది చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does a cache miss significantly impact processor performance? A) It forces the CPU to switch to a different operating system. B) It leads to the permanent deletion of data from the cache. C) It increases the clock speed of the CPU uncontrollably. D) It causes the CPU to stall while waiting for data from slower main memory. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the strong law of large numbers imply about the sample mean of independent and identically distributed random variables? A) Every possible discrete outcome must occur an equal number of times in the long run B) The sample average converges almost surely to the true expected value as the sample size grows infinitely C) The variance of individual observations decreases to zero as more trials are conducted D) The expected value changes progressively until it matches the observed sample mean ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Independent and identically distributed random variables యొక్క sample mean గురించి strong law of large numbers ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) దీర్ఘకాలంలో సాధ్యమైన ప్రతి discrete outcome సమాన సంఖ్యలో జరగాలి B) Sample size అనంతంగా పెరిగే కొద్దీ sample average almost surely నిజమైన expected value కి converge అవుతుంది C) ఎక్కువ trials చేసే కొద్దీ individual observations యొక్క variance zero కి తగ్గుతుంది D) Observed sample mean కి సరిపోయే వరకు expected value క్రమంగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What does the strong law of large numbers imply about the sample mean of independent and identically distributed random variables? A) Every possible discrete outcome must occur an equal number of times in the long run B) The sample average converges almost surely to the true expected value as the sample size grows infinitely C) The variance of individual observations decreases to zero as more trials are conducted D) The expected value changes progressively until it matches the observed sample mean ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which characteristic distinguishes a reversible process from an irreversible one? A) It always produces net positive work output. D) అది ఎలాంటి dissipative losses లేకుండా అనంతంగా నెమ్మదిగా జరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which characteristic distinguishes a reversible process from an irreversible one? A) It always produces net positive work output. B) It involves heat transfer from a cold to a hot reservoir. C) It results in a net decrease of total entropy. D) It occurs infinitely slowly without any dissipative losses. ANSWER: D

D) Cortex లోని pyramidal neurons యొక్క postsynaptic potentials. జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an intrinsic semiconductor behave like an insulator at absolute zero temperature (0 K)? A) Charge carriers recombine instantly before any electric current can be established. B) The band gap expands to infinity at extremely low temperatures. C) The thermal motion of atoms blocks the passage of current through the lattice. D) All electrons are completely localized within the valence band, leaving the conduction band entirely empty. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Absolute zero temperature (0 K) వద్ద intrinsic semiconductor ఎందుకు insulator లా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది? A) ఏ electric current ఏర్పడక ముందే charge carriers వెంటనే recombine అవుతాయి. B) చాలా తక్కువ temperatures వద్ద band gap అనంతంగా పెరుగుతుంది. C) Atoms యొక్క thermal motion lattice గుండా current ప్రవాహాన్ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది. D) అన్ని electrons పూర్తిగా valence band లోనే localize అయి ఉంటాయి, conduction band పూర్తిగా ఖాళీగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does an intrinsic semiconductor behave like an insulator at absolute zero temperature (0 K)? A) Charge carriers recombine instantly before any electric current can be established. B) The band gap expands to infinity at extremely low temperatures. C) The thermal motion of atoms blocks the passage of current through the lattice. D) All electrons are completely localized within the valence band, leaving the conduction band entirely empty. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How are status output signals from an ALU typically used? A) To convert the ALU's integer output into a floating-point number. D) To reset the external circuitry and prepare the ALU for a new clock cycle. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ALU నుండి వచ్చే status output signals సాధారణంగా ఎలా ఉపయోగించబడతాయి? A) ALU యొక్క integer output ని floating-point number గా మార్చడానికి. B) Conditional branching ని నియంత్రించడానికి మరియు భవిష్యత్ ALU operations కి సమాచారాన్ని అందుబాటులో ఉంచడానికి. C) Multi-precision arithmetic కోసం ALU యొక్క word size ని పెంచడానికి. D) External circuitry ని reset చేసి కొత్త clock cycle కి ALU ని సిద్ధం చేయడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How are status output signals from an ALU typically used? A) To convert the ALU's integer output into a floating-point number. B) To control conditional branching and to make information available for future ALU operations. C) To increase the word size of the ALU for multi-precision arithmetic. D) To reset the external circuitry and prepare the ALU for a new clock cycle. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the root locus method primarily used for analyzing feedback control systems? A) ఖచ్చితమైన transfer function coefficients ను లెక్కించడానికి B) మారుతున్న gain parameter తో system stability ఎలా మారుతుందో graphically నిర్ణయించడానికి C) ఇచ్చిన input కి steady-state error ను కనుగొనడానికి D) System ను time domain నుండి frequency domain కి మార్చడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the root locus method primarily used for analyzing feedback control systems? A) To calculate the exact transfer function coefficients B) To graphically determine how system stability changes with a varying gain parameter C) To find the steady-state error for a given input D) To convert a system from the time domain to the frequency domain ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the depletion region width when an external forward bias is applied across a p-n junction? A) It remains unchanged because fixed donor and acceptor ions cannot move in the lattice. B) It decreases as mobile carriers are pushed into the junction, opposing the built-in potential. C) It immediately expands to the physical boundaries of the semiconductor chip. D) It increases due to the attraction of majority carriers away from the metallurgical interface. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: p-n junction అంతటా బయటి forward bias ను apply చేసినప్పుడు depletion region width కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Fixed donor మరియు acceptor ions lattice లో కదలలేవు కాబట్టి అది మారదు. B) Mobile carriers junction లోకి నెట్టబడి built-in potential ను వ్యతిరేకించడంతో అది తగ్గుతుంది. C) అది వెంటనే semiconductor chip యొక్క భౌతిక సరిహద్దుల వరకు విస్తరిస్తుంది. D) Majority carriers metallurgical interface నుండి దూరంగా ఆకర్షించబడడం వల్ల అది పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the depletion region width when an external forward bias is applied across a p-n junction? A) It remains unchanged because fixed donor and acceptor ions cannot move in the lattice. B) It decreases as mobile carriers are pushed into the junction, opposing the built-in potential. target_en: Q: How does a photon generated by stimulated emission compare to the incident photon triggering it? C) పెద్ద ముందస్తు capital expenditures ని variable operational expenditures తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. D) అది internal IT staff అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the core economic advantage of shifting from an on-premises model to a cloud computing model? input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the emitted wavelength of a light-emitting diode when the band gap energy of its active material is increased? A) The emitted wavelength remains constant while the radiative emission rate drops to zero. B) The emitted wavelength shifts toward shorter values (blue/UV shift). C) The emitted wavelength shifts toward longer values (infrared shift). D) The device switches from emitting photons to exclusively emitting phonons. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Light-emitting diode యొక్క active material band gap energy పెరిగితే, దాని emitted wavelength కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Radiative emission rate zero కి పడిపోగా emitted wavelength స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. B) Emitted wavelength తక్కువ values వైపు (blue/UV shift) జరుగుతుంది. C) Emitted wavelength ఎక్కువ values వైపు (infrared shift) జరుగుతుంది. D) Device photons ను emit చేయడం నుండి కేవలం phonons ను emit చేయడానికి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the emitted wavelength of a light-emitting diode when the band gap energy of its active material is increased? A) The emitted wavelength remains constant while the radiative emission rate drops to zero. B) The emitted wavelength shifts toward shorter values (blue/UV shift). C) The emitted wavelength shifts toward longer values (infrared shift). D) The device switches from emitting photons to exclusively emitting phonons. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a Zener diode differ from a conventional solid-state diode in its application? A) It cannot handle any reverse voltage. B) It lacks a p-n junction entirely. C) It only allows current to flow in the forward direction. D) It is specifically designed to operate in the reverse breakdown region for regulation. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Application విషయంలో Zener diode సాధారణ solid-state diode నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అది ఎలాంటి reverse voltage నూ handle చేయలేదు. B) దానికి p-n junction అసలు ఉండదు. C) అది forward direction లో మాత్రమే current ప్రవహించడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) Regulation కోసం reverse breakdown region లో పనిచేసేలా అది ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించబడింది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a Zener diode differ from a conventional solid-state diode in its application? A) It cannot handle any reverse voltage. B) It lacks a p-n junction entirely. C) It only allows current to flow in the forward direction. D) It is specifically designed to operate in the reverse breakdown region for regulation. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Direct Form II realization often preferred over Direct Form I in digital filter implementation? A) It eliminates all potential for numerical overflow. B) It always uses fewer delay elements for a given order N. C) It avoids the use of coefficients entirely. D) It is fundamentally more stable for non-linear systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital filter implementation లో Direct Form I కంటే Direct Form II realization ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) అది numerical overflow యొక్క అన్ని అవకాశాలను తొలగిస్తుంది. B) ఇచ్చిన order N కి అది ఎప్పుడూ తక్కువ delay elements ను వాడుతుంది. C) అది coefficients వాడకాన్ని పూర్తిగా నివారిస్తుంది. D) Non-linear systems కి అది మౌలికంగా ఎక్కువ stable. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Direct Form II realization often preferred over Direct Form I in digital filter implementation? A) It eliminates all potential for numerical overflow. B) It always uses fewer delay elements for a given order N. C) It avoids the use of coefficients entirely. D) It is fundamentally more stable for non-linear systems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is only one clustered index typically allowed per table? A) Because it would violate database constraints B) Because it would slow down write operations C) Because the physical data can only be ordered in one way D) Because it would consume too much storage space ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక table కి సాధారణంగా ఒకే clustered index ను ఎందుకు అనుమతిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది database constraints ను ఉల్లంఘిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే అది write operations ను నెమ్మదింపజేస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే physical data ను ఒకే విధంగా మాత్రమే క్రమబద్ధీకరించగలం D) ఎందుకంటే అది చాలా ఎక్కువ storage space ను వినియోగిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is only one clustered index typically allowed per table? A) Because it would violate database constraints B) Because it would slow down write operations C) Because the physical data can only be ordered in one way D) Because it would consume too much storage space ANSWER: C

C) అవి optimal కి నిరూపించదగిన factor లోపల ఒక solution ని ఇస్తాయి. D) అవి graph problems కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of greedy approximation algorithms for NP-complete problems? A) They run in exponential time. B) They always find the exact optimal solution. input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a feature store in a machine learning pipeline? A) To automatically generate features using deep learning algorithms without human intervention B) To handle the inherent issues with clustering algorithms using manifold learning techniques C) To reduce the dimensionality of the dataset using Principal Components Analysis D) To serve as a centralized location for storing, organizing, and serving features for training and prediction ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Machine learning pipeline లో feature store యొక్క ప్రధాన పని ఏమిటి? A) మనిషి జోక్యం లేకుండా deep learning algorithms ఉపయోగించి features ను స్వయంచాలకంగా generate చేయడం B) Manifold learning techniques ఉపయోగించి clustering algorithms లోని సహజ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించడం C) Principal Components Analysis ఉపయోగించి dataset యొక్క dimensionality ని తగ్గించడం D) Training మరియు prediction కోసం features ను store చేయడానికి, organize చేయడానికి మరియు serve చేయడానికి ఒక కేంద్రీకృత స్థానంగా పనిచేయడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a feature store in a machine learning pipeline? A) To automatically generate features using deep learning algorithms without human intervention B) To handle the inherent issues with clustering algorithms using manifold learning techniques C) To reduce the dimensionality of the dataset using Principal Components Analysis D) To serve as a centralized location for storing, organizing, and serving features for training and prediction ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In the equivalent circuit model of a real transformer, how is core loss typically represented? A) Secondary winding తో series లో ఉంచిన ఒక inductor B) Primary winding తో series లో కనెక్ట్ చేసిన ఒక resistance C) Induced EMF branch కు parallel గా కనెక్ట్ చేసిన ఒక resistance D) Load terminals కు అడ్డంగా ఉంచిన ఒక variable capacitor జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In the equivalent circuit model of a real transformer, how is core loss typically represented? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using multi-head attention in a GAT layer? A) It allows the model to focus on different types of neighbor relationships simultaneously. D) Design ద్వారానే layer permutation equivariant గా ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using multi-head attention in a GAT layer? A) It allows the model to focus on different types of neighbor relationships simultaneously. input: to Telugu: Q: In a Hybrid ARQ scheme using FEC parity data, when does the receiver request retransmission? A) It requests retransmission only if the parity data was insufficient for successful decoding. B) It requests retransmission after a fixed timeout period regardless of decoding success. C) It requests retransmission immediately after the first transmission attempt. D) It requests retransmission if the channel capacity drops below a threshold. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: FEC parity data ను వాడే Hybrid ARQ scheme లో receiver retransmission ను ఎప్పుడు request చేస్తుంది? A) విజయవంతమైన decoding కి parity data సరిపోనప్పుడు మాత్రమే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. B) Decoding విజయంతో సంబంధం లేకుండా fixed timeout period తర్వాత అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. C) మొదటి transmission ప్రయత్నం తర్వాత వెంటనే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. D) Channel capacity ఒక threshold కంటే తగ్గితే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a Hybrid ARQ scheme using FEC parity data, when does the receiver request retransmission? A) It requests retransmission only if the parity data was insufficient for successful decoding. B) It requests retransmission after a fixed timeout period regardless of decoding success. C) It requests retransmission immediately after the first transmission attempt. D) It requests retransmission if the channel capacity drops below a threshold. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is cycle stealing mode preferred over burst mode in certain systems? A) It requires fewer hardware registers in the DMA controller. B) It is simpler to implement in software without any special hardware. C) It allows the CPU to perform work between small data transfers. D) It transfers data faster by using the entire bus continuously. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: కొన్ని systems లో burst mode కంటే cycle stealing mode ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) DMA controller లో దానికి తక్కువ hardware registers అవసరం. B) ఎలాంటి ప్రత్యేక hardware లేకుండా software లో దాన్ని implement చేయడం సులభం. C) చిన్న data transfers మధ్య CPU పని చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) మొత్తం bus ని నిరంతరం ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా అది data ని వేగంగా transfer చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is cycle stealing mode preferred over burst mode in certain systems? A) It requires fewer hardware registers in the DMA controller. B) It is simpler to implement in software without any special hardware. C) It allows the CPU to perform work between small data transfers. D) It transfers data faster by using the entire bus continuously. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the upper-left corner of the ROC space (0, 1) considered the ideal point? A) It indicates a classifier with zero specificity. B) అది true positives మరియు false positives రెండింటినీ ఒకేసారి గరిష్ఠం చేస్తుంది. C) అది diagonal no-discrimination line కి సంబంధించినది. D) అది 0% false positive rate తో 100% sensitivity ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the upper-left corner of the ROC space (0, 1) considered the ideal point? A) It indicates a classifier with zero specificity. B) It maximizes both true positives and false positives simultaneously. C) It corresponds to the diagonal no-discrimination line. D) It represents 100% sensitivity with 0% false positive rate. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might an Adjacency matrix be considered inefficient for sparse graphs compared to an Adjacency list? A) Because it is only compatible with undirected graphs B) Because it makes testing adjacency slower than a list C) Because it requires O(V^2) space regardless of the number of edges D) Because it cannot represent weights on edges ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Sparse graphs కోసం Adjacency list తో పోలిస్తే Adjacency matrix ఎందుకు అసమర్థంగా పరిగణించబడవచ్చు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది undirected graphs తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే అది list కంటే adjacency testing ని నెమ్మదిగా చేస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే edges సంఖ్యతో సంబంధం లేకుండా దానికి O(V^2) space అవసరం D) ఎందుకంటే అది edges పై weights ని సూచించలేదు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why might an Adjacency matrix be considered inefficient for sparse graphs compared to an Adjacency list? A) Because it is only compatible with undirected graphs B) Because it makes testing adjacency slower than a list C) Because it requires O(V^2) space regardless of the number of edges D) Because it cannot represent weights on edges ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In C, if a pointer 'p' points to an integer in an array, what does the expression 'p + 1' typically represent? A) The value of the integer at 'p' plus one. target: ప్రశ్న: C లో ఒక pointer 'p' array లోని ఒక integer ని సూచిస్తే, 'p + 1' expression సాధారణంగా దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది? A) 'p' వద్ద ఉన్న integer value కి ఒకటి కలిపినది. B) Array లోని తదుపరి integer element యొక్క address. C) Data type తో సంబంధం లేకుండా memory లోని తదుపరి byte యొక్క address. D) Segmentation fault కి దారితీసే invalid operation. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In C, if a pointer 'p' points to an integer in an array, what does the expression 'p + 1' typically represent? A) The value of the integer at 'p' plus one. B) The address of the next integer element in the array. C) The address of the next byte in memory regardless of the data type. D) An invalid operation that causes a segmentation fault. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a subnet mask in IPv4 addressing? A) To divide an IP address into network and host portions B) To define the physical topology of a network C) To assign a unique MAC address to a network interface D) To encrypt data packets for secure transmission ANSWER: A

A) IP address ని network మరియు host భాగాలుగా విభజించడం B) Network యొక్క physical topology ని నిర్వచించడం C) Network interface కి ఒక unique MAC address ని కేటాయించడం D) సురక్షిత transmission కోసం data packets ని encrypt చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a subnet mask in IPv4 addressing? A) To divide an IP address into network and host portions B) To define the physical topology of a network C) To assign a unique MAC address to a network interface D) To encrypt data packets for secure transmission ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must a database transaction that subtracts 10 from column A without changing column B be canceled, assuming the invariant is A + B = 100? A) Because atomicity would be violated. B) Because durability would fail. C) Because isolation would be compromised. D) Because the database would enter an inconsistent state. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Invariant A + B = 100 అనుకుంటే, column B ని మార్చకుండా column A నుండి 10 తీసివేసే database transaction ని ఎందుకు cancel చేయాలి? A) ఎందుకంటే atomicity violate అవుతుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే durability fail అవుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే isolation దెబ్బతింటుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే database ఒక inconsistent state లోకి ప్రవేశిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why must a database transaction that subtracts 10 from column A without changing column B be canceled, assuming the invariant is A + B = 100? A) Because atomicity would be violated. B) Because durability would fail. C) Because isolation would be compromised. D) Because the database would enter an inconsistent state. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Boolean satisfiability problem significant in the study of NP-completeness? A) It is the only problem in the class P B) It is the first problem proven to be NP-complete via the Cook-Levin theorem C) It is the only problem that is NP-complete D) It is a problem that requires only logarithmic space to solve ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: NP-completeness అధ్యయనంలో Boolean satisfiability problem ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైనది? A) ఇది class P లో ఉన్న ఏకైక problem B) Cook-Levin theorem ద్వారా NP-complete అని నిరూపించబడిన మొదటి problem ఇదే C) NP-complete అయిన ఏకైక problem ఇదే D) దీన్ని పరిష్కరించడానికి కేవలం logarithmic space మాత్రమే అవసరం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Boolean satisfiability problem significant in the study of NP-completeness? A) It is the only problem in the class P B) It is the first problem proven to be NP-complete via the Cook-Levin theorem C) It is the only problem that is NP-complete D) It is a problem that requires only logarithmic space to solve ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What causes bound charge in dielectric materials? A) The microscopic displacement of electrons relative to atomic nuclei under an external electric field. B) The accumulation of free electrons on the surface of the material. C) The ionization of atoms due to high electric field strength. D) The transfer of electrons between atoms in an external field. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Dielectric materials లో bound charge కి కారణం ఏమిటి? A) External electric field కింద atomic nuclei కి సంబంధించి electrons యొక్క సూక్ష్మ displacement. B) Material ఉపరితలంపై free electrons పేరుకుపోవడం. C) ఎక్కువ electric field strength వల్ల atoms యొక్క ionization. D) External field లో atoms మధ్య electrons బదిలీ. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What causes bound charge in dielectric materials? A) The microscopic displacement of electrons relative to atomic nuclei under an external electric field. B) The accumulation of free electrons on the surface of the material. C) The ionization of atoms due to high electric field strength. D) The transfer of electrons between atoms in an external field. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is busy-waiting generally considered inefficient in software solutions for mutual exclusion? A) It requires complex hardware support that is not widely available. B) It consumes CPU cycles while a thread waits for a resource to become available. C) It leads to immediate deadlock in all cases. D) It cannot be used in multiprocessor systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Mutual exclusion కోసం software solutions లో busy-waiting ను సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు inefficient గా భావిస్తారు? A) దీనికి విస్తృతంగా అందుబాటులో లేని complex hardware support అవసరం. B) ఒక resource అందుబాటులోకి వచ్చే వరకు thread wait చేస్తున్నప్పుడు ఇది CPU cycles ను వినియోగిస్తుంది. C) ఇది అన్ని సందర్భాల్లో వెంటనే deadlock కి దారితీస్తుంది. D) దీనిని multiprocessor systems లో వాడలేము. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is busy-waiting generally considered inefficient in software solutions for mutual exclusion? A) It requires complex hardware support that is not widely available. B) It consumes CPU cycles while a thread waits for a resource to become available. C) It leads to immediate deadlock in all cases. D) It cannot be used in multiprocessor systems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the core philosophy of Scrum regarding team structure? A) A hierarchical structure with a project manager directing daily tasks B) A group of developers reporting directly to the Product Owner for assignments C) A self-organizing, cross-functional team that manages its own work D) A siloed structure where developers and designers work in separate phases ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Team structure విషయంలో Scrum యొక్క ముఖ్య తత్వాన్ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) రోజువారీ tasks ని project manager నిర్దేశించే hierarchical structure B) Assignments కోసం నేరుగా Product Owner కి report చేసే developers సమూహం C) తన పనిని తానే నిర్వహించుకునే self-organizing, cross-functional team D) Developers మరియు designers వేర్వేరు phases లో పనిచేసే siloed structure జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the core philosophy of Scrum regarding team structure? A) A hierarchical structure with a project manager directing daily tasks B) A group of developers reporting directly to the Product Owner for assignments C) A self-organizing, cross-functional team that manages its own work D) A siloed structure where developers and designers work in separate phases ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a queue considered a first-in-first-out (FIFO) data structure? A) Because the first element added is always the first one removed. D) ఎందుకంటే elements ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒకే చివర నుండి చేర్చబడతాయి మరియు తొలగించబడతాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a queue considered a first-in-first-out (FIFO) data structure? A) Because the first element added is always the first one removed. input: to Telugu: Q: When electrons pass through a double slit one at a time over a long duration, what is observed on the detector screen? A) Only two sharp lines directly aligned behind the two slits are formed. B) A uniformly smeared background with no observable structure. C) Individual localized hits gradually accumulate into a wave interference pattern. D) A single concentrated central maximum with no alternating dark fringes. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఎక్కువ కాలం పాటు electrons ఒక్కొక్కటిగా double slit గుండా వెళ్ళినప్పుడు, detector screen పై ఏమి కనిపిస్తుంది? A) రెండు slits వెనుక నేరుగా రెండు పదునైన గీతలు మాత్రమే ఏర్పడతాయి. B) ఎలాంటి గమనించదగిన structure లేని ఒకే విధంగా పరచుకున్న background. C) ఒక్కొక్క localized hits క్రమంగా పేరుకుపోయి wave interference pattern గా ఏర్పడతాయి. D) ఒకదాని తర్వాత ఒకటి వచ్చే dark fringes లేని ఒకే కేంద్రీకృత central maximum. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: When electrons pass through a double slit one at a time over a long duration, what is observed on the detector screen? A) Only two sharp lines directly aligned behind the two slits are formed. B) A uniformly smeared background with no observable structure. A) It eliminates the need for a guard band between adjacent subcarriers. B) It transmits data at a much higher symbol rate per subcarrier. C) It uses fewer total subcarriers to transmit the same amount of data. D) It requires less complex modulation schemes like BPSK or QPSK. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: సాంప్రదాయ FDM కంటే Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) పక్కపక్కన ఉన్న subcarriers మధ్య guard band అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. B) అది ఒక్కో subcarrier కి చాలా ఎక్కువ symbol rate తో data ను transmit చేస్తుంది. C) అదే మొత్తం data ను transmit చేయడానికి అది తక్కువ మొత్తం subcarriers ను వాడుతుంది. D) దానికి BPSK లేదా QPSK వంటి తక్కువ సంక్లిష్ట modulation schemes అవసరం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) over traditional FDM? A) It eliminates the need for a guard band between adjacent subcarriers. B) It transmits data at a much higher symbol rate per subcarrier. C) It uses fewer total subcarriers to transmit the same amount of data. D) It requires less complex modulation schemes like BPSK or QPSK. ANSWER: A

A) Real differentiability of component functions automatically guarantees complex differentiability. B) Complex differentiability requires the difference quotient limit to be identical along any path in the complex plane, which is much stronger. C) A complex differentiable function is not necessarily infinitely differentiable unlike real differentiable functions. D) Complex differentiability only requires the directional derivatives along the real and imaginary axes to exist. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక బిందువు వద్ద complex function యొక్క differentiability, రెండు real variables ఉన్న real function యొక్క differentiability కంటే ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Component functions యొక్క real differentiability వల్ల complex differentiability ఆటోమేటిక్‌గా హామీ అవుతుంది. B) Complex differentiability కి complex plane లో ఏ path వెంబడి వెళ్ళినా difference quotient limit ఒకేలా ఉండాలి, ఇది చాలా బలమైన షరతు. C) Real differentiable functions లా కాకుండా, complex differentiable function తప్పనిసరిగా infinitely differentiable కాదు. D) Complex differentiability కి real మరియు imaginary axes వెంబడి directional derivatives ఉంటే చాలు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does differentiability of a complex function at a point differ fundamentally from differentiability of a real function of two real variables? A) Real differentiability of component functions automatically guarantees complex differentiability. B) Complex differentiability requires the difference quotient limit to be identical along any path in the complex plane, which is much stronger. C) A complex differentiable function is not necessarily infinitely differentiable unlike real differentiable functions. D) Complex differentiability only requires the directional derivatives along the real and imaginary axes to exist. ANSWER: B

D) అది term frequency లెక్కింపుల అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does BM25F differ from the standard BM25 ranking function? A) It accounts for document structure by assigning different weights to different fields like headlines or body text. B) It only works on documents that contain no more than 100 words. C) It treats the entire document as a single, uniform stream of text. D) It removes the need for term frequency calculations. input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of mutual exclusion in concurrent systems? A) To maximize the speed of all threads by running them in parallel. B) To schedule threads based on their priority levels. C) To ensure that only one thread accesses a shared resource at a time to prevent race conditions. D) To allow multiple threads to read and write to shared memory simultaneously. ANSWER: C

B) Threads ను వాటి priority levels ఆధారంగా schedule చేయడం. C) Race conditions ను నివారించడానికి ఒక సమయంలో ఒకే thread shared resource ను access చేసేలా చూడడం. D) అనేక threads ఒకేసారి shared memory కి read, write చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of mutual exclusion in concurrent systems? A) To maximize the speed of all threads by running them in parallel. B) To schedule threads based on their priority levels. C) To ensure that only one thread accesses a shared resource at a time to prevent race conditions. D) To allow multiple threads to read and write to shared memory simultaneously. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: How does the compensation-wave method differ from standard CW transmission? input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes a single container from a containerized system? A) A containerized system requires a separate OS kernel for each individual container. D) A containerized system runs on a non-cloud environment, while a container runs on a cloud. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Single container ని containerized system నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Containerized system కి ప్రతి container కి విడిగా OS kernel అవసరం. B) Single container ఒక portable environment, system అంటే ఒకే OS kernel ని పంచుకునే సమూహం. C) Single container applications యొక్క load balancing మరియు scaling ని నిర్వహిస్తుంది. D) Containerized system non-cloud environment పై run అవుతుంది, container cloud పై run అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What distinguishes a single container from a containerized system? A) A containerized system requires a separate OS kernel for each individual container. B) A single container is a portable environment, while a system is the collective group sharing one OS kernel. C) A single container manages the load balancing and scaling of applications. D) A containerized system runs on a non-cloud environment, while a container runs on a cloud. ANSWER: B

C) Tries చిన్న strings కి మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. D) Keys నేరుగా tree structure లో store చేయబడతాయి, దీనివల్ల hash function అవసరం ఉండదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does a trie not suffer from hash collisions like a hash table? A) A trie uses a different hashing algorithm. B) A trie automatically resolves collisions by chaining. input: to Telugu: Q: In a minimax search tree, what is the fundamental assumption the maximizing player makes about the minimizing player's turn? target_en: Q: In a minimax search tree, what is the fundamental assumption the maximizing player makes about the minimizing player's turn? A) The minimizing player will only move if it leads to a draw B) The minimizing player will play randomly C) The minimizing player will choose the move that is best for the minimizing player (worst for the maximizer) D) The minimizing player will cooperate to maximize the total game score ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: What is the primary functional purpose of the forget gate in an LSTM unit? target_en: Q: Why is the value of a probability density function (PDF) at a specific point not equal to the probability of the random variable taking that exact value? A) Because PDF values must always sum to zero across the sample space B) Because the cumulative distribution function is non-continuous C) Because the probability of a continuous random variable taking any exact single point is zero D) Because PDFs apply only to discrete random variables ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the chain rule considered the mathematical foundation of backpropagation? A) It determines the architecture of the neural network layers B) It allows for the decomposition of the gradient of a composite function across layers C) It eliminates the necessity of having a loss function D) It helps optimize the speed of input data loading ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Chain rule ని backpropagation యొక్క mathematical పునాదిగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది neural network layers యొక్క architecture ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది B) Composite function యొక్క gradient ని layers అంతటా విభజించడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది C) అది loss function అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది D) అది input data loading speed ని optimize చేయడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the chain rule considered the mathematical foundation of backpropagation? A) It determines the architecture of the neural network layers B) It allows for the decomposition of the gradient of a composite function across layers C) It eliminates the necessity of having a loss function D) It helps optimize the speed of input data loading ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of the Bakery algorithm compared to simpler algorithms like Peterson's? A) It does not use shared memory for communication. B) It can handle an arbitrary number of processes without deadlock. C) It requires more than two processes to function correctly. D) It is only applicable to uniprocessor systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Peterson's వంటి సరళమైన algorithms తో పోలిస్తే Bakery algorithm యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Communication కోసం అది shared memory ఉపయోగించదు. B) Deadlock లేకుండా అది ఎన్ని processes నైనా handle చేయగలదు. C) సరిగ్గా పనిచేయడానికి దానికి రెండు కంటే ఎక్కువ processes అవసరం. D) అది uniprocessor systems కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of the Bakery algorithm compared to simpler algorithms like Peterson's? A) It does not use shared memory for communication. B) It can handle an arbitrary number of processes without deadlock. C) It requires more than two processes to function correctly. D) It is only applicable to uniprocessor systems. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What happens to the size of the central Airy disk when the diameter of a circular aperture is reduced? target_en: Q: Under which condition can mean field theory be applied to solve the weight equations in a linear network? A) When a small, fixed fraction of weights are diluted and the number of terms goes to infinite B) When the network is processed by an analog neuromorphic processor C) When the fraction of removed connections is large D) When strong dilution is applied to the input frequencies ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is 'knowledge acquisition' often cited as the most significant challenge in the development of expert systems? A) It requires the expert to write complex procedural code in low-level programming languages. B) It involves translating implicit human expert intuition into explicit machine-readable rules. C) It requires high-performance computing clusters that are expensive to maintain. D) It is impossible to store large amounts of data in a knowledge base without using neural networks. ANSWER: B

A) Expert low-level programming languages లో సంక్లిష్టమైన procedural code రాయవలసి వస్తుంది. B) Human expert యొక్క అవ్యక్త intuition ను explicit, machine-readable rules గా మార్చవలసి ఉంటుంది. C) Maintain చేయడానికి ఖరీదైన high-performance computing clusters అవసరం. D) Neural networks వాడకుండా knowledge base లో పెద్ద మొత్తంలో data ను store చేయడం అసాధ్యం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is 'knowledge acquisition' often cited as the most significant challenge in the development of expert systems? A) It requires the expert to write complex procedural code in low-level programming languages. B) It involves translating implicit human expert intuition into explicit machine-readable rules. C) It requires high-performance computing clusters that are expensive to maintain. D) It is impossible to store large amounts of data in a knowledge base without using neural networks. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How is a principal submatrix constructed from an n × n square matrix? A) By selecting only the entries that reside strictly above the main diagonal. B) By deleting the exact same set of row and column indices from the original matrix. C) By deleting arbitrary rows while keeping all original columns intact. D) By computing the transpose and setting off-diagonal elements to zero. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: n × n square matrix నుండి principal submatrix ఎలా నిర్మించబడుతుంది? A) Main diagonal కి కచ్చితంగా పైన ఉన్న entries ని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకోవడం ద్వారా. B) అసలు matrix నుండి ఒకే set row మరియు column indices ని తొలగించడం ద్వారా. C) అన్ని అసలు columns ని అలాగే ఉంచి ఏవైనా rows ని తొలగించడం ద్వారా. D) Transpose లెక్కించి off-diagonal elements ని సున్నాగా పెట్టడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How is a principal submatrix constructed from an n × n square matrix? A) By selecting only the entries that reside strictly above the main diagonal. B) By deleting the exact same set of row and column indices from the original matrix. C) By deleting arbitrary rows while keeping all original columns intact. D) By computing the transpose and setting off-diagonal elements to zero. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a write-miss in a write-back cache require two memory accesses to the backing store? A) To first write back dirty data and then fetch the requested block from the backing store B) To first update the tag and then write the data to the backing store C) To first check permissions and then write the data to the backing store D) To first fetch the block into cache and then write it back to the backing store ANSWER: A

A) ముందుగా dirty data ను write back చేసి, తర్వాత అడిగిన block ను backing store నుండి fetch చేయడానికి B) ముందుగా tag ను update చేసి, తర్వాత data ను backing store కు write చేయడానికి C) ముందుగా permissions ను check చేసి, తర్వాత data ను backing store కు write చేయడానికి D) ముందుగా block ను cache లోకి fetch చేసి, తర్వాత దాన్ని backing store కు తిరిగి write చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why might a write-miss in a write-back cache require two memory accesses to the backing store? A) To first write back dirty data and then fetch the requested block from the backing store B) To first update the tag and then write the data to the backing store C) To first check permissions and then write the data to the backing store D) To first fetch the block into cache and then write it back to the backing store ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the relationship between AES and Rijndael? input: to Telugu: Q: What does Gauss's law fundamentally relate in electromagnetism? target: ప్రశ్న: Electromagnetism లో Gauss's law ప్రాథమికంగా దేనిని దేనితో సంబంధపరుస్తుంది? A) Electric potential ని ఒక charge ని కదిలించడంలో చేసిన work తో B) Electric field ని closed surface ద్వారా వెళ్ళే magnetic flux తో C) రెండు charges మధ్య force ని వాటి మధ్య దూరంతో D) Closed surface ద్వారా వెళ్ళే మొత్తం electric flux ని లోపల ఉన్న charge తో జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What does Gauss's law fundamentally relate in electromagnetism? A) The electric potential to the work done moving a charge B) The electric field to the magnetic flux through a closed surface C) The force between two charges to the distance between them D) The total electric flux through a closed surface to the enclosed charge ANSWER: D
