input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the vector representation crucial in the context of word embeddings? A) It removes the need for grammatical parsing in all NLP tasks. B) It converts words into a unique binary hash for faster encryption. C) It maps semantic meanings to a mathematical space where proximity indicates similar meaning. D) It compresses text to save storage space on a hard drive. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Word embeddings సందర్భంలో vector representation ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) అన్ని NLP tasks లో grammatical parsing అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. B) వేగవంతమైన encryption కోసం words ని unique binary hash గా మారుస్తుంది. C) Semantic అర్థాలను ఒక mathematical space కి map చేస్తుంది, అక్కడ దగ్గరగా ఉండటం సారూప్య అర్థాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది. D) Hard drive పై storage space ఆదా చేయడానికి text ని compress చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the vector representation crucial in the context of word embeddings? A) It removes the need for grammatical parsing in all NLP tasks. B) It converts words into a unique binary hash for faster encryption. C) It maps semantic meanings to a mathematical space where proximity indicates similar meaning. D) It compresses text to save storage space on a hard drive. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a social media recommender system classified as a heuristic rather than an algorithm according to the text? A) It is based on ancient mathematical principles. ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: Why is a social media recommender system classified as a heuristic rather than an algorithm according to the text? A) It is based on ancient mathematical principles. B) It requires a finite amount of space and time to run. C) It uses a formal language to define its operations. D) It lacks an objective criteria to judge its output as definitively correct. D) దీని singularities దగ్గర దీన్ని Laurent series ద్వారా సూచించలేము. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which statement correctly describes a meromorphic function on an open domain in the complex plane? A) It must be bounded everywhere on the entire complex plane. input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of regular expression syntax, what distinguishes a literal character from a metacharacter? A) Literal characters are defined by the POSIX standard, while metacharacters are proprietary. B) Literal characters have no special meaning and match themselves, while metacharacters trigger special matching logic. C) Literal characters are used for replacement, and metacharacters are used for searching. D) Metacharacters are only used in basic syntax, while literals are used in extended syntax. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Regular expression syntax సందర్భంలో literal character ని metacharacter నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Literal characters POSIX standard ద్వారా నిర్వచించబడతాయి, metacharacters proprietary. C) Literal characters replacement కి ఉపయోగించబడతాయి, metacharacters searching కి ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. D) Metacharacters basic syntax లో మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడతాయి, literals extended syntax లో ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of regular expression syntax, what distinguishes a literal character from a metacharacter? A) Literal characters are defined by the POSIX standard, while metacharacters are proprietary. B) Literal characters have no special meaning and match themselves, while metacharacters trigger special matching logic. C) Literal characters are used for replacement, and metacharacters are used for searching. D) Metacharacters are only used in basic syntax, while literals are used in extended syntax. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What major advantage does defining expected value via the Lebesgue integral offer over Riemann sums? A) It guarantees that every infinite series converges absolutely without conditions B) It eliminates the requirement that the total probability of the sample space sums to one C) It provides a unified axiomatic definition across discrete, continuous, and mixed random variables D) It allows computation of averages without defining a probability measure ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) fails to hold strictly across a node under which of the following physical conditions? input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of infinitesimal strain theory, what key assumption is made regarding the geometry of the material? A) Rotations are negligible, but strains must be large. B) Deformed మరియు undeformed configurations ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయని ఊహించబడుతుంది. C) Material rigid గా ఉండి అసలు deform కాదు. D) Material అనంతంగా పొడవుగా ఉందని ఊహించబడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of infinitesimal strain theory, what key assumption is made regarding the geometry of the material? A) Rotations are negligible, but strains must be large. B) The deformed and undeformed configurations are assumed to be identical. C) The material remains rigid and does not deform at all. D) The material is assumed to be infinitely long. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary goal of using a prefetch input queue in a cache? target: ప్రశ్న: Cache లో prefetch input queue ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి? A) Entries సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా cache replacement policies ని సరళీకరించడం B) Data ని స్పష్టంగా request చేయకముందే load చేయడం ద్వారా hit rate ని మెరుగుపరచడం C) Writes ని batch చేయడం ద్వారా cache write latency ని తగ్గించడం D) ఉపయోగించని data ని evict చేయడం ద్వారా cache capacity ని పెంచడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary goal of using a prefetch input queue in a cache? A) To simplify cache replacement policies by reducing the number of entries B) To improve hit rate by loading data before it is explicitly requested C) To reduce cache write latency by batching writes D) To increase cache capacity by evicting unused data ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Dijkstra's algorithm guaranteed to find the shortest path in graphs with non-negative edge weights? A) ఎందుకంటే అది nodes మధ్య ప్రత్యక్ష connections ని మాత్రమే పరిగణిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ తెలిసిన అతి చిన్న distance ఉన్న node ని expand చేయడానికి priority queue ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే అది అన్ని సాధ్యమైన paths ని సమగ్రంగా అన్వేషిస్తుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అది visit చేయాల్సిన nodes ని random గా ఎంచుకుంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Dijkstra's algorithm guaranteed to find the shortest path in graphs with non-negative edge weights? A) Because it only considers direct connections between nodes B) Because it uses a priority queue to always expand the node with the smallest known distance C) Because it explores all possible paths exhaustively D) Because it randomly selects nodes to visit ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does statistical multiplexing improve efficiency compared to fixed time-division multiplexing for variable bit rate streams? D) ప్రతి stream కి వేర్వేరు frequency ranges ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does statistical multiplexing improve efficiency compared to fixed time-division multiplexing for variable bit rate streams? A) It requires all streams to have the same peak bit rate. B) It dynamically allocates time slots based on real-time demand, reducing idle capacity. C) It assigns dedicated time slots to each stream regardless of activity. D) It uses different frequency ranges for each stream. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a series DC motor often preferred for applications like electric trains? target: ప్రశ్న: Electric trains వంటి applications కి series DC motor ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) బరువైన inertia ను కదిలించడానికి అవసరమైన చాలా ఎక్కువ starting torque ను అది generate చేస్తుంది B) తక్కువ loads వద్ద అది shunt motor కంటే ఎక్కువ efficient C) పనిచేయడానికి దానికి బయటి power supply అవసరం లేదు D) Load మార్పులతో సంబంధం లేకుండా అది స్థిరమైన speed ను ఇస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a series DC motor often preferred for applications like electric trains? A) It generates very high starting torque needed to move heavy inertia B) It is more efficient than a shunt motor at low loads C) It does not require any external power supply to function D) It provides a constant speed regardless of load variations ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a primary reason divide-and-conquer algorithms are often more numerically accurate than iterative loops for summing large datasets? target: ప్రశ్న: పెద్ద datasets ను sum చేయడానికి iterative loops కంటే divide-and-conquer algorithms తరచుగా ఎక్కువ numerically accurate గా ఉండడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం కింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) అవి recursion stacks ను నివారిస్తాయి B) అవి మొత్తం operations సంఖ్యను తగ్గిస్తాయి C) Round-off errors ను కనిష్ఠం చేయడానికి అవి pairwise summation ను వాడతాయి D) అవి చిన్న data types ను వాడతాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a primary reason divide-and-conquer algorithms are often more numerically accurate than iterative loops for summing large datasets? A) They avoid recursion stacks B) They reduce the total number of operations C) They use pairwise summation to minimize round-off errors D) They use smaller data types ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do peephole connections alter the standard decision-making process of an LSTM gate? A) They allow the gates to inspect the cell state directly B) They remove the need for the output gate entirely C) They change the activation function to a linear function D) They force the network to only look at future inputs ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Peephole connections LSTM gate యొక్క standard నిర్ణయ ప్రక్రియను ఎలా మారుస్తాయి? A) Gates cell state ని నేరుగా పరిశీలించడానికి అవి అనుమతిస్తాయి B) అవి output gate అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తాయి C) అవి activation function ని linear function గా మారుస్తాయి D) Network భవిష్యత్ inputs ని మాత్రమే చూసేలా అవి బలవంతం చేస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How do peephole connections alter the standard decision-making process of an LSTM gate? A) They allow the gates to inspect the cell state directly B) They remove the need for the output gate entirely C) They change the activation function to a linear function D) They force the network to only look at future inputs ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does increasing model complexity not always lead to better performance on unseen data? A) Because the number of parameters is a poor measure of complexity. B) ఎందుకంటే సంక్లిష్ట models ను computationally train చేయడం కష్టం. C) ఎందుకంటే పెరిగిన complexity ఎప్పుడూ bias మరియు variance రెండింటినీ తగ్గిస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే పెరిగిన complexity ఎక్కువ variance కి దారితీసి overfitting కి కారణం కావచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does increasing model complexity not always lead to better performance on unseen data? A) Because the number of parameters is a poor measure of complexity. B) Because complex models are harder to train computationally. C) Because increased complexity always decreases both bias and variance. D) Because increased complexity can lead to high variance, causing overfitting. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When is a glue record necessary in the DNS? A) When the parent domain server cannot find the IP address of the child domain's name server. B) When a TLD server needs to define a new root server. C) When a user wants to cache the IP address of a website for faster browsing. D) When the authoritative name server for a subdomain is itself located within that subdomain. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: DNS లో glue record ఎప్పుడు అవసరం? A) Parent domain server, child domain యొక్క name server IP address ని కనుగొనలేనప్పుడు. B) TLD server ఒక కొత్త root server ని నిర్వచించాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు. C) వేగవంతమైన browsing కోసం user ఒక website యొక్క IP address ని cache చేయాలనుకున్నప్పుడు. D) ఒక subdomain కి authoritative name server స్వయంగా ఆ subdomain లోనే ఉన్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: When is a glue record necessary in the DNS? A) When the parent domain server cannot find the IP address of the child domain's name server. B) When a TLD server needs to define a new root server. C) When a user wants to cache the IP address of a website for faster browsing. D) When the authoritative name server for a subdomain is itself located within that subdomain. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the decision form of the knapsack problem considered co-NP-complete? target_en: Q: Why is the decision form of the knapsack problem considered co-NP-complete? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is OFDM preferred over conventional FDM for wideband applications? A) It requires separate filters for each subcarrier B) It has a very low peak-to-average-power ratio C) It requires complex time-domain equalization D) It uses orthogonal subcarriers to increase spectral efficiency ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Wideband applications కి సాంప్రదాయ FDM కంటే OFDM ను ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) దానికి ప్రతి subcarrier కి వేర్వేరు filters అవసరం B) దానికి చాలా తక్కువ peak-to-average-power ratio ఉంటుంది C) దానికి సంక్లిష్టమైన time-domain equalization అవసరం D) Spectral efficiency ని పెంచడానికి అది orthogonal subcarriers ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is OFDM preferred over conventional FDM for wideband applications? A) It requires separate filters for each subcarrier B) It has a very low peak-to-average-power ratio C) It requires complex time-domain equalization D) It uses orthogonal subcarriers to increase spectral efficiency ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens when an IP datagram exceeds the MTU of an intermediate link? A) The link automatically increases its MTU to accommodate the larger packet. B) The transport layer resends the data using a different protocol. C) The datagram is dropped and an ICMP error message is sent to the source. D) The datagram is fragmented into smaller units by the IP layer. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక IP datagram మధ్యలోని link యొక్క MTU ని మించితే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) పెద్ద packet కి సరిపడేలా link తన MTU ని స్వయంచాలకంగా పెంచుకుంటుంది. B) Transport layer వేరే protocol ను వాడి data ను మళ్లీ పంపుతుంది. C) Datagram drop చేయబడి source కి ICMP error message పంపబడుతుంది. D) IP layer datagram ను చిన్న units గా fragment చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens when an IP datagram exceeds the MTU of an intermediate link? A) The link automatically increases its MTU to accommodate the larger packet. B) The transport layer resends the data using a different protocol. C) The datagram is dropped and an ICMP error message is sent to the source. D) The datagram is fragmented into smaller units by the IP layer. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the basic Paxos protocol not guarantee liveness? A) Because it requires a majority of acceptors to be online at all times. D) ఎందుకంటే Prepare మరియు Promise phases నిరవధికంగా deadlock కావచ్చు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the basic Paxos protocol not guarantee liveness? A) Because it requires a majority of acceptors to be online at all times. B) Because it only guarantees safety and fault tolerance, per the FLP result. C) Because it is designed to handle Byzantine failures, which slow down consensus. input: to Telugu: Q: Why are direct band gap semiconductors significantly more efficient than indirect band gap semiconductors in light-emitting diodes? A) Indirect materials cannot absorb or emit photons under any circumstances due to quantum selection rules. B) The electronic transport gap equals zero, allowing effortless current flow without electrical resistance. C) Direct band gap materials exhibit a much larger exciton binding energy that accelerates radiative decay. D) Electrons can recombine across the gap purely via photon emission without requiring momentum-conserving phonons. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Light-emitting diodes లో indirect band gap semiconductors కంటే direct band gap semiconductors ఎందుకు చాలా ఎక్కువ efficient గా ఉంటాయి? A) Quantum selection rules వల్ల indirect materials ఏ పరిస్థితిలోనూ photons ని absorb లేదా emit చేయలేవు. B) Electronic transport gap సున్నా, దీనివల్ల electrical resistance లేకుండా current సులభంగా ప్రవహిస్తుంది. C) Direct band gap materials కి చాలా ఎక్కువ exciton binding energy ఉంటుంది, అది radiative decay ని వేగవంతం చేస్తుంది. D) Momentum ని conserve చేసే phonons అవసరం లేకుండా కేవలం photon emission ద్వారానే electrons gap అంతటా recombine కాగలవు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why are direct band gap semiconductors significantly more efficient than indirect band gap semiconductors in light-emitting diodes? A) Indirect materials cannot absorb or emit photons under any circumstances due to quantum selection rules. B) The electronic transport gap equals zero, allowing effortless current flow without electrical resistance. C) Direct band gap materials exhibit a much larger exciton binding energy that accelerates radiative decay. D) Electrons can recombine across the gap purely via photon emission without requiring momentum-conserving phonons. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the collector current in a BJT primarily driven by minority carriers in the base? A) Because minority carriers have higher conductivity than majority carriers B) Because the base is always reverse-biased to attract majority carriers C) Because minority carriers diffuse across the thin base region D) Because majority carriers are blocked by the depletion layer ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: BJT లో collector current ప్రధానంగా base లోని minority carriers ద్వారా ఎందుకు నడపబడుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే minority carriers కి majority carriers కంటే ఎక్కువ conductivity ఉంటుంది B) ఎందుకంటే majority carriers ని ఆకర్షించడానికి base ఎల్లప్పుడూ reverse-biased గా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే minority carriers పలుచని base region అంతటా diffuse అవుతాయి D) ఎందుకంటే majority carriers depletion layer ద్వారా అడ్డుకోబడతాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the collector current in a BJT primarily driven by minority carriers in the base? A) Because minority carriers have higher conductivity than majority carriers B) Because the base is always reverse-biased to attract majority carriers C) Because minority carriers diffuse across the thin base region D) Because majority carriers are blocked by the depletion layer ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is batch normalization performed using mini-batch statistics during training instead of the entire dataset's statistics? A) Because it prevents the network from overfitting to the training data. B) Because the entire dataset's statistics are too large to store in memory. C) Because it allows the normalization to be differentiable and compatible with stochastic gradient descent. D) Because the entire dataset's statistics change too slowly during training. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Training సమయంలో batch normalization ను మొత్తం dataset statistics బదులు mini-batch statistics తో ఎందుకు చేస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది network training data కి overfit కాకుండా నిరోధిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే మొత్తం dataset statistics memory లో store చేయడానికి చాలా పెద్దవి. C) ఎందుకంటే అది normalization ను differentiable గా, stochastic gradient descent తో అనుకూలంగా ఉండేలా చేస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే training సమయంలో మొత్తం dataset statistics చాలా నెమ్మదిగా మారుతాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is batch normalization performed using mini-batch statistics during training instead of the entire dataset's statistics? A) Because it prevents the network from overfitting to the training data. B) Because the entire dataset's statistics are too large to store in memory. C) Because it allows the normalization to be differentiable and compatible with stochastic gradient descent. D) Because the entire dataset's statistics change too slowly during training. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: How does SVD relate to PCA in terms of computational approach? A) SVD is used to compute the covariance matrix directly. B) SVD and PCA are mathematically unrelated. input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a negative feedback loop in a control system? A) To amplify input signals to their maximum potential. B) Phase space ని అన్వేషించడానికి system chaos స్థితిలోకి ప్రవేశించేలా చూడటం. C) Control architecture లో set point అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడం. D) ప్రస్తుత deviations కి వ్యతిరేకంగా పనిచేయడం ద్వారా error signal ని minimize చేయడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a negative feedback loop in a control system? A) To amplify input signals to their maximum potential. B) To ensure the system enters a state of chaos to explore the phase space. C) To remove the need for a set point in the control architecture. D) To minimize the error signal by acting in opposition to current deviations. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the shuffle operation critical for the correctness of a MapReduce job? A) అది input records యొక్క data types ని validate చేస్తుంది B) Network bandwidth తగ్గించడానికి అది intermediate data ని compress చేస్తుంది C) Sorting కోసం output pairs కి కొత్త keys ని కేటాయిస్తుంది D) ఒక నిర్దిష్ట key కి సంబంధించిన మొత్తం data ఒకే reducer కి పంపబడేలా అది చూస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the shuffle operation critical for the correctness of a MapReduce job? A) It validates the data types of the input records B) It compresses the intermediate data to reduce network bandwidth C) It assigns new keys to the output pairs for sorting D) It ensures that all data for a specific key is sent to the same reducer ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Young's modulus considered a measure of material stiffness? A) Because it is the ratio of stress to strain, indicating resistance to deformation B) Because it is the same for all materials regardless of type C) Because it is directly proportional to the applied force D) Because it is measured in units of strain ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Young's modulus ను పదార్థం యొక్క stiffness కు కొలతగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే ఇది stress కు strain కు మధ్య నిష్పత్తి, deformation కు ఉన్న నిరోధాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే పదార్థం రకం ఏదైనా ఇది అన్నింటికీ ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే ఇది ప్రయోగించిన force కు నేరుగా అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది D) ఎందుకంటే దీన్ని strain units లో కొలుస్తారు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is Young's modulus considered a measure of material stiffness? A) Because it is the ratio of stress to strain, indicating resistance to deformation B) Because it is the same for all materials regardless of type C) Because it is directly proportional to the applied force D) Because it is measured in units of strain ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Nyquist stability criterion determine the stability of a closed-loop system? A) By finding the roots of the characteristic equation using the Routh-Hurwitz criterion. B) By counting the number of poles of the open-loop transfer function in the right-half plane. C) By counting the number of encirclements of the critical point -1 by the Nyquist plot of the open-loop transfer function. D) By calculating the gain and phase margin from the Bode plot of the closed-loop system. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Nyquist stability criterion ఒక closed-loop system యొక్క stability ని ఎలా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది? A) Routh-Hurwitz criterion ను వాడి characteristic equation యొక్క roots ను కనుగొనడం ద్వారా. B) Right-half plane లో open-loop transfer function యొక్క poles సంఖ్యను లెక్కించడం ద్వారా. C) Open-loop transfer function యొక్క Nyquist plot critical point -1 ను ఎన్నిసార్లు చుట్టుముడుతుందో లెక్కించడం ద్వారా. D) Closed-loop system యొక్క Bode plot నుండి gain మరియు phase margin ను లెక్కించడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does the Nyquist stability criterion determine the stability of a closed-loop system? A) By finding the roots of the characteristic equation using the Routh-Hurwitz criterion. B) By counting the number of poles of the open-loop transfer function in the right-half plane. C) By counting the number of encirclements of the critical point -1 by the Nyquist plot of the open-loop transfer function. D) By calculating the gain and phase margin from the Bode plot of the closed-loop system. ANSWER: C

D) Connection establishment సమయంలో అవసరమైన round trips సంఖ్యను అది తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does HTTP/3 typically experience lower latency than HTTP/2? A) It compresses the entire payload more efficiently than HTTP/2. B) It uses a faster compression algorithm for headers. C) It eliminates TCP's slow-start mechanism by using UDP. D) It reduces the number of required round trips during connection establishment. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is functional observability a useful concept in control systems? A) It simplifies the design of Kalman filters for nonlinear systems. D) పూర్తి state reconstruction అసాధ్యమైనప్పుడు కూడా నిర్దిష్ట state combinations ను అంచనా వేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is functional observability a useful concept in control systems? A) It simplifies the design of Kalman filters for nonlinear systems. B) It guarantees that all state variables can be perfectly reconstructed from outputs. C) It eliminates the need for any sensor measurements in the system. D) It allows for the estimation of specific state combinations even when full-state reconstruction is impossible. ANSWER: D

target: ప్రశ్న: Image processing మరియు computer vision లో edge detection ను మౌలిక tool గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? target_en: Q: Why is edge detection considered a fundamental tool in image processing and computer vision? A) It increases the amount of data to be processed by adding structural information. input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental difference between an expert system and a traditional procedural computer program? A) Expert systems use only machine learning, while procedural programs use if-then rules. B) Expert systems can only run on specialized hardware, unlike procedural programs. C) Expert systems are designed to replace the user interface, while procedural programs focus on data storage. D) Expert systems separate domain knowledge from the reasoning logic, while procedural programs embed logic in the code. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Expert system కి సాంప్రదాయ procedural computer program కి మధ్య మౌలిక తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Expert systems machine learning ను మాత్రమే వాడతాయి, procedural programs if-then rules ను వాడతాయి. B) Procedural programs లా కాకుండా expert systems ప్రత్యేక hardware పై మాత్రమే నడుస్తాయి. C) Expert systems user interface ను భర్తీ చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడ్డాయి, procedural programs data storage పై దృష్టి పెడతాయి. D) Expert systems domain knowledge ను reasoning logic నుండి వేరు చేస్తాయి, procedural programs logic ను code లోనే పొందుపరుస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental difference between an expert system and a traditional procedural computer program? A) Expert systems use only machine learning, while procedural programs use if-then rules. B) Expert systems can only run on specialized hardware, unlike procedural programs. C) Expert systems are designed to replace the user interface, while procedural programs focus on data storage. D) Expert systems separate domain knowledge from the reasoning logic, while procedural programs embed logic in the code. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it often difficult to interpret the 'unique effect' of a predictor variable in multiple regression? C) Because unique effects only apply to nonlinear regression models. D) Because the intercept term interferes with the partial derivative calculation. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Multiple regression లో ఒక predictor variable యొక్క 'unique effect' ను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం తరచుగా ఎందుకు కష్టం? A) ఎందుకంటే దానికి మిగతా అన్ని variables ను స్థిరంగా ఉంచాలి, అది భౌతికంగా సాధ్యం కాకపోవచ్చు. B) ఎందుకంటే సంక్లిష్ట models లో unique effect ఎప్పుడూ marginal effect కి సమానం. C) ఎందుకంటే unique effects nonlinear regression models కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తాయి. D) ఎందుకంటే intercept term partial derivative లెక్కింపులో జోక్యం చేసుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is it often difficult to interpret the 'unique effect' of a predictor variable in multiple regression? A) Because it requires holding all other variables constant, which may not be physically possible. B) Because the unique effect always equals the marginal effect in complex models. C) Because unique effects only apply to nonlinear regression models. D) Because the intercept term interferes with the partial derivative calculation. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary cause of a static race condition in digital electronics? A) When a signal and its complement are combined in a logic gate. D) When multiple transitions are intended but only one is desired. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital electronics లో static race condition కి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) ఒక signal మరియు దాని complement ఒక logic gate లో కలిపినప్పుడు. B) Feedback loop delay సమయంలో ఒక input అనేకసార్లు మారినప్పుడు. C) Signals ఒకే delays ఉన్న వేర్వేరు paths లో propagate అయినప్పుడు. D) అనేక transitions ఉద్దేశించినా ఒక్కటి మాత్రమే కావాలనుకున్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary cause of a static race condition in digital electronics? A) When a signal and its complement are combined in a logic gate. B) When an input transitions multiple times during the feedback loop delay. C) When signals propagate along different paths with identical delays. D) When multiple transitions are intended but only one is desired. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the killer heuristic in game tree search? A) To limit the search to a fixed window size. B) To store the best move found at each depth for reuse. target: ప్రశ్న: Game tree search లో killer heuristic యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Search ను fixed window size కి పరిమితం చేయడం. D) Non-capturing moves కంటే captures కి ప్రాధాన్యత ఇవ్వడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the killer heuristic in game tree search? A) To limit the search to a fixed window size. B) To store the best move found at each depth for reuse. C) To force a beta-cutoff by re-examining the last move that caused a cutoff. D) To prioritize captures over non-capturing moves. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What problem occurs in a write-back cache when a device uses DMA to write to memory? A) The CPU might read a stale value from its cache that has not been updated in memory. B) The DMA controller cannot access memory without flushing the entire cache. C) The memory address register in the DMA controller becomes invalid. D) The CPU immediately receives an interrupt for every write operation. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక device memory కి write చేయడానికి DMA ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు write-back cache లో ఏ సమస్య వస్తుంది? A) Memory లో update కాని పాత value ని CPU తన cache నుండి read చేయవచ్చు. B) మొత్తం cache ని flush చేయకుండా DMA controller memory ని access చేయలేదు. C) DMA controller లోని memory address register invalid అవుతుంది. D) ప్రతి write operation కి CPU వెంటనే ఒక interrupt ని అందుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What problem occurs in a write-back cache when a device uses DMA to write to memory? A) The CPU might read a stale value from its cache that has not been updated in memory. B) The DMA controller cannot access memory without flushing the entire cache. C) The memory address register in the DMA controller becomes invalid. D) The CPU immediately receives an interrupt for every write operation. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the GAN training process considered a 'zero-sum game'? A) Because the total accuracy of the system is forced to equal zero at equilibrium. B) Because the generator and discriminator share the same set of weights. C) Because any improvement in the discriminator's accuracy directly hinders the generator's objective. D) Because GANs are designed to function exclusively on zero-mean data distributions. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: GAN training process ను 'zero-sum game' గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే equilibrium వద్ద system యొక్క మొత్తం accuracy zero కి సమానం అయ్యేలా బలవంతం చేయబడుతుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే generator మరియు discriminator ఒకే set of weights ను పంచుకుంటాయి. C) ఎందుకంటే discriminator accuracy లో ఏ మెరుగుదల అయినా generator లక్ష్యానికి నేరుగా అడ్డుపడుతుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే GANs zero-mean data distributions పై మాత్రమే పనిచేయడానికి రూపొందించబడ్డాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the GAN training process considered a 'zero-sum game'? A) Because the total accuracy of the system is forced to equal zero at equilibrium. B) Because the generator and discriminator share the same set of weights. C) Because any improvement in the discriminator's accuracy directly hinders the generator's objective. D) Because GANs are designed to function exclusively on zero-mean data distributions. ANSWER: C

D) Short circuits కలగకుండా అనేక nodes సురక్షితంగా connect అవ్వడానికి వీలుగా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is an open-drain design with pull-up resistors used for the I2C bus lines? A) To reduce the power consumption of idle devices on the bus. input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a particle with energy E < V0 have a non-zero probability of appearing beyond a rectangular potential barrier of height V0? A) Its wave function decays exponentially within the barrier but remains non-zero at the opposite interface B) Classical collisions with the barrier walls accelerate the particle to surmount the peak C) It temporarily borrows energy from the barrier in violation of energy conservation D) The barrier height dynamically collapses when approached by a moving wave packet ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: E < V0 energy ఉన్న ఒక particle, V0 height ఉన్న rectangular potential barrier కి అవతల కనిపించే non-zero probability ఎందుకు కలిగి ఉంటుంది? A) దాని wave function barrier లోపల exponential గా తగ్గుతుంది కానీ ఎదురు interface వద్ద non-zero గానే ఉంటుంది B) Barrier walls తో classical collisions particle ని peak దాటేలా accelerate చేస్తాయి C) Energy conservation ని ఉల్లంఘిస్తూ అది barrier నుండి తాత్కాలికంగా energy ని అరువు తీసుకుంటుంది D) కదిలే wave packet దగ్గరకు వచ్చినప్పుడు barrier height dynamic గా కూలిపోతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why does a particle with energy E < V0 have a non-zero probability of appearing beyond a rectangular potential barrier of height V0? A) Its wave function decays exponentially within the barrier but remains non-zero at the opposite interface B) Classical collisions with the barrier walls accelerate the particle to surmount the peak C) It temporarily borrows energy from the barrier in violation of energy conservation D) The barrier height dynamically collapses when approached by a moving wave packet ANSWER: A

D) Generator synthetic data గా మార్చే compressed randomness source గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: For a discrete-time LTI system to be both causal and bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable, what condition must its transfer function ROC satisfy? A) It must consist strictly of an open annulus not touching the unit circle. B) It must extend outwards from the outermost pole and encompass the unit circle. C) It can be any region as long as poles lie on the imaginary axis. D) It must lie entirely inside the unit circle enclosing the origin. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక discrete-time LTI system causal మరియు bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable రెండూ కావాలంటే, దాని transfer function ROC ఏ షరతును తీర్చాలి? A) అది unit circle ను తాకని ఒక open annulus మాత్రమే అయి ఉండాలి. B) అది outermost pole నుండి బయటికి విస్తరించి, unit circle ను కలిగి ఉండాలి. C) Poles imaginary axis పై ఉన్నంత వరకు అది ఏ region అయినా కావచ్చు. D) అది origin ను కలుపుకొని పూర్తిగా unit circle లోపల ఉండాలి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: For a discrete-time LTI system to be both causal and bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable, what condition must its transfer function ROC satisfy? A) It must consist strictly of an open annulus not touching the unit circle. B) It must extend outwards from the outermost pole and encompass the unit circle. C) It can be any region as long as poles lie on the imaginary axis. D) It must lie entirely inside the unit circle enclosing the origin. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is object detection in autonomous driving often trained on synthetic data like video game scenes? C) Video games have better lighting conditions for detecting objects. D) It is easier and cheaper to generate labeled data for synthetic scenes without manual labor. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Autonomous driving లో object detection ని తరచుగా video game scenes వంటి synthetic data పై ఎందుకు train చేస్తారు? A) Real-world cameras కంటే video game scenes ఎక్కువ resolution ఉన్న images ఇస్తాయి. B) Neural networks real-world traffic data నుండి నేర్చుకోలేవు. C) Objects ని గుర్తించడానికి video games లో మెరుగైన lighting conditions ఉంటాయి. D) Manual labor లేకుండా synthetic scenes కి labeled data ని generate చేయడం సులభం మరియు చౌక. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is object detection in autonomous driving often trained on synthetic data like video game scenes? A) Video game scenes provide higher resolution images than real-world cameras. B) Neural networks cannot learn from real-world traffic data. C) Video games have better lighting conditions for detecting objects. D) It is easier and cheaper to generate labeled data for synthetic scenes without manual labor. ANSWER: D

D) Binary categorization కి multi-class categorization కంటే ఎక్కువ training data అవసరం. జవాబు: A

B) Because a temporary glitch can propagate if it acts as a clock signal for memory elements. C) Because the Boolean algebra of the gate is incorrect. D) Because logic gates are inherently unreliable and often fail. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Logic gate లోని race condition digital system లో శాశ్వత glitch ని ఎందుకు కలిగించవచ్చు? A) ఎందుకంటే system తన design లో తగినంత redundancy ని ఉపయోగించడం లేదు. B) ఎందుకంటే తాత్కాలిక glitch memory elements కి clock signal గా పనిచేస్తే అది propagate అవుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే gate యొక్క Boolean algebra తప్పు. D) ఎందుకంటే logic gates సహజంగానే నమ్మదగినవి కావు మరియు తరచుగా విఫలమవుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a race condition in a logic gate potentially cause a permanent glitch in a digital system? A) Because the system is not using enough redundancy in its design. B) Because a temporary glitch can propagate if it acts as a clock signal for memory elements. C) Because the Boolean algebra of the gate is incorrect. D) Because logic gates are inherently unreliable and often fail. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: In the context of time-series analysis, what does a normalized cross-correlation value of -1 indicate? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the relationship of classes in inheritance often described as a directed acyclic graph (DAG)? A) Because classes can inherit from multiple sources creating cycles B) Because it represents a single, linear line of development C) Because subclasses cannot inherit from their own descendants, preventing infinite loops D) Because it is required to optimize dynamic dispatch tables ANSWER: C

A) ఎందుకంటే classes అనేక sources నుండి inherit చేసుకుని cycles ని సృష్టించగలవు B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒకే, linear అభివృద్ధి రేఖను సూచిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే subclasses తమ స్వంత descendants నుండి inherit చేసుకోలేవు, దీనివల్ల infinite loops నివారించబడతాయి D) ఎందుకంటే dynamic dispatch tables ని optimize చేయడానికి అది అవసరం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the relationship of classes in inheritance often described as a directed acyclic graph (DAG)? A) Because classes can inherit from multiple sources creating cycles B) Because it represents a single, linear line of development C) Because subclasses cannot inherit from their own descendants, preventing infinite loops D) Because it is required to optimize dynamic dispatch tables ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the first principal component defined as a unit vector that maximizes variance? A) To normalize the direction so that only its orientation matters. B) To align with the original data axes. C) To ensure the component has the largest possible magnitude. D) To make the component orthogonal to the second component. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: మొదటి principal component ను variance ను గరిష్ఠం చేసే unit vector గా ఎందుకు నిర్వచిస్తారు? A) దాని orientation మాత్రమే ముఖ్యమయ్యేలా direction ను normalize చేయడానికి. B) Original data axes తో align అవ్వడానికి. C) Component కి సాధ్యమైనంత పెద్ద magnitude ఉండేలా చూడడానికి. D) Component ను రెండో component కి orthogonal గా చేయడానికి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the first principal component defined as a unit vector that maximizes variance? A) To normalize the direction so that only its orientation matters. B) To align with the original data axes. C) To ensure the component has the largest possible magnitude. D) To make the component orthogonal to the second component. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is true about the difference between optical flow and motion estimation? A) Optical flow is only valid for static cameras. B) Optical flow is purely for video compression, while motion estimation is for robotics. C) Optical flow specifically requires machine learning, whereas motion estimation does not. D) Optical flow estimates the 3D structure and scene movement, while motion estimation is a broader field of determining movement. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Optical flow మరియు motion estimation మధ్య తేడా గురించి ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది నిజం? A) Optical flow static cameras కి మాత్రమే చెల్లుతుంది. B) Optical flow కేవలం video compression కోసం, motion estimation robotics కోసం. C) Optical flow కి ప్రత్యేకంగా machine learning అవసరం, motion estimation కి అవసరం లేదు. D) Optical flow 3D structure మరియు scene movement ని అంచనా వేస్తుంది, motion estimation కదలికను నిర్ణయించే విస్తృత రంగం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following is true about the difference between optical flow and motion estimation? A) Optical flow is only valid for static cameras. B) Optical flow is purely for video compression, while motion estimation is for robotics. C) Optical flow specifically requires machine learning, whereas motion estimation does not. D) Optical flow estimates the 3D structure and scene movement, while motion estimation is a broader field of determining movement. ANSWER: D

target: ప్రశ్న: DC content విషయంలో delta-sigma modulation, standard delta modulation ని ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) Low-frequency components ని కాపాడటానికి sampling rate ని పెంచుతుంది. B) DC content ని modulated signal నుండి విడిగా transmit చేస్తుంది. C) DC loss ని నివారించడానికి పెద్ద step size ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. D) Integrator స్థానాన్ని మార్చడం వల్ల signal derivative కి బదులు amplitude ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does delta-sigma modulation improve upon standard delta modulation regarding DC content? A) It increases the sampling rate to preserve low-frequency components. B) It transmits DC content separately from the modulated signal. C) It uses a larger step size to prevent DC loss. D) It rearranges the integrator's position so the signal represents amplitude instead of derivative. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How can the steady-state frequency response of an RLC circuit be directly obtained from its transfer function H(s)? C) Numerator polynomial యొక్క roots కనుగొని వాటిని infinity కి set చేయడం ద్వారా. D) s ను zero కి సమానం చేసి time పై integrate చేయడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How can the steady-state frequency response of an RLC circuit be directly obtained from its transfer function H(s)? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the transfer function considered a primary tool for LTI systems? A) It automatically stabilizes any unstable system. B) It forces all non-linear systems to behave linearly. C) It eliminates the need for any mathematical differential equation analysis. D) It uniquely defines the system's output for any input using a simple multiplication in the transform domain. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: LTI systems కి transfer function ను ప్రధాన tool గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది ఏ unstable system నైనా స్వయంచాలకంగా stabilize చేస్తుంది. B) అది అన్ని non-linear systems ను linear గా ప్రవర్తించేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. C) అది ఎలాంటి గణిత differential equation analysis అవసరాన్నైనా తొలగిస్తుంది. D) Transform domain లో సాధారణ గుణకారం ద్వారా ఏ input కైనా system output ను అది ప్రత్యేకంగా నిర్వచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the transfer function considered a primary tool for LTI systems? A) It automatically stabilizes any unstable system. B) It forces all non-linear systems to behave linearly. C) It eliminates the need for any mathematical differential equation analysis. D) It uniquely defines the system's output for any input using a simple multiplication in the transform domain. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens in an LL parser during a leftmost derivation step? A) The parser ignores non-terminals and only matches terminals. B) Parser మొదట rightmost non-terminal ని expand చేస్తుంది. C) Parser ప్రస్తుతం stack పై ఉన్న leftmost non-terminal ని expand చేస్తుంది. D) Parser ఒక terminal symbol ని non-terminal తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens in an LL parser during a leftmost derivation step? A) The parser ignores non-terminals and only matches terminals. B) The parser expands the rightmost non-terminal first. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a lowpass filter necessary after the expansion step in an integer upsampling process? A) To remove spectral images created by the insertion of zeros during expansion B) To increase the signal amplitude to match the higher sampling rate C) To convert the digital signal back into an analog continuous-time signal D) To shift the phase of the signal so the samples align correctly ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Integer upsampling process లో expansion step తర్వాత lowpass filter ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) Expansion సమయంలో zeros ని చేర్చడం వల్ల ఏర్పడిన spectral images ని తొలగించడానికి B) ఎక్కువ sampling rate కి సరిపోయేలా signal amplitude ని పెంచడానికి C) Digital signal ని తిరిగి analog continuous-time signal గా మార్చడానికి D) Samples సరిగ్గా align అయ్యేలా signal phase ని shift చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a lowpass filter necessary after the expansion step in an integer upsampling process? A) To remove spectral images created by the insertion of zeros during expansion B) To increase the signal amplitude to match the higher sampling rate C) To convert the digital signal back into an analog continuous-time signal D) To shift the phase of the signal so the samples align correctly ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of a set-associative cache design over a direct-mapped cache? A) It uses significantly less power because it does not require tags. B) It reduces the probability of conflict misses by providing multiple slots per set. C) It allows a memory block to be placed in any cache line without restriction. D) It eliminates the need for any replacement policy. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Direct-mapped cache కంటే set-associative cache design యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) దానికి tags అవసరం లేనందున అది గణనీయంగా తక్కువ power ను వాడుతుంది. B) ఒక్కో set కి అనేక slots ను అందించడం ద్వారా conflict misses సంభావ్యతను అది తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) ఒక memory block ను ఎలాంటి పరిమితి లేకుండా ఏ cache line లోనైనా పెట్టడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది. D) అది ఏ replacement policy అవసరాన్నైనా తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of a set-associative cache design over a direct-mapped cache? A) It uses significantly less power because it does not require tags. B) It reduces the probability of conflict misses by providing multiple slots per set. C) It allows a memory block to be placed in any cache line without restriction. D) It eliminates the need for any replacement policy. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the noisy-channel coding theorem state about transmission rates above channel capacity? A) The error probability can be reduced to zero by increasing bandwidth. B) The system achieves perfect reliability with advanced coding. C) The channel becomes completely unusable for any communication. D) The error probability approaches 0.5 as block length goes to infinity. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Channel capacity కంటే ఎక్కువ transmission rates గురించి noisy-channel coding theorem ఏమి చెబుతుంది? A) Bandwidth పెంచడం ద్వారా error probability ని సున్నాకు తగ్గించవచ్చు. B) Advanced coding తో system పూర్తి reliability ని సాధిస్తుంది. C) Channel ఏ communication కీ పూర్తిగా ఉపయోగపడదు. D) Block length infinity కి వెళ్ళేకొద్దీ error probability 0.5 కి చేరుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What does the noisy-channel coding theorem state about transmission rates above channel capacity? A) The error probability can be reduced to zero by increasing bandwidth. B) The system achieves perfect reliability with advanced coding. C) The channel becomes completely unusable for any communication. D) The error probability approaches 0.5 as block length goes to infinity. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes the 'count to infinity' problem in routing? A) Two routers continuously increment the hop count for a destination that is no longer reachable. B) A network loop is formed where packets travel only between two routers indefinitely. C) A router chooses the path with the highest possible number of hops. D) The routing table exceeds the maximum allowed memory storage on a router. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Routing లో 'count to infinity' problem ను ఏ సందర్భం బాగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) ఇకపై చేరలేని ఒక destination కోసం రెండు routers నిరంతరం hop count ను పెంచుతూ ఉంటాయి. B) Packets రెండు routers మధ్య మాత్రమే నిరవధికంగా ప్రయాణించే network loop ఏర్పడుతుంది. C) ఒక router సాధ్యమైనంత ఎక్కువ hops ఉన్న path ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. D) Routing table router పై అనుమతించిన maximum memory storage ను మించిపోతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes the 'count to infinity' problem in routing? A) Two routers continuously increment the hop count for a destination that is no longer reachable. B) A network loop is formed where packets travel only between two routers indefinitely. C) A router chooses the path with the highest possible number of hops. D) The routing table exceeds the maximum allowed memory storage on a router. ANSWER: A

A) ఉపయోగించే మొత్తం logic gates సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా B) Addition ని subtraction process గా మార్చడం ద్వారా C) Digital gates కి బదులు analog summing amplifiers ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా D) Generate మరియు propagate signals ఉపయోగించి అన్ని bit positions కి carries ని parallel గా లెక్కించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why were early ARM designs limited to a 26-bit address space rather than using the full 32-bit capacity of the register? B) Instruction set architecture కి floating-point లెక్కల కోసం అదనపు bits అవసరమయ్యాయి. C) తొలి ARM processors 8-bit systems కోసం ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించబడ్డాయి, అవి 32-bit addressing ను support చేయలేవు. D) Program counter మరియు processor status flags ఒకే 32-bit register ను పంచుకోవడానికి వీలుగా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why were early ARM designs limited to a 26-bit address space rather than using the full 32-bit capacity of the register? A) Because 32-bit memory was significantly more expensive to manufacture in the 1980s. B) The instruction set architecture required the extra bits for floating-point calculations. C) Early ARM processors were specifically designed for 8-bit systems, which cannot support 32-bit addressing. input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key benefit of using iterative deepening with alpha-beta pruning? A) It provides move-ordering hints from shallower searches for deeper ones. B) అది heuristic evaluation functions అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. C) తక్కువ nodes లో optimal move ని కనుగొంటుందని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) అది search యొక్క space complexity ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is a key benefit of using iterative deepening with alpha-beta pruning? A) It provides move-ordering hints from shallower searches for deeper ones. B) It eliminates the need for heuristic evaluation functions. C) It guarantees finding the optimal move in fewer nodes. D) It reduces the space complexity of the search. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a larger value of k reduce the effect of noise on classification accuracy? A) It forces the algorithm to use only the single closest training sample. D) It increases the computational complexity of the distance calculations. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: k యొక్క పెద్ద value classification accuracy పై noise ప్రభావాన్ని ఎందుకు తగ్గించవచ్చు? A) అది algorithm ను ఒకే దగ్గరి training sample ను మాత్రమే వాడేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. B) అది ఎక్కువ neighbors పై average తీసుకుంటుంది, దాంతో ఏ ఒక్క noisy point ప్రభావమైనా తగ్గుతుంది. C) అది classes మధ్య decision boundaries ను మరింత స్పష్టంగా, సంక్లిష్టంగా చేస్తుంది. D) అది distance calculations యొక్క computational complexity ని పెంచుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why might a larger value of k reduce the effect of noise on classification accuracy? A) It forces the algorithm to use only the single closest training sample. B) It averages over more neighbors, reducing the influence of any single noisy point. C) It makes the decision boundaries between classes more distinct and complex. D) It increases the computational complexity of the distance calculations. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How do channels provide an alternative to explicit naming in the producer-consumer problem? A) By requiring each process to have a unique identifier for every communication instance. B) By eliminating the need for any synchronization mechanisms between processes. C) By allowing processes to communicate through a named port without specifying the exact source or destination. D) By using global variables to store data instead of named ports. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Producer-consumer problem లో explicit naming కి channels ఎలా ప్రత్యామ్నాయాన్ని అందిస్తాయి? A) ప్రతి communication instance కి ప్రతి process కి unique identifier ఉండాలని కోరడం ద్వారా. B) Processes మధ్య ఎలాంటి synchronization mechanisms అవసరం లేకుండా చేయడం ద్వారా. C) కచ్చితమైన source లేదా destination ని పేర్కొనకుండా named port ద్వారా processes communicate చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం ద్వారా. D) Named ports కి బదులు data ని store చేయడానికి global variables ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How do channels provide an alternative to explicit naming in the producer-consumer problem? A) By requiring each process to have a unique identifier for every communication instance. B) By eliminating the need for any synchronization mechanisms between processes. C) By allowing processes to communicate through a named port without specifying the exact source or destination. D) By using global variables to store data instead of named ports. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a clamping circuit differ from a clipping circuit? target: ప్రశ్న: Clamping circuit, clipping circuit నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Clamping peak-to-peak excursion ను మార్చకుండా DC level ను shift చేస్తుంది, అయితే clipping waveform లోని భాగాలను తొలగిస్తుంది B) Clamping కేవలం AC signals తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది, clipping కేవలం DC signals తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది C) Clamping peak-to-peak excursion ను పరిమితం చేస్తుంది, clipping చేయదు D) ఎలాంటి తేడా లేదు; రెండు పదాలు ఒకే electronic function ను వివరిస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does a clamping circuit differ from a clipping circuit? A) Clamping shifts the DC level while preserving peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping removes parts of the waveform B) Clamping only works with AC signals, while clipping only works with DC signals C) Clamping restricts peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping does not D) There is no difference; both terms describe the same electronic function ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is the primary distinction between fluid statics and fluid dynamics? A) Fluid statics only applies to gases, while fluid dynamics applies only to liquids. target: ప్రశ్న: Fluid statics మరియు fluid dynamics మధ్య ప్రధాన తేడా ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) Fluid statics gases కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది, fluid dynamics liquids కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది. B) Fluid statics నిశ్చలంగా ఉన్న fluids ని అధ్యయనం చేస్తుంది, fluid dynamics fluid motion పై forces ప్రభావాన్ని అధ్యయనం చేస్తుంది. C) Fluid statics physics లో ఒక శాఖ, కానీ fluid dynamics కేవలం engineering. D) Fluid statics density ని పట్టించుకోదు, fluid dynamics దాన్ని చేర్చుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is the primary distinction between fluid statics and fluid dynamics? A) Fluid statics only applies to gases, while fluid dynamics applies only to liquids. B) Fluid statics studies fluids at rest, whereas fluid dynamics studies the effect of forces on fluid motion. C) Fluid statics is a branch of physics, but fluid dynamics is only engineering. D) Fluid statics ignores density, while fluid dynamics includes it. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is RSA considered a public-key cryptosystem? target: ప్రశ్న: RSA ను public-key cryptosystem గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే దానిని అనేక researchers ఒకేసారి అభివృద్ధి చేశారు B) ఎందుకంటే అది symmetric key exchange protocols ను వాడుతుంది C) ఎందుకంటే encryption మరియు decryption రెండింటికీ ఒకే key వాడతారు D) ఎందుకంటే అది పెద్ద prime numbers ను factor చేయడంలో ఉన్న కష్టంపై ఆధారపడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is RSA considered a public-key cryptosystem? A) Because it was developed by multiple researchers simultaneously B) Because it uses symmetric key exchange protocols C) Because the same key is used for both encryption and decryption D) Because it relies on the difficulty of factoring large prime numbers ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary responsibility of a Proposer in the Paxos protocol? A) To ensure the network delivers messages without corruption or duplication. B) To receive and store the final chosen value from the Acceptors. C) To act as a stable storage for rejoining processors after a crash. D) To initiate the consensus process by sending a Prepare message to Acceptors. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Paxos protocol లో Proposer యొక్క ప్రధాన బాధ్యత ఏమిటి? A) Network messages ని corruption లేదా duplication లేకుండా deliver చేసేలా చూడటం. B) Acceptors నుండి చివరగా ఎంచుకున్న value ని అందుకుని store చేయడం. C) Crash తర్వాత తిరిగి చేరే processors కి stable storage గా పనిచేయడం. D) Acceptors కి Prepare message పంపడం ద్వారా consensus process ని ప్రారంభించడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary responsibility of a Proposer in the Paxos protocol? A) To ensure the network delivers messages without corruption or duplication. B) To receive and store the final chosen value from the Acceptors. C) To act as a stable storage for rejoining processors after a crash. D) To initiate the consensus process by sending a Prepare message to Acceptors. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the reject procedure in a backtracking algorithm? target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the reject procedure in a backtracking algorithm? A) To report a valid solution to the user B) To find the first valid solution quickly C) To prune branches of the search tree that cannot lead to valid solutions D) To generate the next extension of a partial candidate ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Miller effect influence the bandwidth of a common-emitter amplifier? A) It has no effect on bandwidth as it only affects output impedance. B) It decreases bandwidth by increasing the effective input capacitance. C) It increases bandwidth by reducing input capacitance. D) It increases bandwidth by providing positive feedback. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Common-emitter amplifier యొక్క bandwidth ను Miller effect ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది output impedance ను మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది కాబట్టి bandwidth పై ప్రభావం ఉండదు. B) Effective input capacitance ను పెంచడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Input capacitance ను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను పెంచుతుంది. D) Positive feedback ను అందించడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను పెంచుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the Miller effect influence the bandwidth of a common-emitter amplifier? A) It has no effect on bandwidth as it only affects output impedance. B) It decreases bandwidth by increasing the effective input capacitance. C) It increases bandwidth by reducing input capacitance. D) It increases bandwidth by providing positive feedback. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a purely inductive load affect the relationship between voltage and current in an AC circuit? A) Current waveform becomes non-sinusoidal and distorted. D) Current voltage కంటే 90 degrees phase angle తో వెనుక ఉంటుంది (lags). జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a purely inductive load affect the relationship between voltage and current in an AC circuit? A) Current waveform becomes non-sinusoidal and distorted. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is feature engineering a critical preprocessing step in supervised machine learning? A) It automates the selection of deep learning architectures for the given dataset B) It replaces the need for domain expertise by generating features algorithmically C) It transforms raw data into informative inputs that significantly enhance model predictive accuracy D) It reduces the dimensionality of the feature space by removing all redundant features ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Supervised machine learning లో feature engineering ఎందుకు ఒక కీలకమైన preprocessing step? A) ఇచ్చిన dataset కోసం deep learning architectures ఎంపికను ఇది స్వయంచాలకం చేస్తుంది B) Features ను algorithmic గా generate చేయడం ద్వారా domain expertise అవసరాన్ని ఇది తొలగిస్తుంది C) ఇది raw data ను model యొక్క predictive accuracy ని గణనీయంగా పెంచే సమాచారపూర్వక inputs గా మారుస్తుంది D) అన్ని redundant features ను తొలగించడం ద్వారా ఇది feature space యొక్క dimensionality ని తగ్గిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is feature engineering a critical preprocessing step in supervised machine learning? A) It automates the selection of deep learning architectures for the given dataset B) It replaces the need for domain expertise by generating features algorithmically C) It transforms raw data into informative inputs that significantly enhance model predictive accuracy D) It reduces the dimensionality of the feature space by removing all redundant features ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do block ciphers process plaintext compared to stream ciphers? A) They are inherently faster than stream ciphers for all data types. D) They require the plaintext to be a multiple of the block size, processing multiple bits as a single unit. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Stream ciphers తో పోలిస్తే block ciphers plaintext ని ఎలా process చేస్తాయి? A) అన్ని data types కి అవి సహజంగానే stream ciphers కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయి. D) Plaintext block size యొక్క multiple గా ఉండాలి, అనేక bits ని ఒకే unit గా process చేస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How do block ciphers process plaintext compared to stream ciphers? A) They are inherently faster than stream ciphers for all data types. B) They do not require any key to function, unlike stream ciphers. C) They encrypt characters one by one in a continuous stream. D) They require the plaintext to be a multiple of the block size, processing multiple bits as a single unit. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: According to BCS theory, how do two negatively charged electrons form an attractive Cooper pair? A) Through the magnetic attraction of their perfectly aligned parallel spins. B) Positive ion lattice లోని deformations (phonons) ద్వారా జరిగే పరోక్ష interaction ద్వారా. C) కాంతి వేగానికి దగ్గరగా కదులుతున్నప్పుడు ప్రత్యక్ష electrostatic Coulomb attraction ద్వారా. D) Cryogenic పరిస్థితుల వల్ల తీవ్రమైన gravitational attraction ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to BCS theory, how do two negatively charged electrons form an attractive Cooper pair? A) Through the magnetic attraction of their perfectly aligned parallel spins. B) Through an indirect interaction mediated by deformations in the positive ion lattice (phonons). C) By direct electrostatic Coulomb attraction when moving close to the speed of light. input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition is a material classified as linear? A) When the stress-strain curve is linear for all possible loads B) When the material has a high Poisson's ratio C) When the range of valid Hooke's law is large compared to typical applied stresses D) When the material is isotropic in all directions ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో ఒక material ని linear గా వర్గీకరిస్తారు? A) అన్ని సాధ్యమైన loads కి stress-strain curve linear గా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) Material కి ఎక్కువ Poisson's ratio ఉన్నప్పుడు C) సాధారణంగా ప్రయోగించే stresses తో పోలిస్తే Hooke's law చెల్లుబాటు అయ్యే range పెద్దదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Material అన్ని దిశలలో isotropic గా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Under what condition is a material classified as linear? A) When the stress-strain curve is linear for all possible loads B) When the material has a high Poisson's ratio C) When the range of valid Hooke's law is large compared to typical applied stresses D) When the material is isotropic in all directions ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the electronic transport band gap differ from the optical band gap in semiconductors? A) Both gaps are always identical because Coulomb attraction between charge carriers is negligible in all solids. B) The electronic transport gap is larger by an amount equal to the exciton binding energy. C) The optical band gap is larger because photons carry more momentum than phonons. D) The electronic transport gap accounts only for thermal phonon transitions without generating free carriers. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Semiconductors లో electronic transport band gap optical band gap నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అన్ని solids లో charge carriers మధ్య Coulomb attraction నామమాత్రం కాబట్టి రెండు gaps ఎప్పుడూ ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి. B) Electronic transport gap exciton binding energy కి సమానమైన మొత్తంలో పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. C) Photons phonons కంటే ఎక్కువ momentum ను కలిగి ఉంటాయి కాబట్టి optical band gap పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. D) Electronic transport gap free carriers ను generate చేయకుండా thermal phonon transitions ను మాత్రమే పరిగణిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the electronic transport band gap differ from the optical band gap in semiconductors? A) Both gaps are always identical because Coulomb attraction between charge carriers is negligible in all solids. B) The electronic transport gap is larger by an amount equal to the exciton binding energy. C) The optical band gap is larger because photons carry more momentum than phonons. D) The electronic transport gap accounts only for thermal phonon transitions without generating free carriers. ANSWER: B

D) Infinite గా నడపకుండా finite సంఖ్యలో iterations తర్వాత process ను ఆపడం. జవాబు: D

D) Mid-tread quantizer ఎలాంటి quantization noise ను కలిగించదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary characteristic that distinguishes a mid-tread quantizer from a mid-riser quantizer? A) The mid-tread quantizer is exclusively used for non-linear quantization. input: to Telugu: Q: Why must developers be cautious when using caches with Memory-mapped I/O? A) Caches are always too slow to access I/O devices. D) Caches can reorder writes, potentially causing peripheral registers to be accessed in the wrong order. ANSWER: D

B) I/O devices తో communicate చేసేటప్పుడు caches చాలా ఎక్కువ power ను వినియోగిస్తాయి. C) Caches direct memory access (DMA) పనిచేయకుండా నిరోధిస్తాయి. D) Caches writes ను reorder చేయగలవు, దాని వల్ల peripheral registers తప్పు క్రమంలో access కావచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why must developers be cautious when using caches with Memory-mapped I/O? A) Caches are always too slow to access I/O devices. B) Caches consume too much power when communicating with I/O devices. C) Caches prevent direct memory access (DMA) from functioning. D) Caches can reorder writes, potentially causing peripheral registers to be accessed in the wrong order. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the product of two distinct phasors generally not represented as a standard single-frequency phasor? A) Multiplying sinusoids in time yields sum and difference frequencies, violating single-frequency assumptions B) The angle of the resulting phasor would become undefined in the complex plane C) Multiplying complex numbers alters the RMS values unpredictably D) Phasors can only be multiplied by purely real scalar values ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: రెండు వేర్వేరు phasors యొక్క product ను సాధారణంగా ఒక standard single-frequency phasor గా ఎందుకు సూచించలేము? A) Time లో sinusoids ను గుణిస్తే sum మరియు difference frequencies వస్తాయి, ఇది single-frequency assumption ను ఉల్లంఘిస్తుంది B) వచ్చే phasor యొక్క angle complex plane లో undefined అవుతుంది C) Complex numbers ను గుణిస్తే RMS values అనూహ్యంగా మారుతాయి D) Phasors ను కేవలం purely real scalar values తో మాత్రమే గుణించగలం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the product of two distinct phasors generally not represented as a standard single-frequency phasor? A) Multiplying sinusoids in time yields sum and difference frequencies, violating single-frequency assumptions B) The angle of the resulting phasor would become undefined in the complex plane C) Multiplying complex numbers alters the RMS values unpredictably D) Phasors can only be multiplied by purely real scalar values ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the effective resistance of a conductor increase as the frequency of an alternating current increases? A) The number of electrons moving through the wire decreases B) The length of the conductor effectively increases C) The resistivity of the material changes with frequency D) The cross-sectional area effectively carrying current decreases ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Alternating current యొక్క frequency పెరిగేకొద్దీ conductor యొక్క effective resistance ఎందుకు పెరుగుతుంది? A) Wire ద్వారా కదిలే electrons సంఖ్య తగ్గుతుంది B) Conductor యొక్క length ప్రభావవంతంగా పెరుగుతుంది C) Material యొక్క resistivity frequency తో మారుతుంది D) Current ని మోసే effective cross-sectional area తగ్గుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does the effective resistance of a conductor increase as the frequency of an alternating current increases? A) The number of electrons moving through the wire decreases B) The length of the conductor effectively increases C) The resistivity of the material changes with frequency D) The cross-sectional area effectively carrying current decreases ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of the BM25 algorithm, what is the primary role of the IDF component? A) To rank documents based solely on their total word length. B) To count how many times a term appears in one document. C) To determine the number of documents in the collection. D) To assign higher weights to rare, informative terms and lower weights to common, non-informative terms. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: BM25 algorithm సందర్భంలో IDF component యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Documents ను వాటి మొత్తం word length ఆధారంగా మాత్రమే rank చేయడం. B) ఒక document లో ఒక term ఎన్నిసార్లు కనిపిస్తుందో లెక్కించడం. C) Collection లోని documents సంఖ్యను నిర్ణయించడం. D) అరుదైన, సమాచారం ఉన్న terms కి ఎక్కువ weights ను, సాధారణ, సమాచారం లేని terms కి తక్కువ weights ను కేటాయించడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of the BM25 algorithm, what is the primary role of the IDF component? A) To rank documents based solely on their total word length. B) To count how many times a term appears in one document. C) To determine the number of documents in the collection. D) To assign higher weights to rare, informative terms and lower weights to common, non-informative terms. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes a cache hit during a processor memory access operation? A) The cache evicts an old entry to make room for new data. B) The CPU fetches data from the main memory after a stall. C) The CPU finds the requested data address already stored in the cache memory. D) The CPU successfully writes new data to the main memory via the cache. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Processor memory access operation సమయంలో cache hit ని ఏ సందర్భం ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) కొత్త data కి చోటు కల్పించడానికి cache ఒక పాత entry ని evict చేస్తుంది. B) Stall తర్వాత CPU main memory నుండి data ని fetch చేస్తుంది. C) Request చేసిన data address ఇప్పటికే cache memory లో store చేయబడి ఉన్నట్లు CPU కనుగొంటుంది. D) CPU cache ద్వారా main memory కి కొత్త data ని విజయవంతంగా write చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes a cache hit during a processor memory access operation? A) The cache evicts an old entry to make room for new data. B) The CPU fetches data from the main memory after a stall. C) The CPU finds the requested data address already stored in the cache memory. D) The CPU successfully writes new data to the main memory via the cache. ANSWER: C

D) ఇది master node మాత్రమే drive చేసే unidirectional line. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does the Serial clock line (SCL) function on an I2C bus? A) It is a bidirectional line that is driven low by the master and pulled high by resistors. B) It is a dedicated line that carries only clock signals and no data. C) It is a bidirectional line that is pulled high and driven low by nodes. input: to Telugu: Q: What geometric feature corresponds to the next iterate x_{n+1} in Newton's method? target: ప్రశ్న: Newton's method లో తదుపరి iterate x_{n+1} కి ఏ geometric లక్షణం అనుగుణంగా ఉంటుంది? A) x_n మరియు నిజమైన root మధ్య midpoint B) x_n వద్ద f(x) కి tangent line యొక్క x-intercept C) x_{n-1} మరియు x_n మధ్య secant line యొక్క local extremum D) x_n వద్ద evaluate చేసిన normal line యొక్క y-intercept జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What geometric feature corresponds to the next iterate x_{n+1} in Newton's method? D) బయటి hardware ను మాత్రమే వాడి internal microcode వాడకాన్ని అది పూర్తిగా నివారిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B

A) అది output ను infinity కి explode చేస్తుంది B) అది network ను అన్ని points వద్ద non-differentiable చేస్తుంది C) దాని వల్ల neurons non-zero values ను output చేయడం ఆపేస్తాయి, మొత్తం gradient flow ఆగిపోతుంది D) అది అనవసరంగా network ను zero-centered గా మారేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the 'Dying ReLU' problem considered a significant issue in training deep neural networks? target_en: Q: Under what condition can the superposition principle be applied to analyze a physical system? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is IP described as a connectionless protocol? A) It only operates at the transport layer of the network model. target_en: Q: Why is IP described as a connectionless protocol? A) It only operates at the transport layer of the network model. target_en: Q: What is the primary reason an LTI system can be completely characterized by its impulse response? A) It has a constant output regardless of input B) It is a non-linear system C) It only reacts to single frequencies D) It allows for the use of superposition and time-shifting ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the back-off mechanism in CSMA/CD help manage network traffic? A) By synchronizing all stations to transmit at the same time B) By having stations wait a random time proportional to the number of collisions before retrying C) By permanently blocking stations that collide frequently D) By increasing the jam signal length after each collision ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: CSMA/CD లోని back-off mechanism network traffic ను నిర్వహించడంలో ఎలా సహాయపడుతుంది? A) అన్ని stations ఒకేసారి transmit చేసేలా synchronize చేయడం ద్వారా B) మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించే ముందు collisions సంఖ్యకు అనుపాతంలో stations random సమయం ఎదురుచూసేలా చేయడం ద్వారా C) తరచుగా collide అయ్యే stations ను శాశ్వతంగా block చేయడం ద్వారా D) ప్రతి collision తర్వాత jam signal length ను పెంచడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the back-off mechanism in CSMA/CD help manage network traffic? A) By synchronizing all stations to transmit at the same time B) By having stations wait a random time proportional to the number of collisions before retrying C) By permanently blocking stations that collide frequently D) By increasing the jam signal length after each collision ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the non-recursive implementation of DFS typically differ from the recursive version in terms of neighbor visitation? A) Adjacency list కి సంబంధించి అది neighbors ని వ్యతిరేక క్రమంలో visit చేస్తుంది B) అది stacks కి బదులు queues ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒక constant factor తో వేగంగా ఉంటుంది D) Connected graph లోని అన్ని vertices ని అది traverse చేయలేదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does the non-recursive implementation of DFS typically differ from the recursive version in terms of neighbor visitation? A) It visits neighbors in the opposite order relative to the adjacency list B) It uses queues instead of stacks C) It is always faster by a constant factor D) It cannot traverse all vertices in a connected graph ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must an anti-aliasing filter be an analog filter placed before the sampler rather than a digital filter placed after? A) Digital-to-analog converters cannot process discrete data without pre-filtering B) Analog filters consume far less computational power than digital finite impulse response filters C) Once sampling occurs, aliases irrevocably overlap the original spectrum and cannot be separated digitally D) Digital filters introduce phase delays that cause spectral inversion ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Anti-aliasing filter sampler తర్వాత పెట్టే digital filter కాకుండా ముందు పెట్టే analog filter ఎందుకు కావాలి? A) Pre-filtering లేకుండా digital-to-analog converters discrete data ను process చేయలేవు B) Digital finite impulse response filters కంటే analog filters చాలా తక్కువ computational power ను వినియోగిస్తాయి C) Sampling జరిగిన తర్వాత aliases అసలు spectrum తో తిరిగి మార్చలేని విధంగా overlap అవుతాయి, వాటిని digital గా వేరు చేయలేము D) Digital filters spectral inversion కి కారణమయ్యే phase delays ను కలిగిస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why must an anti-aliasing filter be an analog filter placed before the sampler rather than a digital filter placed after? A) Digital-to-analog converters cannot process discrete data without pre-filtering B) Analog filters consume far less computational power than digital finite impulse response filters C) Once sampling occurs, aliases irrevocably overlap the original spectrum and cannot be separated digitally D) Digital filters introduce phase delays that cause spectral inversion ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is image padding performed before Fourier domain filtering? A) To increase the image size for better quality B) To convert the image to grayscale C) To apply convolution directly in the spatial domain D) To prevent artificial edge artifacts caused by the Fourier transform ANSWER: D

A) మెరుగైన quality కోసం image size ని పెంచడానికి B) Image ని grayscale గా మార్చడానికి C) Spatial domain లో నేరుగా convolution ని apply చేయడానికి D) Fourier transform వల్ల కలిగే కృత్రిమ edge artifacts ని నివారించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is image padding performed before Fourier domain filtering? A) To increase the image size for better quality B) To convert the image to grayscale C) To apply convolution directly in the spatial domain D) To prevent artificial edge artifacts caused by the Fourier transform ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does Green's theorem relate directly to Stokes' theorem? A) It applies only to irrotational electric fields in three dimensions. B) It replaces the line integral with a closed volume integral. C) It is the divergence theorem applied strictly to spherical surfaces. D) It is Stokes' theorem specialized to a flat surface lying in the xy-plane. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Green's theorem కి Stokes' theorem తో ప్రత్యక్ష సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) అది మూడు dimensions లోని irrotational electric fields కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది. B) అది line integral ను closed volume integral తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. C) అది spherical surfaces కి మాత్రమే apply చేసిన divergence theorem. D) అది xy-plane లో ఉన్న flat surface కి ప్రత్యేకించిన Stokes' theorem. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does Green's theorem relate directly to Stokes' theorem? A) It applies only to irrotational electric fields in three dimensions. B) It replaces the line integral with a closed volume integral. C) It is the divergence theorem applied strictly to spherical surfaces. D) It is Stokes' theorem specialized to a flat surface lying in the xy-plane. ANSWER: D
