input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is true according to the Wiener–Khinchin theorem? A) The autocorrelation is equivalent to the Fourier transform of the signal. B) The autocorrelation and power spectral density are Fourier transform pairs. C) The autocorrelation matrix is always a diagonal matrix. D) The theorem only applies to deterministic signals. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Wiener–Khinchin theorem ప్రకారం కింది వాటిలో ఏది నిజం? A) Autocorrelation అనేది signal యొక్క Fourier transform కు సమానం. B) Autocorrelation మరియు power spectral density లు Fourier transform pairs. C) Autocorrelation matrix ఎల్లప్పుడూ diagonal matrix అవుతుంది. D) ఈ theorem కేవలం deterministic signals కే వర్తిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is true according to the Wiener–Khinchin theorem? A) The autocorrelation is equivalent to the Fourier transform of the signal. B) The autocorrelation and power spectral density are Fourier transform pairs. C) The autocorrelation matrix is always a diagonal matrix. D) The theorem only applies to deterministic signals. ANSWER: B

D) అన్ని programs halt అవుతాయని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary consequence of a programming language being Turing-complete? A) It means the halting problem is decidable for that language. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Minimax algorithm primarily used in two-player zero-sum games? A) It allows players to collaborate to reach a higher shared total B) It guarantees a win every single time regardless of the opponent C) It provides a strategy that minimizes the maximum possible loss against an optimal opponent D) It eliminates the need for calculating heuristic values at leaf nodes ANSWER: C

A) ఎక్కువ shared total సాధించడానికి players కలిసి పనిచేయడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది B) Opponent ఎవరైనా ప్రతిసారీ గెలుపుకి హామీ ఇస్తుంది C) Optimal opponent కి వ్యతిరేకంగా గరిష్ట సాధ్యమైన నష్టాన్ని minimize చేసే strategy ని అందిస్తుంది D) Leaf nodes వద్ద heuristic values లెక్కించాల్సిన అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the Minimax algorithm primarily used in two-player zero-sum games? A) It allows players to collaborate to reach a higher shared total B) It guarantees a win every single time regardless of the opponent C) It provides a strategy that minimizes the maximum possible loss against an optimal opponent D) It eliminates the need for calculating heuristic values at leaf nodes ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: Why did the statistical approach in NLP lead to an end of the AI winter? A) It used machine learning to find patterns in large corpora, proving more effective. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it critical for a database management system to treat a transaction as a single unit of work? A) To allow users to bypass security protocols while performing large updates. B) To ensure that individual operations within the unit are executed at different times to save memory. C) To increase the speed of hardware processing by ignoring data validation rules. D) To prevent partial data updates and maintain database consistency during unexpected system failures. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Database management system ఒక transaction ను ఒకే unit of work గా పరిగణించడం ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) పెద్ద updates చేసేటప్పుడు users security protocols ను దాటవేయడానికి వీలుగా. B) Memory ఆదా చేయడానికి unit లోని వ్యక్తిగత operations వేర్వేరు సమయాల్లో execute అయ్యేలా చూడడానికి. C) Data validation rules ను పట్టించుకోకుండా hardware processing వేగాన్ని పెంచడానికి. D) అనుకోని system failures సమయంలో partial data updates ను నిరోధించి database consistency ని కాపాడడానికి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is it critical for a database management system to treat a transaction as a single unit of work? A) To allow users to bypass security protocols while performing large updates. B) To ensure that individual operations within the unit are executed at different times to save memory. C) To increase the speed of hardware processing by ignoring data validation rules. D) To prevent partial data updates and maintain database consistency during unexpected system failures. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the use of pointers considered efficient for traversing large data structures like linked lists compared to copying the data? A) It prevents memory fragmentation within the operating system. B) It avoids the time and memory overhead of copying the actual data payload. C) It allows the CPU to bypass the cache entirely during access. D) It automatically reduces the total number of elements in the data structure. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Data ని copy చేయడంతో పోలిస్తే linked lists వంటి పెద్ద data structures ని traverse చేయడానికి pointers ఉపయోగించడం ఎందుకు సమర్థవంతం? A) అది operating system లో memory fragmentation ని నివారిస్తుంది. B) అసలు data payload ని copy చేసే time మరియు memory overhead ని అది తప్పిస్తుంది. C) Access సమయంలో CPU cache ని పూర్తిగా bypass చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) అది data structure లోని మొత్తం elements సంఖ్యను automatic గా తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the use of pointers considered efficient for traversing large data structures like linked lists compared to copying the data? A) It prevents memory fragmentation within the operating system. B) It avoids the time and memory overhead of copying the actual data payload. C) It allows the CPU to bypass the cache entirely during access. D) It automatically reduces the total number of elements in the data structure. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: Why is thermal noise approximated as additive white Gaussian noise in communication models? target_en: Q: According to the robustness principle, how should a protocol implementation behave? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary clinical advantage of using a 12-lead ECG over a single-lead ECG? A) It records the ECG signal for a longer duration, such as 24 hours. D) అది అనేక planes లో గుండె యొక్క electrical activity గురించి సమగ్ర దృశ్యాన్ని అందిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary clinical advantage of using a 12-lead ECG over a single-lead ECG? A) It records the ECG signal for a longer duration, such as 24 hours. B) It uses fewer electrodes, making the setup faster and more comfortable. C) It is the only type of ECG that can detect myocardial ischemia. D) It provides a comprehensive view of the heart's electrical activity in multiple planes. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under which condition does the third case of the master theorem apply to a recurrence relation? target_en: Q: Under which condition does the third case of the master theorem apply to a recurrence relation? input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary benefit of using a high-level assembler over a traditional one? target_en: Q: What is a primary benefit of using a high-level assembler over a traditional one? A) It directly generates machine code without any translation step B) It requires no knowledge of the underlying machine architecture C) It eliminates the need for an assembler program entirely D) It allows for the use of advanced programming constructs like functions and control structures ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the ARM philosophy toward hardware-software interaction compare to traditional CISC architectures? A) ARM integrates all possible peripheral functions into the hardware to remove software dependency. B) ARM relies solely on software to manage memory, whereas CISC uses hardware only. C) ARM designs are identical to CISC designs, just with a different marketing name. D) ARM generally prefers simplicity in instructions, pushing more complex logic into software when possible. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hardware-software interaction పట్ల ARM దృక్పథం సాంప్రదాయ CISC architectures తో ఎలా పోలుస్తుంది? A) Software dependency ని తొలగించడానికి ARM సాధ్యమైన అన్ని peripheral functions ను hardware లో integrate చేస్తుంది. B) Memory ని నిర్వహించడానికి ARM కేవలం software పై ఆధారపడుతుంది, CISC hardware ను మాత్రమే వాడుతుంది. C) ARM designs CISC designs తో ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి, కేవలం వేరే marketing పేరుతో. D) ARM సాధారణంగా instructions లో సరళతను ఇష్టపడుతుంది, సాధ్యమైనప్పుడు సంక్లిష్ట logic ను software లోకి నెడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does the ARM philosophy toward hardware-software interaction compare to traditional CISC architectures? A) ARM integrates all possible peripheral functions into the hardware to remove software dependency. B) ARM relies solely on software to manage memory, whereas CISC uses hardware only. C) ARM designs are identical to CISC designs, just with a different marketing name. D) ARM generally prefers simplicity in instructions, pushing more complex logic into software when possible. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the time-independent Schrödinger equation take the mathematical form of an eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ? A) Because quantum mechanics strictly forbids any variation of physical states with spatial coordinates. B) Because the Hamiltonian acting on an energy eigenstate yields the state scaled by its total energy value. C) Because the wave function must decay exponentially to zero at infinite time boundaries. D) Because kinetic energy and potential energy must remain identically equal at all spatial coordinates. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Time-independent Schrödinger equation eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ యొక్క గణిత రూపాన్ని ఎందుకు తీసుకుంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే spatial coordinates తో physical states మారడాన్ని quantum mechanics ఖచ్చితంగా నిషేధిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే energy eigenstate పై పనిచేసే Hamiltonian ఆ state ను దాని మొత్తం energy value తో scale చేసి ఇస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే wave function infinite time boundaries వద్ద exponential గా zero కి decay అవ్వాలి. D) ఎందుకంటే అన్ని spatial coordinates వద్ద kinetic energy మరియు potential energy ఒకేలా సమానంగా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the time-independent Schrödinger equation take the mathematical form of an eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ? A) Because quantum mechanics strictly forbids any variation of physical states with spatial coordinates. B) Because the Hamiltonian acting on an energy eigenstate yields the state scaled by its total energy value. C) Because the wave function must decay exponentially to zero at infinite time boundaries. D) Because kinetic energy and potential energy must remain identically equal at all spatial coordinates. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Divergence Theorem simplify the calculation of flux across a complicated closed surface? A) It replaces the vector field with an equivalent constant scalar field. B) It converts the boundary surface integral into a volume integral of divergence over the enclosed region. C) It projects the surface into a 1D line integral along the perimeter. D) It restricts evaluation to only the points where the outward unit normal is constant. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: సంక్లిష్టమైన closed surface గుండా flux లెక్కింపును Divergence Theorem ఎలా సరళీకరిస్తుంది? A) ఇది vector field ను సమానమైన స్థిర scalar field తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. B) ఇది boundary surface integral ను, లోపల ఉన్న ప్రాంతంపై divergence యొక్క volume integral గా మారుస్తుంది. C) ఇది surface ను perimeter వెంబడి 1D line integral గా project చేస్తుంది. D) ఇది outward unit normal స్థిరంగా ఉన్న points వద్ద మాత్రమే evaluation ను పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the Divergence Theorem simplify the calculation of flux across a complicated closed surface? A) It replaces the vector field with an equivalent constant scalar field. B) It converts the boundary surface integral into a volume integral of divergence over the enclosed region. C) It projects the surface into a 1D line integral along the perimeter. D) It restricts evaluation to only the points where the outward unit normal is constant. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the fully connected topology of an MLP less practical for high-dimensional inputs like images? D) It prevents the use of nonlinear activation functions. ANSWER: A

A) Parameters సంఖ్య quadratic గా పెరుగుతుంది, దాంతో memory మరియు computational costs ఎక్కువవుతాయి. B) అది image data ను అసలు process చేయలేదు. C) దానికి linear activation function అవసరం. D) అది nonlinear activation functions వాడకాన్ని నిరోధిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the fully connected topology of an MLP less practical for high-dimensional inputs like images? A) The number of parameters grows quadratically, leading to high memory and computational costs. B) It cannot process image data at all. C) It requires a linear activation function. D) It prevents the use of nonlinear activation functions. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the complex conjugate of current (I*) used in the complex power formula S = V · I*? A) To ensure inductive loads with lagging current yield a positive reactive power Q B) Because current cannot be expressed directly as a phasor C) To invert the phase of voltage relative to the reference bus D) To prevent the apparent power from becoming an imaginary number ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex power formula S = V · I* లో current యొక్క complex conjugate (I*) ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) Lagging current ఉన్న inductive loads positive reactive power Q ఇచ్చేలా చూడడానికి B) Current ను నేరుగా phasor గా వ్యక్తపరచలేము కాబట్టి C) Reference bus తో పోలిస్తే voltage phase ను invert చేయడానికి D) Apparent power imaginary number కాకుండా నిరోధించడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the complex conjugate of current (I*) used in the complex power formula S = V · I*? target_en: Q: Which mathematical condition satisfies the approximation needed for Fraunhofer diffraction? input: to Telugu: Q: In a control system, how is the error signal mathematically derived? A) By multiplying the set point by the system gain. D) By integrating the feedback signal over a specific time interval. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: In a control system, how is the error signal mathematically derived? A) By multiplying the set point by the system gain. B) By summing the output signal and the disturbance signal. C) By calculating the difference between the target set point and the measured output. D) By integrating the feedback signal over a specific time interval. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a vector v is added to a set S, and v is already in Span(S), what happens to Span(S U {v})? target_en: Q: If a vector v is added to a set S, and v is already in Span(S), what happens to Span(S U {v})? input: to Telugu: Q: What does the line integral of the H-field around a closed curve equal according to the original circuital law? target_en: Q: What does the line integral of the H-field around a closed curve equal according to the original circuital law? A) The magnetic flux through the surface B) The total current, including bound current C) The free current passing through the enclosed surface D) The displacement current in the region ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: What does the contractive regularization loss primarily measure? A) The sparsity of the latent code. B) The divergence between the prior and posterior distributions. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) considered a combination of PSK and ASK? A) Because it uses two different modulation alphabets for I and Q channels. B) Because it requires both analog and digital signal processing. C) Because it uses both phase and amplitude variations of the carrier signal simultaneously. D) Because it transmits on two separate carrier frequencies. ANSWER: C

B) ఎందుకంటే దానికి analog మరియు digital signal processing రెండూ అవసరం. C) ఎందుకంటే అది carrier signal యొక్క phase మరియు amplitude variations రెండింటినీ ఒకేసారి ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే అది రెండు వేర్వేరు carrier frequencies పై transmit చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) considered a combination of PSK and ASK? A) Because it uses two different modulation alphabets for I and Q channels. B) Because it requires both analog and digital signal processing. C) Because it uses both phase and amplitude variations of the carrier signal simultaneously. D) Because it transmits on two separate carrier frequencies. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is knowing the step response of a dynamical system important for overall system performance? A) It is the only way to measure the system's static gain accurately. B) It reveals potential large, fast deviations from steady state that could damage components or delay the system. C) It simplifies the mathematical description of the system to a single pole. D) It directly determines the system's frequency response characteristics. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: మొత్తం system performance కి ఒక dynamical system యొక్క step response తెలుసుకోవడం ఎందుకు ముఖ్యం? A) System యొక్క static gain ను ఖచ్చితంగా కొలవడానికి అదే ఏకైక మార్గం. B) Components ను పాడు చేయగల లేదా system ను ఆలస్యం చేయగల steady state నుండి పెద్ద, వేగవంతమైన విచలనాలను అది బయటపెడుతుంది. C) అది system యొక్క గణిత వివరణను ఒకే pole కి సరళీకరిస్తుంది. D) అది system యొక్క frequency response లక్షణాలను నేరుగా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is knowing the step response of a dynamical system important for overall system performance? A) It is the only way to measure the system's static gain accurately. B) It reveals potential large, fast deviations from steady state that could damage components or delay the system. C) It simplifies the mathematical description of the system to a single pole. D) It directly determines the system's frequency response characteristics. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the superposition principle necessary to derive Gauss's law from Coulomb's law? A) Because it allows the total field from a distributed charge to be the sum of individual fields. B) Because Gauss's law requires knowledge of the curl of the electric field. C) Because it ensures the electric field is spherically symmetric. D) Because Coulomb's law only gives the field from a single point charge. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Coulomb's law నుండి Gauss's law ని derive చేయడానికి superposition principle ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఎందుకంటే distributed charge నుండి వచ్చే total field ఒక్కొక్క fields యొక్క మొత్తంగా ఉండటానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే Gauss's law కి electric field యొక్క curl గురించిన జ్ఞానం అవసరం. C) ఎందుకంటే electric field spherically symmetric గా ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే Coulomb's law ఒకే point charge నుండి వచ్చే field ని మాత్రమే ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the superposition principle necessary to derive Gauss's law from Coulomb's law? A) Because it allows the total field from a distributed charge to be the sum of individual fields. B) Because Gauss's law requires knowledge of the curl of the electric field. C) Because it ensures the electric field is spherically symmetric. D) Because Coulomb's law only gives the field from a single point charge. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does increasing the damping ratio affect the resonant peak in the frequency response of a harmonic oscillator? A) The resonant peak sharpens and matches the undamped natural frequency precisely. B) The peak amplitude stays constant while bandwidth decreases. C) The peak amplitude increases and the resonant frequency shifts higher. D) The peak amplitude decreases and the peak frequency shifts to lower values. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Damping ratio ని పెంచడం harmonic oscillator యొక్క frequency response లోని resonant peak ను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) Resonant peak పదునుగా మారి undamped natural frequency కి ఖచ్చితంగా సరిపోలుతుంది. B) Bandwidth తగ్గగా peak amplitude స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. C) Peak amplitude పెరిగి resonant frequency ఎక్కువ వైపు shift అవుతుంది. D) Peak amplitude తగ్గి peak frequency తక్కువ values వైపు shift అవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does increasing the damping ratio affect the resonant peak in the frequency response of a harmonic oscillator? A) The resonant peak sharpens and matches the undamped natural frequency precisely. B) The peak amplitude stays constant while bandwidth decreases. C) The peak amplitude increases and the resonant frequency shifts higher. D) The peak amplitude decreases and the peak frequency shifts to lower values. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of a natural join compared to a standard equi-join? A) It only works with tables that have no foreign keys. B) It uses all columns with the same name in both tables as join conditions. C) It requires an explicit ON clause to define the join condition. D) It automatically filters the result to only include rows with matching primary keys. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard equi-join తో పోలిస్తే natural join యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Foreign keys లేని tables తో మాత్రమే అది పనిచేస్తుంది. B) రెండు tables లోనూ ఒకే పేరు ఉన్న అన్ని columns ను అది join conditions గా వాడుతుంది. C) Join condition ను నిర్వచించడానికి దానికి explicit ON clause అవసరం. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the rho-theta parametrization preferred over the slope-intercept form for line detection? A) It is computationally faster to calculate. input: to Telugu: Q: If a vector field $\mathbf{F}$ satisfies $\nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}$ everywhere across an open surface $S$ bounded by a closed curve $C$, what is the circulation $\oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$? A) 0 B) Equal to the surface area of $S$ C) Dependent on the specific choice of path $C$ D) Infinite ANSWER: A

A) 0 B) $S$ యొక్క surface area కి సమానం C) Path $C$ యొక్క నిర్దిష్ట ఎంపికపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది D) Infinite జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If a vector field $\mathbf{F}$ satisfies $\nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}$ everywhere across an open surface $S$ bounded by a closed curve $C$, what is the circulation $\oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$? input: to Telugu: Q: Under thermal equilibrium (zero bias), why does net current across a p-n junction cease to flow? A) All mobile electrons and holes across the entire semiconductor completely recombine and vanish. B) Fixed dopant ions leave the crystal lattice to physically block charge transfer. C) The bandgap of the semiconductor increases to an infinite value at the metallurgical interface. D) Diffusion current of carriers is exactly balanced by the drift current driven by the built-in electric field. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Thermal equilibrium (zero bias) లో p-n junction అంతటా net current ఎందుకు ప్రవహించడం ఆగిపోతుంది? A) మొత్తం semiconductor లోని అన్ని mobile electrons మరియు holes పూర్తిగా recombine అయి అదృశ్యమవుతాయి. B) Fixed dopant ions crystal lattice ని వదిలి charge transfer ని భౌతికంగా అడ్డుకుంటాయి. C) Metallurgical interface వద్ద semiconductor యొక్క bandgap infinite value కి పెరుగుతుంది. D) Carriers యొక్క diffusion current, built-in electric field నడిపే drift current తో కచ్చితంగా సమతుల్యమవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under thermal equilibrium (zero bias), why does net current across a p-n junction cease to flow? A) All mobile electrons and holes across the entire semiconductor completely recombine and vanish. B) Fixed dopant ions leave the crystal lattice to physically block charge transfer. C) The bandgap of the semiconductor increases to an infinite value at the metallurgical interface. D) Diffusion current of carriers is exactly balanced by the drift current driven by the built-in electric field. ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: In a wired-OR interrupt circuit, why might a spurious interrupt occur? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is dropout performed during the training process but not during inference? A) అది learning సమయంలో co-adaptation ను నిరోధించడానికి ఉద్దేశించబడింది, prediction సమయంలో data ను తొలగించడానికి కాదు B) Inference సమయంలో అది model ను చాలా నెమ్మదిగా చేస్తుంది C) Inference కి dropout కి విరుద్ధమైన mean field theory వాడకం అవసరం D) Training తర్వాత weight matrix శాశ్వతంగా మారిపోతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is dropout performed during the training process but not during inference? A) It is intended to prevent co-adaptation during learning, not to remove data during prediction B) It would make the model too slow during inference C) Inference requires the use of mean field theory which contradicts dropout D) The weight matrix is permanently changed after training ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using a circular buffer to implement a queue over a standard array? A) It makes the queue a purely functional data structure. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the F1-score considered a harmonic mean rather than a simple arithmetic mean of precision and recall? A) To allow the metric to handle negative values in the confusion matrix B) Because harmonic means are easier to calculate computationally than arithmetic means C) To punish extreme values and ensure a high score requires both precision and recall to be high D) To force the metric to always equal 1.0 regardless of model performance ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: F1-score ను precision మరియు recall యొక్క సాధారణ arithmetic mean గా కాకుండా harmonic mean గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) Confusion matrix లోని negative values ను metric handle చేయడానికి వీలుగా B) ఎందుకంటే harmonic means ను arithmetic means కంటే computationally సులభంగా లెక్కించవచ్చు C) తీవ్ర values ను శిక్షించి, ఎక్కువ score రావాలంటే precision మరియు recall రెండూ ఎక్కువగా ఉండేలా చూడడానికి D) Model performance తో సంబంధం లేకుండా metric ఎప్పుడూ 1.0 కి సమానం అయ్యేలా బలవంతం చేయడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the F1-score considered a harmonic mean rather than a simple arithmetic mean of precision and recall? A) To allow the metric to handle negative values in the confusion matrix B) Because harmonic means are easier to calculate computationally than arithmetic means C) To punish extreme values and ensure a high score requires both precision and recall to be high D) To force the metric to always equal 1.0 regardless of model performance ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In Bayesian inference, what role does the denominator of Bayes' theorem play in calculating the posterior probability? A) It determines the initial subjective belief prior to observing evidence. B) It maximizes the likelihood function across parameter dimensions. C) It acts as a normalizing constant to ensure posterior probabilities sum to one. D) It represents the likelihood of the hypothesis given the observed data. ANSWER: C

A) Evidence ను గమనించే ముందు ఉన్న initial subjective belief ను అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. B) Parameter dimensions అంతటా likelihood function ను అది గరిష్ఠం చేస్తుంది. C) Posterior probabilities sum one అయ్యేలా చూసే normalizing constant గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. D) Observed data ఇచ్చినప్పుడు hypothesis యొక్క likelihood ను అది సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In Bayesian inference, what role does the denominator of Bayes' theorem play in calculating the posterior probability? A) It determines the initial subjective belief prior to observing evidence. B) It maximizes the likelihood function across parameter dimensions. C) It acts as a normalizing constant to ensure posterior probabilities sum to one. D) It represents the likelihood of the hypothesis given the observed data. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following describes the behavior of a top-down parser? input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a hysteresis motor produce torque when the rotor is below synchronous speed? A) The magnetic field in the rotor lags behind the stator field due to magnetic hysteresis. B) The rotor is driven by external direct current through slip rings. C) The air gap reluctance is minimized through high-speed rotation. D) The rotor poles align perfectly with the stator poles at all speeds. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Rotor synchronous speed కంటే తక్కువలో ఉన్నప్పుడు hysteresis motor torque ను ఎందుకు ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది? A) Magnetic hysteresis వల్ల rotor లోని magnetic field stator field కంటే వెనుకబడి ఉంటుంది. B) Slip rings ద్వారా బయటి direct current తో rotor నడుస్తుంది. C) High-speed rotation ద్వారా air gap reluctance కనిష్ఠం అవుతుంది. D) అన్ని speeds వద్ద rotor poles stator poles తో పూర్తిగా align అవుతాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why does a hysteresis motor produce torque when the rotor is below synchronous speed? A) The magnetic field in the rotor lags behind the stator field due to magnetic hysteresis. B) The rotor is driven by external direct current through slip rings. C) The air gap reluctance is minimized through high-speed rotation. D) The rotor poles align perfectly with the stator poles at all speeds. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a cloud service experiences downtime, why might a customer still be responsible for the loss, according to standard cloud SLAs? C) Cloud providers are legally exempt from all forms of liability. D) SLAs often exclude downtimes caused by external factors like network issues or user misconfigurations. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక cloud service కి downtime వస్తే, standard cloud SLAs ప్రకారం నష్టానికి customer ఇంకా ఎందుకు బాధ్యుడు కావచ్చు? A) Outage ఒక వారం కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉంటేనే provider బాధ్యుడు. B) Provider వైపు ఉన్న అన్ని network issues ను customer చట్టపరంగా సరిచేయాలి. C) Cloud providers కి అన్ని రకాల liability నుండి చట్టపరమైన మినహాయింపు ఉంది. D) Network issues లేదా user misconfigurations వంటి బయటి కారణాల వల్ల వచ్చే downtimes ను SLAs తరచుగా మినహాయిస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a cloud service experiences downtime, why might a customer still be responsible for the loss, according to standard cloud SLAs? D) లోతైన recursion ని handle చేయడానికి stack size ని పెంచుతుంది. జవాబు: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a 'complex' instruction implemented via microcode actually decrease performance compared to a sequence of simple instructions? A) Microcode is too simple to perform arithmetic operations. B) It forces the compiler to ignore high-level language optimizations. C) Microcode instructions require more memory space than hardwired logic. D) It may include side effects or unnecessary hardware interactions that demand extra, inefficient clock cycles. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Microcode ద్వారా implement చేసిన 'complex' instruction, సరళమైన instructions క్రమంతో పోలిస్తే performance ను నిజానికి ఎందుకు తగ్గించవచ్చు? A) Arithmetic operations చేయడానికి microcode చాలా సరళమైనది. B) అది compiler ను high-level language optimizations ను పట్టించుకోకుండా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. C) Microcode instructions కి hardwired logic కంటే ఎక్కువ memory space అవసరం. D) దానిలో side effects లేదా అనవసరమైన hardware interactions ఉండవచ్చు, అవి అదనపు, అసమర్థమైన clock cycles ను కోరతాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why might a 'complex' instruction implemented via microcode actually decrease performance compared to a sequence of simple instructions? A) Microcode is too simple to perform arithmetic operations. B) It forces the compiler to ignore high-level language optimizations. C) Microcode instructions require more memory space than hardwired logic. D) It may include side effects or unnecessary hardware interactions that demand extra, inefficient clock cycles. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FFT often utilized when performing discrete convolutions in digital signal processing? A) అన్ని signals complex-valued అయ్యేలా చూడడానికి B) Time-domain signals ను periodic summations గా మార్చడానికి C) Laplace transform అవసరాన్ని దాటవేయడానికి D) Computational complexity ని O(N^2) నుండి O(N log N) కి తగ్గించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the FFT often utilized when performing discrete convolutions in digital signal processing? A) To ensure that all signals become complex-valued B) To convert time-domain signals into periodic summations C) To bypass the need for a Laplace transform D) To reduce the computational complexity from O(N^2) to O(N log N) ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: For a system described by a linear constant coefficient differential equation to be causal, what must be true of its impulse response h(t)? target_en: Q: For a system described by a linear constant coefficient differential equation to be causal, what must be true of its impulse response h(t)? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Heapsort considered an 'in-place' sorting algorithm? A) It does not require recursion to function. D) It uses a fixed amount of extra memory regardless of the input size. ANSWER: B

B) Heap ను store చేయడానికి అది ఉన్న array నే వాడుకుంటుంది, input size కి అనుపాతంలో అదనపు storage అవసరం లేదు. C) Elements ను swap చేయకుండా అది ఎప్పుడూ array ను ascending order లో sort చేస్తుంది. D) Input size తో సంబంధం లేకుండా అది స్థిరమైన అదనపు memory ను వాడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Heapsort considered an 'in-place' sorting algorithm? A) It does not require recursion to function. B) It utilizes the existing array to store the heap, requiring no additional storage proportional to the input size. C) It always sorts the array in ascending order without swapping elements. target_en: Q: Why is a reconstruction filter necessary after a digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in a PCM system? A) To increase the bit depth of the signal. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the expected value of rolling a fair six-sided die equal to 3.5 even though 3.5 cannot be rolled? A) The probabilities of the individual faces shift toward the median value during trials B) It accounts for variance and higher statistical moments inherent to fair dice C) Discrete random variables round upward to the nearest half-integer D) It represents the long-run average outcome rather than an achievable individual event ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: 3.5 అనేది dice పై రాదు అయినప్పటికీ, ఒక fair six-sided die ని వేసినప్పుడు expected value 3.5 కి ఎందుకు సమానం? A) Trials సమయంలో ఒక్కొక్క face యొక్క probabilities median value వైపు మారతాయి B) Fair dice కి సహజమైన variance మరియు higher statistical moments ని అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకుంటుంది C) Discrete random variables సమీప half-integer కి పైకి round అవుతాయి D) అది సాధించగల ఒక్క event ని కాకుండా దీర్ఘకాల సగటు ఫలితాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the expected value of rolling a fair six-sided die equal to 3.5 even though 3.5 cannot be rolled? A) The probabilities of the individual faces shift toward the median value during trials B) It accounts for variance and higher statistical moments inherent to fair dice C) Discrete random variables round upward to the nearest half-integer D) It represents the long-run average outcome rather than an achievable individual event ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does alpha-beta pruning effectively reduce the search time in a minimax tree? A) It only searches the first half of the tree depth. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Minimax tree లో alpha-beta pruning search time ని సమర్థవంతంగా ఎందుకు తగ్గిస్తుంది? A) అది tree depth లో మొదటి సగాన్ని మాత్రమే search చేస్తుంది. B) ప్రతి node వద్ద branching factor ని సగానికి తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Cutoffs ని వేగంగా కనుగొనడానికి nodes ని random order లో evaluate చేస్తుంది. D) చివరి నిర్ణయాన్ని ఏ విధంగానూ ప్రభావితం చేయలేని branches ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does alpha-beta pruning effectively reduce the search time in a minimax tree? A) It only searches the first half of the tree depth. B) It reduces the branching factor by half at every node. C) It evaluates nodes in a random order to find cutoffs faster. D) It eliminates branches that cannot possibly influence the final decision. ANSWER: D
